content: Fact check: Actor Arvind Trivedi, who played the role of Ravana in the serial Ramayana, passes away? A misleading information is going viral on social media. Social media users are sharing this information claiming that actor Arvind Trivedi, who played Ravana in the famous Indian television show ‘ Ramayan ‘ , has passed away. Further, users are also paying tribute to him by sharing this news.A user wrote on Twitter – ” Arvind Trivedi” the brilliant artist who played the role of Ravana in the popular serial “Ramayana” is no more. A pillar of knowledge and devotion has fallen. Many God give him a place at his feet. Om shanti!At the same time, a user wrote on Facebook – ” Sat Sat Naman to Ram devotee Shri Arvind Trivedi ji who played the role of Ravana in Ramayana serial. Tribute!At the same time, there are many such posts regarding his death, on Facebook and Twitter.Fact Check:To verify the veracity of the claim that is going viral on social media, we first searched on Google. A link of a news of ‘ Amar Ujala ‘ newspaper was found on Google . Its title was- ” Ravan’s actor Arvind Trivedi is no more , died at the age of 83 ” . This news was published by Amar Ujala on 6 October 2021.Apart from this, we found news published on 6th October 2021 of his demise on many news websites.While sharing the post on 6 October 2021, another user wrote – ” The news of the death of Shri Arvind Trivedi ji, who left an indelible mark in the hearts of crores of people in the character of Ravana in the popular serial “Ramayana”, is extremely sad. May Lord Shri Ram give him a place at his feet and give strength to the bereaved family. ” Peace ”Conclusion:Arvind Trivedi passed away on 6 October 2021. But, social media users are posting information related to his death is in a misleading manner.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: The real story of the ‘Asani’ cyclone bringing a mysterious golden chariot on the beach? A video is becoming massively viral on social media sites. In the video some people are bringing a golden chariot, pulled from the sea, towards Shore. A social media user Shivam shared the video and gave the caption, “A golden chariot found in the ocean: Due to Cyclone Asani, sea waves brought a ‘golden chariot’ along with them on a coast in Srikakulam district of Andhra Pradesh. The structure of this chariot is like a monastery. Apparently, this chariot has flown from Thailand or Myanmar and reached the coast of Andhra. Video: ABP news”https://twitter.com/Aaaru_Prem/status/1524259528698925056Similarly, a Facebook user Anand Srivastava wrote, “A chariot of gold has been found in the sea. Due to Cyclone Asani, sea waves have brought a ‘chariot of gold’ to a coast in Srikakulam district of Andhra Pradesh. The structure of this chariot is like a monastery. Perhaps this chariot has flown from Thailand or Myanmar and reached the coast of Andhra.”And, Virag Pandey also posted the video with the caption,” A golden chariot like a temple appeared in the sea, people cheered, where did the mysterious chariot come from, the officers involved in the investigation ..Watch amazing video of Andhra Pradesh.”Fact Check :After searching the internet, we found that many media houses reported on this video of chariot is of gold. And, social media users have shared the same video used in the reports. News24 wrote in the video’s caption on May 11, 2022 , ” ‘ Availed ‘ gold chariot cost in ‘ Billions ‘! .” Similarly, the video thumbnail of Dainik Jagran’s YouTube channel reads , “Golden chariot found flowing in the sea ! ” .https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3-PwXrW2SsgFurther, on our analysis, we found a tweet of ANI that, “#WATCH | Andhra Pradesh: A mysterious gold-coloured chariot washed ashore at Sunnapalli Sea Harbour in Srikakulam y’day, as the sea remained turbulent due to #CycloneAsani SI Naupada says, “It might’ve come from another country. We’ve informed Intelligence & higher officials.”#WATCH | Andhra Pradesh: A mysterious gold-coloured chariot washed ashore at Sunnapalli Sea Harbour in Srikakulam y'day, as the sea remained turbulent due to #CycloneAsani SI Naupada says, "It might've come from another country. We've informed Intelligence & higher officials." pic.twitter.com/XunW5cNy6O — ANI (@ANI) May 11, 2022On the other hand, Suman TV Telugu’s Verified YouTube channel on May 11, 2022 uploaded a News Bulletin report in which the Police Inspector of Srikakulam gave a statement that it is not a chariot or structure made of gold but a gold plated (gold-colored) the structure.Also Read: Another Deceptive Tweet by CJ Werleman To Defame Hindus. Know The Full Story.Conclusion :Hence, the claim that waves drove off a Chariot of gold Sunnapally in District Srikakulam Of Andhra is deceptive. The stucture is not made up of gold. Rather, it is made up of wood and steel. And, due to Cyclone Asani, this structure drifted from Myanmar or Thailand and came in the coastal region of Andhra Pradesh.Claim: A chariot of gold ‘ appeared ‘ in the sea, costing ‘ in billions ‘ !Claimed by: social media usersFact Check: misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Another Deceptive Tweet by CJ Werleman To Defame Hindus. Know The Full Story. A Video of a man being beaten up is going viral is going viral on the internet. Further, many social media users are sharing the video giving communal colours to it. In the same vein, CJ Werleman, who calls himself as an activist against Islamophobia, shared this video on his official Twitter account. Along with the video he wrote, “Muslim man assaulted by mob of Hindu extremists in Delhi, yesterday.” He later, deleted the post but the archived version of the post can be seen here.Similarly, Congress leader Alka Lamba also shared this video with the caption which can be nearly translated into English, “The way Delhi used to filled with blood shed on the streets of our Delhi …. 🙁 #ThankYouModiG #ThankYouKejriwalG”Fact checkIn our investigation, our team got to know that, the man in the video was Irfan Khan. 37 yr. old Irfan was accused of stalking & misbehaving with a 13-years-old girl.Moreover, we also found a tweet of ANI regarding the same matter. ANI tweeted the whole matter, “Delhi Police arrested a 37-year-old man namely Irfan Khan for allegedly stalking & misbehaving with a 13-years-old girl. Case registered against him u/s 354D IPC & 12 POCSO Act. Accused was produced before court &remanded to judicial custody, police saidDelhi Police arrested a 37-year-old man namely Irfan Khan for allegedly stalking & misbehaving with a 13-years-old girl. Case registered against him u/s 354D IPC & 12 POCSO Act. Accused was produced before court &remanded to judicial custody, police said — ANI (@ANI) May 12, 2022Later, CJ Werleman also stated a clarification. He wrote, “I deleted this tweet because turns out there was more to this story – the individual was credibly accused of sexual assault. This doesn’t justify vigilante violence, but it also doesn’t make him a sympathetic character.”Also Read: Who is CJ Werleman?ConclusionSocial media users posted the video with misleading claims. Moreover, so called activist like CJ Werleman has given the incident communal colors which his absolutely baseless. And, later he deleted the tweet but not apologised for misleading people. DFRAC, request reader not to believe in any post on social media before knowing the actual matter.Also Read: List Of Fabricated stories of Sudhir Chaudhary and Zee News.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Did Rajasthan government allow Muslims to offer Namaz at Kumbhalgarh Fort? A post on social media claimed that the Gehlot government of Rajasthan has given permission to the people of the Muslim community to offer Namaz in Mewar’s Kumbhalgarh Fort .Further, caption reads, “Congress is giving a unique gift to the Hindus who had voted for the Congress in Rajasthan. Accept happily (now Namaz will be offered in Kumbhalgadh, the pride of Mewar).Ashok Gehlot did what Akbar could not do . Rajasthan government allowed ijtema in Kumbhalgarh fort of Maharana Pratap. Only possible if Congress is there, destruction of Hindu culture.”Fact Check:To investigate the above claim, we looked for the information about the Fort .In 2013, it was declared a World Heritage Site by UNESCO .Since, the Kumbhalgarh Fort comes under Archaeological Survey of India of the Union Ministry of Culture , Government of India. Therefore, it is outside the purview of the the Rajasthan government to allow Muslims to offer Namaz there.Also Story: List Of Fabricated stories of Sudhir Chaudhary and Zee News.ConclusionTherefore , the claim that the Rajasthan government allowing to offer Namaz in the fort is fake and misleading.Claim Review: Rajasthan government allows Muslims to offer Namaz in Kumbhalgarh Fort.Claimant: Social media userFact Check: Fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Kiran Bedi Getting Trolled All Over The Internet For Her Misleading Tweet. Read The Full Story. Several social media users are sharing a video on social media sites, claiming that National Geography has paid one million dollars (about seven and a half million rupees) for this 15-second video. Moreover, famous former IPS and former Puducherry Lieutenant Governor (LG) Kiran Bedi captioned the viral video “Watch this.”Replying to Kiran Bedi’s tweet, famous film writer and standup comedian Varun Grover taunted , “National Geographic paid 1 million dollars for this because India’s top cinematographer Madhu Kishwar shot this footage with multiple cameras, all in one take.”National Geographic paid 1 million dollars for this because India's top cinematographer Madhu Kishwar shot this footage with multiple cameras, all in one take. — वरुण 🇮🇳 (@varungrover) May 11, 2022Simillarly, Twitter users named Ratan Kumar Agarwal and Deshbhakt Sherni have also shared the video with the same claim.Fact Check :On our fact check analysis we found a video on the YouTube channel named YouTube Movies. Further, the video was uploaded on September 5, 2017 with the title, “5-Headed Shark Attack – Trailer.” At 1:05 to fish helicopter Feather swoon Kill Tax drink her down bring happened saw Go Can Is.Therefore, the video is not real its taken from a movie. And, the movie is purely based on fiction. Further, on keyword research we found no such video of any five headed shark by National Geographic.Recommended Story: List Of Fabricated stories of Sudhir Chaudhary and Zee News.Conclusion :Hence, The viral video is misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did Ajit Doval tweet that If there is no Saraswati Pooja in Jamia then why is iftar celebrated in BHU? A screengrab of a tweet by the name of National Security Advisor Ajit Doval is getting viral on social media. Further, in the screengrab, it is written that, if there is no Saraswati Pooja in Jamia then why is iftar celebrated in Banaras Hindu University? VC should be asked this question?Social media users are sharing this screenshot massively on their accounts.Similarly, another user Dr. Ram Pandey also shared the same screengrab.Fact CheckTo know the reality of the viral screengrab we looked for the official Twitter account of Ajit Doval. But, found a tweet of the verified account of Arindam Bagchi, official Spokesperson, Ministry of External Affairs, India. In the tweet he wrote, “Important Alert! Shri Ajit Kumar Doval K.C., National Security Advisor has no official account on Twitter. This is to advise caution against impostor or fake accounts under his name.”Important Alert! Shri Ajit Kumar Doval K.C., National Security Advisor has no official account on Twitter. This is to advise caution against impostor or fake accounts under his name. — Randhir Jaiswal (@MEAIndia) November 8, 2021Then, we searched for the account @Iajitdoval_ shown on the screengrab. We found that it is a parody account.Also Read: List Of Fabricated stories of Sudhir Chaudhary and Zee News.ConclusionHence, from our fact check analysis it is clear that Ajit Doval is not on Twitter. Hence, the viral screenshot is wrong and baseless
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did A Woman Faint After Air India Denied Her To Board The Flight? A social media user ????? ??????? shared a woman lying on the floor.He Further, sharing the video he wrote, “Please help to forward this video till it reaches to their management and action taken against such employees. Lets show them power of common man. Heart & Diabetic Patient seeking for medical service inspite of they call security & forced her to go out of the airport.Lets make such shameless employees unemployed & Think before you book Air-India flights.This video of Delhi International Airport Terminal 3 for Air India flight AI 823. PNR was J84KT.Note: Recording is for 1min out of 60min of Incident.Case:We’re 3 people at the airport and there was some technical issues going on @ security check-in point. Additionally, we had a heart & diabetic lady patient with us. Knowing the situation, we already communicated Air-India staff to help us in check-in due to technical issues at the check-in point. They strictly denied us any assistance by saying the security check-in issue is none of our business.However, we made check-in successfully. We called Air-India staff again to inform them that we have cleared check-in & we are moving towards gate 32B but we will be late by 5 min due to having a Heart & Diabetic Patient with us & she can’t run. My cousin reached the boarding gate within 2min & I reached after him with my aunt. They literally closed gates for us & other passengers like us even if we intimated (plane was yet to fly after 30min).My cousin had his final year VIVA on the same day on which he missed the flight.And, my aunt got anxiety which turned into a panic attack, and she fainted there on the spot. We asked for a medical emergency. But, instead of that a staff called security and asked them to leave us at the exit gate.”Soon the video went viral on the internet.Fact CheckOn our fact check analysis we got a clarification on the official handle of Air India.#FlyAI : Air India statement on Delhi Airport Video . pic.twitter.com/mHgUkWk13p — Air India (@airindia) May 11, 2022ConclusionAir India refuted the claims of the viral video and called it misleading. And, the doctors were called immediately.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Was Pfizer Vice President arrested in fraud case? A poster is going viral on social media. In which it was claimed that the Vice President of the pharmaceutical company Pfizer, which makes the COVID-19 vaccine, has been arrested in a fraud case.Sharing the poster, a user wrote, “Pfizer Executive Vice President Rady Johnson has been arrested from his home. Federal agents have charged him with several counts of fraud.”Fact Check:To check the above claim, when we searched about it on the internet, we found a sarcastic article. This article was published on the website ‘Vancouver Times’ on 6 May 2022.The website clearly states that the Vancouver Times is the most trusted source for West Coast satire. We write satirical stories about issues affecting conservatives. We are not affiliated in any way with the mainstream media (CBC, CTV etc.), and any resemblance between our content and MSM’s work is purely coincidental.Apart from this, we also got a fact check from the international news agency Reuters. A Pfizer spokesman told Reuters that the claims of Johnson’s arrest are “false”. “Ready Johnson has not been arrested,” a Pfizer spokesman said.ConclusionTherefore, the claim of arrest of Pfizer Vice President Ready Johnson is fake.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did AAP MP Sanjay Singh beat up party worker with shoes? A video is going viral on social media. In the video that in a meeting, an MP beat up the leader of his own party with his shoes. A scuffle is also taking place between the two. Some officials are intervening between the two leaders. Social media users are sharing this video claiming that this video is of an Aam Aadmi Party meeting and party MP Sanjay Singh thrashed his leader with shoes.On Facebook, a user named Amit Sharma wrote- ” Aam Aadmi Party meeting was going on in Delhi in which MP Sanjay Singh beat up his own party leader with shoes…. These bastards are not able to handle Delhi and now they are dreaming of forming the government in Gujarat…..!!!! ,Fact Check:We did a Google search to investigate this news going viral. But we did not get any news of AAP MP Sanjay Singh thrashing any leader with shoes there. After this we searched on Google ‘ MP beat up politician with shoes .’ Further, we got a report of ‘ Hindustan ‘ newspaper published on 7th March 2019. Whose title- ‘ MP beats MLA with shoes , video went viral ‘ .According to this report, this video is from Sant Kabirnagar district of UP. Where, during the district planning meeting, BJP MP Sharad Tripathi beat up his own party MLA Rakesh Singh Baghel with his shoes. This incident is 3 years old.Then, we found the viral video on the YouTube channel of ‘ Aaj Tak ‘ . which was posted on 6th March 2019. This is the same video, which is being viral as being of Aam Aadmi Party.Conclusion:Hence, in our investigation of the viral video proves that the video of MP being thrashed with shoes is not of Aam Aadmi Party but of BJP. This incident is from 2019. But, social media users are sharing the video with a false and misleading claim.Claim- AAP MP Sanjay Singh thrashed worker with shoesClaimant- Social media usersFact Check – Misleading and False
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Did Arvind Kejriwal Say, “Corruption should continue?” A 13-second video of CM Arvind Kejriwal is getting viral on the internet, where he is heard speaking about corruption.In that video, he said, “I have not seen a single economist writing about corruption ruining the country. Corruption should go on.”A Facebook user writes, “AAP’s corruption must continue!”Fact Check:We reverse searched the video and found that the video is clipped and is actually from an event celebrating news organization lokmat’s 50th anniversary in Nagpur Maharashtra on 8th of May.The full video was posted on the official account of the Aam Janta Party.And, also on the YouTube account of Aam Admi Party.Conclusion:Therefore, the video has been clipped and shared out of context that Kejriwal and AAP support corruption.Claim Review: Arvind Kejriwal Say, “Corruption should continue.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Video Went Viral With Claim That France Used Water Cannons To Dispersed Namazis. Know The Full Story. A video is getting viral on social media. Further sharing the video a Facebook user wrote in Bengali which can be nearly translated into English, “Finally France has started working. They are taking over the road and removing the Namazis from the road!! Hope to see this again Drama named “Boycott France” in some countries.”Similarly, many other users also shared the video.Fact CheckUsing InVID tool and reverse image searching of screengrabs from the viral video we found the same video on the Youtube channel named Yüksekova Haber Portalı. The channel uploaded the video on November 9, 2012 whith a Turkish caption, “Gaz bombalı ‘sivil Cuma namazı – Yüksekova – Gever.” Moreover, the English translation of the caption is,”Civil Friday prayer with gas bombs – Yüksekova – Gever.”Furthermore, while keyword research we found a Turkish Report of ilkehaber. The publish date of the report was 9th November, 2012. And, the title of the report “civil Friday prayers”. The report covered a incident where prisoner sat on a hunger strike and police used water cannons and tear gas to disperse them. From the report we also got to know that Events took place between the crowd and the police in the Orman, Kışla, Cumhuriyet, Güngör, Kaniheyder and Esentepe neighborhoods of the district.ConclusionHence, the users are sharing a video of an old incident of Turkey with false caption.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: What is the reality of the viral video of a running dinosaur? A video is going viral on social media sites, in which it is being claimed that the animals seen in it are dinosaurs.On the evening of 05 May 2022, a user named Zombie Panchi captioned “Dinosaurs born again!!!” Has shared a video, in which animals that seem like dinosaurs can be seen.https://twitter.com/ZombieAviator/status/1522181071353249792Similarly, a user named Joon writes, “Dinosaurs running” While Twitter user, Buitengebieden captioned “This took me a few seconds..” (This took a few seconds” with a laughing emoji. For) posted the same video.Fact Check:After searching the internet, we found that the claim being made in the video is misleading, as the animals seen in the video are not dinosaurs but ‘koti’ which live in South and Central America as well as Mexico and South America. – Found in the western United States (USA). Their weight is possible as a big cat, but in stature they are seen between a dog and a monkey.Wion News website has covered it and denied that the video is being falsely claimed.Also, a Twitter user named Dapir Don Dharshi Kamil added the BBC video to the same video with the caption “So, if you put a video with coati, or coatimundi, in reverse, you are in Jurassic Park. Who made this.”So, if you put a video with coati, or coatimundi, in reverse, you are in Jurassic Park. Who made this?!?! 🦕 pic.twitter.com/cEgUEpCNwl — DAPPER DON DHARSHI • K A M I L • (@SoloFlow786) May 4, 2022Conclusion:This fact check proves that the claim being made by social media users quoting dinosaurs is false and misleading.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Truth of Chinese robots doing Bharatnatyam Videos and photos with strange facts keep going viral on social media. Here, sometimes a human being is made into a machine, and sometimes a human is called a robot. A video with a similar claim is going viral. In this video, two women are doing Bharatnatyam. Social media users are calling these two women Chinese robots.A user named Narinder Gupta wrote on Facebook – “Watch this dance carefully. The dance is being performed at Disneyland in Shanghai*. *These two are not human dancers, but two Chinese-made robots*. *The duration of the dance is only five minutes. But the waiting time to buy a ticket to watch this dance is 4 hours. The ticket price to watch this dance is 499 yuan, which is equivalent to 75 dollxars*. *The facial expressions of the robots are perfect and it is difficult to distinguish them from real humans.”Fact Check:To check the reality of the viral video, we reverse searched some of the frames of the video. On searching, we found a link to a YouTube video. A YouTube channel named Indian Raga posted this video on August 11, 2017. Moreover, the title of the video is titled as “ Vahana Alarippu : Bharatanatyam Dance | Best of Indian Classical Dance” has been given.As the title of this video suggests, it is not from China but from India. Then, we checked the description of this video. Investigation revealed that this Bharatnatyam has been performed by Sophia Salingaros and Isha Parupudi. Sofia is also the choreographer of this dance.Conclusion:Therefore, DFRAC fact check proves that the claims being made by social media users are false and misleading. Because this Bharatnatyam is not being done by Chinese robots but by two dancers.Claim- Chinese robot did BharatnatyamClaimant- Social media usersFact Check – False and Deceptive
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did the Russian MiG-31BM fighter jet shoot down in Ukraine? A picture of a fighter jet on fire is getting viral on social media sites. People are sharing the images of the fighter jet with the claim that the fighter jet is MIG-31BM and it got shot down in Ukraine amid Russia- the Ukraine war.A Facebook user writes, “Rare Russian MiG-31BM fighter jet shot down in Ukraine destroyed along with crew – media.”Fact Check:We did a reverse search of the image to know the authenticity of the picture getting viral on different social media platforms.With the internet search, we got reports from different sites containing similar images.The links to which are provided here and here.We found out that the fighter jet was shot down in siriya which was of the siriyan government only. In Which members of the Syrian group Jaish Tahrir al-Sham in the eastern province of Kalamun shot down a Su-24 bomber of President Bashar al-Assad ‘s Air Force.The date was 12th of march and the fighter jet was Su-24.Conclusion:Therefore the picture is getting viral with the misleading claims.Claim Review: The Russian MiG-31BM fighter jet shoot down in Ukraine.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did World Economic Forum Endorse A Commercial In Which A Man Suggest To Kill A Child? A video in which a man suggesting to kill a woman’s son to prevent carbon emissions is going viral on the internet. Sharing the video social media users are claiming that it is a commercial done by World economic. Further, sharing the video Heidi McDonald wrote, “WOW! How’s this for disgusting? This video is so disturbing and UNNECESSARY that you would not believe it’s an actual commercial done by the WORLD ECONOMIC FORUM. Check out the credits at the end. Pass this on to every single person you know!””Similarly, Nastasia Grace wrote, “ This video is so disturbing and UNNECESSARY that you would not believe it’s an actual commercial done by the WORLD ECONOMIC FORUM… smh.. This is the video I shared on my YouTube channel.”Similarly, many users have shared this video criticizing WEF for endorsing this commercial.Fact CheckFirstly, in our analysis we searched the official site and YouTube channel of WEF. But, we didn’t find any such video there. Then, by keyword searching we found that the viral video is a clip from season two, episode six of the British TV series UTOPIA. Moreover, we also found the same video on the Youtube channel named Augusto Jacquier. The channel uploaded the video on 15th August, 2024 with the title, “Utopia – Season 2, Episode 6 – Opening scene.”Also Read: Is Raghuram Rajan Is Going To be The Next Governor Of Bank Of England?ConclusionHence, the claim WEF have endorsed the viral video is false.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: What are the truth behind Amit Shah and Pooja Singhal’s viral picture? Jharkhand is in the headlines these days. The reason for this is to interrogate CA CM Suman Singh of veteran IAS Pooja Singhal and her second husband Abhishek Jha, arrested with Rs 19.31 crore in the raid of the Directorate of Mountains (ED).The picture of IAS Pooja Singhal with Union Home Minister Amit Shah is getting viral on social media.Avinash Das, the director of the film ‘Anarkali of Aarah and the web series ‘She’, on the morning of May 8, 2022, tweeted a photo of Pooja Singhal with the caption “A few days before she was caught with the cash from home.” (Translates Hindi), in which Pooja Singhal is seen with Amit Shah speaking something in his ear.Tweet archive linkhttps://twitter.com/avinashonly/status/1523114250620702722A verified Twitter account Meenakshi Joshi Writes, “How corrupt is IAS Pooja Singhal. What does greed do after having a good salary, status, and fame? With this tweet a picture was posted with piles of notes can be seen.कितनी भ्रष्ट है IAS पूजा सिंघल । अच्छी सैलरी, रूतबा और जलवा सब होने के बाद लालच क्या क्या करवाता है। pic.twitter.com/dHzxVOvCj6 — Meenakshi Joshi (@IMinakshiJoshi) May 7, 2022Shahnawaz Ansari shared the same picture with the hashtag #PoojaSinghal and the caption “corrupted IAS Pooja Singhal having some important talk with the country’s Home Minister Amit Shah”.https://twitter.com/shanu_sab/status/1523175866146119680Fact Check:After doing an internet search and reverse image search, we found that the image was uploaded on the image provider website Shutterstock on 16 September 2017. Apart from this, News Bharti and Lens Eye news portal including The Telegraph have covered the rally “Garib Kalyan Mela”, in which the then Chief Minister of Jharkhand Raghuvar Das is also present. At that time Amit Shah was on a three-day visit to Jharkhand. During that time he had launched many schemes. In this event, he organized a rally “Garib Kalyan Mela” and distributed the connections of LPG cylinders.Videos in this regard can also be seen on DD News and Bharatiya Janata Party’s verified YouTube channel.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0GS8tqXMR9QAlso, we were retweeted by a user named Lala to Avinash Das, in which he shared a screenshot writing “delete kar be bollywood’s Ashutosh @avinashonly” in which it is told how old this picture is.conclusion :The claim with which the picture is being shared on social media is baseless and false as it is from the time when BJP was in power in Jharkhand.
label: truth

content: Fact Check:Is the viral video of Muslim praying on azan and blocking streets really from France? On the auspicious occasion of Eid-Ul-Fitr, a video of many Muslims gathered at a place to offer prayers is getting viral. People all over the globe are sharing the video.In the 30 sec video, many believers can be seen offering prayers at the time of Eid, the chanting of Azan can also be heard from background music. The video is getting viral with the claim that the video is from France.A Twitter user wrote, “25 years ago France was memorizing the lesson of ‘Liberal-Humanity’…now it is getting a ‘lesson’.. Common French citizens have no way to walk.. Videohttps://twitter.com/KreatelyMedia/status/1523104722588037120?s=20&t=3fP-lPZMSuDaq2YVW0ELEQThe video is getting viral on Facebook too with similar captions.Fact Check:We reverse searched the video to know the authenticity of the video getting lot of attraction on the internet. We found that the video is actually not from the France but from the Russian, capital Moscow during Eid-Ul-Fitr.The same video was posted by many on the internet in the year 2013 which make this video very old.Москва. Проспект мира. Курбан байрам pic.twitter.com/GBhDnt40Kk — Olga Ivshina (@oivshina) October 15, 2013The news was shared on a Russian news site too.Also, a report from Reuters and BBC showed that France has banned street prayers from the year 2011.Conclusion:Therefore, the video is not from France, but from Moscow.Claim Review: the viral video of Muslim prying azan and blocking streets from France.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: Misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Taj Mahal Or Tejo Mahalaya? Know The Full Story. A claim is going viral on the internet that the Taj Mahal is originally a Hindu building named Tejo Mahalaya. In the support of the claim social media user @jagatmindri, tweeted, “Yes this one rupee Book is the source of all the controversy and the latest petition in the UP court.”Similarly, @rwingnat wrote, “Hindus must unite and stand against attacking forces of Islam. #GyanvapiMosque #TajMahalThe basis of the controversy is a book named Taj Mahal: The True Story by P N Oak which was released in 1989. In the book, Oak claimed that the monument was built in 1155 AD. Since then, this controversy is going on.Moreover, on July 24, 2020, also giving reference to a report of Kreately by Dilbert BJP leader Kapil Mishra tweeted, “Taj Mahal – A Hindu Temple All scientific evidence prove that Taj Mahal is Tejo Mahalaya, ancient Hindu Vedic temple For 300 years the world was fooled to believe that Taj Mahal was built by the Shahjahan.Fact CheckOn our fact check analysis we got a report of Hindustan Times of 25 August, 2017. In the report, it was written that ASI has told the Agra court that the Taj Mahal is a Tomb, not a Hindu building.Further, a RTI was also filed in 2016 filed where the appellant wanted to know whether Taj Mahal at Agra is Taj Mahal or Tejo Mahalaya. In a response to which Central information commission released a clarification in which they have stated that there is no evidence that the Taj Mahal is actually Tejo Mahalaya.ConclusionCurrently, the matter is in court. A plea is being filled to open the closed door of the Taj Mahal at the Allahabad High Court. As of now, there is no official statement of the state or ASI from which it can be concluded that the Taj Mahal is Tejo Mahalaya. Hence, the viral claim is misleading.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Is Raghuram Rajan Is Going To be The Next Governor Of Bank Of England? A piece of news is getting viral on the internet that ex-RBI Governor and renowned Indian economist Raghuram Rajan is going to be the next governor Of the Bank Of England. Further, sharing a picture of @nidar_hl wrote in the caption, “World’s renowned economist Mr. Raghuram Rajan was the Governor of RBI in India but due to wrong policies of Modi Ji and Amit Shah he resigned from the post of RBI Governor. Many congratulations to Shri Raghuram Rajan ji on being appointed as the Governor of Bank of England .”Similarly, another user @santoshyadav313 wrote, “Many congratulations to Shri Raghuram Rajan ji on being appointed as the Governor of Bank of England.”Many users on social media are sharing post congratulating him for being appointed as the Governor of bank of England.Fact CheckIn our fact check analysis we found that the incumbent governor of bank of England is Andrew John Bailey since 16 March 2020.Further, on reverse search of the image used by the users we found a report of Indian Express of 4th September 2013. The title of the report is, “Raghuram Rajan takes over as 23rd Governor of Reserve Bank.”Hence, the image used by the user is old. It is of the time when Rajan was appointed as governor of RBI. Moreover, on keyword research we have not found any such report that he is going to be appointed as the governor if bank of India yet.This fake news was spread in 2018 also when politician like Sashi Tharoor also tweeted this.ConclusionRajan is not going to be appointed as the governor of bank of England.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Viral Video of a woman constable giving a speech on Love Jihad. Know the whole truth. A video of a woman constable is getting the attention of many on social media. In the video, the woman is seen giving a speech. In the speech, she says, “If a Muslim man marries two Hindu women to give birth to 12 kids so in the next 20 years Muslims can be in power in India.”She further talks about a Muslim man named Wasim Akram who runs a Facebook page by the Daksha Sharma who traps Hindu girls in his love and exploits them. Wasim was also arrested by police. He accepted upon his arrest that all this is running under the name of Love Jihad. The video also revealed the association that is in Kerala.The whole speech can be seen under this link.Fact Check:By simply looking at the video one could tell that the video is morphed as no words and voiceover are syncing in together.We reverse searched too to take out the real video of the Woman Constable and her speech and found the same video on a Youtube channel of Punjab Kesari. The policewoman here in the video is complaining about her higher official in front of the media.The same news was covered by The Times of India under the headline, “Woman Constable alleges harassment in mainpuri.”Also, we find out the video is five years old .Conclusion:The video is being spread with the fake claim. Also, the video is evidently morphed in nature.Claim Review: Video of a woman constable giving a speech on love jihad.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: Fake.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Is Russia preparing for a parade to celebrate their war and genocide in Europe? Amid the ongoing Russia Ukraine crisis, another piece of news that Russia is preparing for a victory parade is getting circulated all over the internet. Social media users are sharing some pictures with the claims that fascist Russia is preparing a parade. Further, sharing some images Michael MacKay wrote, “Red armbands, white circle, black symbol Russian fascists prepare for a parade to celebrate their war and genocide in Europe.”Similarly, Visegrád 24 shared an image with the caption, “Russian Army training ahead of their May 9th parade in Moscow. Looks familiar doesn’t it? Nice black outfits with armbands…”Further, along with the picture another user Anders Östlund wrote, “Russian soldiers training for victory day. History goes full circle.”Many users shared this picture with the same claim.Fact CheckWhile reverse image searching of the viral pictures we found the viral image of women in the parade on gettyimages.The image is of Russian servicewomen march during a Victory Day parade rehearsal on Dvortsovaya (Palace) Square in central Saint Petersburg on April 26, 2019.Hence, the above image is old. It has no relation with the ongoing situation.Moreover, we found a tweet of @PutinBear71 of April 20,2018. Along with the picture he wrote,”Shreds, that’s how it was .. The girls from the Ministry of Internal Affairs are rehearsing the parade.”@PutinBear71 @mhmckHence, this viral image is also old.Also Read: Madhya Pradesh CM Shivraj comes out of the women’s toilet. Picture goes viralConclusionHence, our fact check proves that users are sharing old images with misleading.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: The truth behind the viral picture of a wounded policeman. On 2nd of May clashes between two communal groups took place in the district of Rajasthan, Jodhpur for hoisting an Islamic flag at the Jalori gate circle before Eid.Meanwhile, a picture is getting viral on all the news reports and also on various social media platforms of a policeman. In that video, a policeman is seen tying a handkerchief on his wounded forehead.People all over the internet are claiming the wound of a policeman to be fake.A Facebook user wrote, “This video is becoming increasingly viral on social media. The reality of the policeman who got hurt was captured in the video, all the riots are happening due to planning. Now the question arises till it is possible to investigate? Will there be strict action for spreading lies on this? The newspaper also seems to be completely involved in this fraud.”(Translates Hindi)DDN News too shared the same post on their page with the same caption.Twitter Users also shared the same post with similar captions on it.Reality of the policeman who claimed to be injured in the #Jodhpur Violence on #Eid,reality captured in this video,all Violence happening against Muslims in #India are in a planned way.Now,the question is, in these circumstances can we expect fair investigation by the same cops? pic.twitter.com/f8OXVS18Vs — Mohd Amir Mintoee (@MAmintoee) May 5, 2022Fact Check:We reverse searched the video to know about its authenticity the video. That very video was posted by the official Twitter handle of Jodhpur Police.“The truth of the misleading news regarding the injury of ASI Shri Dhannaram in the Jalori Gate incident… In the incident, there was a head injury of the ASI, due to which there was blood on the hand and handkerchief. After the incident, the injured ASI was made medical and FIR was registered in the police station Sardarpura.” Reads the Caption. (Translates Hindi)The police also urged people to avoid fake news.Conclusion:Therefore, the video is getting viral with misleding claims.Claim Review: a policeman is seen tying a handkerchief on his wounded forehead.Claimed by: social media usersFact Check: Misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Reality of the women protesters breaking down the police shield in Mexico. An image of a group of women protesting breaking down the police’s shield in Mexico is going on the internet. Users are claiming that these picture is of a protest regarding when abortion rights where these women marched to the presidential palace & attempted to burn it down. Further, along with the image Rima Isam Anabtawi wrote, “In Mexico when abortion rights were up for debate they marched to the presidential palace & attempted to burn it down. The Mexican government quickly decriminalized Abortion nationwide soon after that. Does this mean abortion is legal in Mexico? No. They are still fighting for rights but this was a huge step in that direction. A historic one.”Similarly, many user have shared this image on their accounts.Fact CheckOn reverse image search we found a report of reuters. In the report we found the viral image.According to the report the image is of a protest in Mexico when women kicked police officer’s shield during a protest outside the National Palace on international Women’s day in Mexico city, March,8, 2021.ConclusionHence, the viral image is not related with the protest regarding the abortion rights. Therefore, the claims with the viral image is misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Madhya Pradesh CM Shivraj comes out of the women’s toilet. Picture goes viral A video of Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan coming out from a women’s toilet is going viral on social media. In the viral video, Shivraj is coming out of a toilet. On the walls of that toilet, it was written that Women’s toilet. After this, he is greeting the people by shaking hands with them.A user named Sachin Dubey wrote on Facebook – “ Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan Ji coming out of the women’s toilet.Fact Check:On reverse-searching some of the frames of this viral video, we found a video uploaded on YouTube. This video was uploaded on a YouTube channel named ‘ Global Herald News ‘ on 19th April 2019. The titled of the video is, “ Khargone- Shivraj Singh Chouhan entered the women’s toilet . Shivraj Singh Chauhan enters women’s toilet” .This is the same video that is being shared by social media users.Also Read: Did police thrashed out Muslims who were asking for a separate country in Assam.Conclusion:Therefore, our fact check proves that the viral video is 3 years old. Hence, the claim of social media users is misleading.Claim- CM Shivraj coming out of the women’s toiletClaimant- Sachin Dubey and other Social media usersFact Check – Misleading

content: Fact Check: Know the reality behind the viral picture of Rahul Gandhi in the name of Nepal’s wedding. Recently, in Kathmandu, Nepal the wedding video of former Congress President Rahul Gandhi, his friend, daughter of former Nepalese ambassador to Myanmar Bhim Udas, and former CNN journalist Sumanima Udas was viral on social media in which he was seen with a woman.The woman was seen having a drink, although it was being claimed that Rahul Gandhi was partying with Chinese Ambassador Hou Yanqi at a pub in Nepal.Now another picture of Rahul Gandhi is going viral on social media, in which former Congress leader and current Union Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia are also seen. It is being claimed by social media users that this picture is of Nepal’s wedding.Shared this picture from the verified Twitter account of Madhya Pradesh Congress Seva Dal with the caption ‘ye alag bat ki khamosh khade rahte hain, phir bhi jo log bade hain wo bade rahte hain – Shri @RahulGandhiji at his friend’s wedding ceremony in Nepal.’ Has been.(Translates hindi)Fact Check:By doing a reverse image search on the Internet, we found that this image was published on the Hindustan Times website on 15 October 2011 with the headline “Royal guests at royal wedding”.According to Hindustan Times, the then AICC General Secretary Rahul Gandhi and the then Union Minister of State Jyotiraditya Scindia with Jigme Dorji Wangchuck, former King of Bhutan, at the Chang Liem Thang Stadium in Thimphu on the occasion of the wedding reception of King Jigme Dorji Wangchuck and Queen Jetsun Pema Wangchuck of Bhutan are appearing. More photos from the royal wedding are included in the news when you scroll through.Conclusion:This fact check proves that the viral picture of Congress leader Rahul Gandhi attending a Nepal wedding is fake.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Is Finland transporting military equipment on the eastern border with Russia? Russia invaded Ukraine on 24 February 2022, marking a steep escalation of the Russo-Ukrainian War, which began in 2014 following the Ukrainian Revolution of Dignity. Since the start of Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, 223 children have died and 408 were injured in Ukraine says various reports from different news sites.Meanwhile, a video is getting viral on social media sites. In the video, large military tanks with military equipment can be seen.People are sharing the video on Twitter with different captions.A Twitter user (@khalediskef) wrote, “A circulated video by #Tampere residents, #Finland shows transporting military equipment to the eastern border with #Russia. In addition to dozens of Leopard tanks, a huge amount of Soviet equipment BMP, MTLB, KSHM-1V16.”A circulated video by #Tampere residents, #Finland shows transporting military equipment to the eastern border with #Russia. In addition to dozens of Leopard tanks, a huge amount of Soviet equipment BMP, MTLB, KSHM-1V16 pic.twitter.com/NxO6BIVItb — Khaled Iskef خالد اسكيف (@khalediskef) May 3, 2022Another user (@OsintTv) wrote, “Per report #Finland has begun moving military equipments presumably towards Russian border, following the pending decision to join #NATO. Visual from social media.”https://twitter.com/OsintTv/status/1521763320088387584?s=20&t=zrHAt0jQt4e-L-wrJVa72gFact Check:We reverse searched the video to know its authenticity of the video. We found that the video of the military tanks with military equipment is not from Finland but they are heading to Western Finland for the #Arrow22- exercise that was announced a year ago.A Swedish news site too told the reality of the video in one of its reports.They too posted about the same issue on their official Twitter handle.“A video has been circulated in the network, which claims that the transfer of tanks to the Finnish borders is visible. The claim in the video is not true. The transfer of equipment is related to the Army’s mechanized Arrow 22 exercise. The internship takes place in Niinisalo and Säkylä.” Reads the caption.Verkossa on kiertänyt video, jossa väitetään näkyvän panssarivaunujen siirtoa Suomen rajoille. Videon väite ei pidä paikkaansa. Kaluston siirto liittyy Maavoimien mekanisoituun Arrow 22 -harjoitukseen. Harjoittelu tapahtuu Niinisalossa ja Säkylässä. https://t.co/brtoTRj39R — Puolustusvoimat (@Puolustusvoimat) May 4, 2022Conclusion:the video is getting viral with misleading claim.Claim Review: Finland transporting military equipment on the eastern border with Russia.Claimed by: social media users.Fact check: misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did police thrashed out Muslims who were asking for a separate country in Assam? A video is getting viral on the internet in which police are chasing and beating people. Social media users are claiming that the video is from Assam where Muslims are asking for a separate country and police are arresting these defaulters. Further, a user named @DRajlaxmisaini shared the video with the caption, “Muslims took out a procession in Assam to create a separate country, then see their condition. Chief Minister of Assam is two steps ahead of Yogi.”Similarly, many users have shared this video on their handles.Fact CheckFor our investigation we took help of the InVID tool and google image. After reverse image search we found the same video on the YouTube channel of News18 India. They uploaded the video on Apr 6, 2020 with the title which can be nearly translated into English, “Mob attacked the police who went to follow the lockdown in Bareilly, UP, IPS officer injured in the attack.”Moreover, we also found the same video on the YouTube channel of Bareilly Ki awaaz. with the title, “Attack on police who went to follow lock down, 8 custodial cases registered, one IPS injured.” Hence, this is and old video.Also Read: List Of Fabricated stories of Sudhir Chaudhary and Zee News.ConclusionTherefore, it is clear that social media users are sharing a old video with a misleading caption.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Is Muslim population increasing in India, producing 15-15 children? Population control has been an issue in India. The population of the country has crossed 135 crores. At the same time, Muslims have been targeted in a misleading and wrong way due to the increasing population. Social media users often target the Muslim community of the increasing population. A video is becoming increasingly viral on social media. In this video a female reporter is interviewing a man, this man has 15 children. Social media users are targeting the Muslim Population by sharing this video.A user named Mukesh Sharma wrote- ” Masha Allah. In a few years, forget about your job, there will be no place to set foot in the country.Similarly, Mohit Chandila Gurjar wrote – “ Forget job, in a few years there will be no place to set foot in the country . PMO India should implement a population control law.Fact Check:On reverse image search of some frames of the video going viral, we found a link to a video uploaded on YouTube. A channel named ‘ Leader TV HD ‘ uploaded the video on 11th April 2022. The caption of this video is ” How do slum dwellers live ?”To know more about this YouTube channel we clicked on the ‘About Us ‘ then we found that it is not India’s but Pakistan’s YouTube channel. As its location showed Pakistan.At the same time, all the reporting and coverage of this channel is done in Urdu language as well as it is done in different cities of Pakistan.Conclusion:Our investigation has revealed that the viral video is not from India but from Pakistan and this video has nothing to do with the population of India.Claim- Population of Muslims is increasing in India, producing 15-15 childrenClaimed by- Social Media usersFact Check – Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Was there a picture of Nehru on the wall during PM Modi and Chancellor Schultz’s meeting? The picture of the meeting between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and German Chancellor Olaf Schultz on May 3, 2022 is going viral on social media sites, in which India’s first Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru is seen in the background. Users are sharing the picture with the caption ‘Look back’.Dr Manmohan Singh – A Facebook user named Fan Club PM Modi with the caption ‘peechhe dekho…Nehru trying to prevent Modi from working in Germany.” And shared a photo of Chancellor Schultz’s meeting, in which Nehru is seen in the background.”Himachal Pradesh Guide Forum wrote ‘Nowadays in our country only the devotees of Modi ji speak about Nehru ji, but why are the pictures of Nehru installed abroad?’ while writing the same picture on 04 May 2022 at around 04 pm has posted. (Translates Hindi)Fact Check:On searching the internet, we found that many pictures of PM Modi and Chancellor Schultz’s meeting in Germany’s capital Berlin have been shared from the verified account of PM Narendra Modi on 03 May 2022 and none of these pictures are such that whose background I have Nehru’s photo.On the other hand, the official Twitter handle of PMO India has shared a picture in English by writing ‘Increasing Indo-German cooperation, meeting between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and German Chancellor Olaf Schultz in Berlin.It should be noted that this is the same picture in which the picture of Nehru is being shown on the wall in a misleading way.Conclusion:This fact check proves that the claims being made by social media users are false and misleading.Claim Review- Nehru’s photo in the background of the meeting of PM Modi and Chancellor Olaf Schultz in Berlin.Claimed by- Social media usersFact Check- Fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Rahul Gandhi Is getting Trolled Again. Know The Full Story Rahul Gandhi is again targeted by the Internet troll army after his statement on the Coal crisis. Rahul said the Narendra Modi-led Centre should stop running the “bulldozer of hatred” and run power plants instead. “Today, the coal and electricity crisis has created havoc in the entire country.”Saying it again he said, “I am saying again — This crisis will destroy small industries, due to which unemployment will increase further. Small children cannot stand this scorching heat. The lives of patients admitted to hospitals are at stake. There will be financial loss by stopping rail and metro services.”A Facebook page named Modi Once More shared a post that reads, “India’s coal production has increased in recent times. Factories are getting regular power supply. Yet Rahul Gandhi says India is facing coal crisis. In a desperate attempt to attack Coal Minister Pralhad Joshi, Rahul Gandhi is making fun of himself.”Similarly, many other users have shared this post.Rahul is getting trolled over the internet for his remark over the coal crisis. Union minister Prahalad Joshi called Rahul a fake astrologer.Fact CheckIn our fact check analysis, we checked the actual coal production and the supply of coal. We found a recent tweet of Union Minister of Parliamentary Affairs, Coal and Mines, Prahlad Joshi in which he wrote, “@CoalIndiaHQ is mushrooming Nation’s energy security, inscribing a noteworthy rise in April’22. Coal production was 45.29 MT in 2019 and it increased to 53.47 MT in April’22, a 6% increase.”Further, according to the repots published official site of national power portal, there is increase in the production of the coal but different thermal stations across the country faced coal shortage.Moreover, Indian Railways cancels 657 reports to ensure coal transport. Financial Express on 27th April released a report on “Coal stocks reach ‘critical’ levels in 11 of 13 thermal power plants in UP.”According to a report of The Hindu, Prahalad Joshi said not to panic for the coal shortage.ConclusionSince, the coal production has increased but still coal crisis is faced in different part of the country. Hence, the viral claim is misleading. It doesn’t take into account the full story.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Reality behind the viral picture of Masjid in Nanital. A picture of masjid is getting viral on the internet. It is claimed that the viral; masjid picture is from the Nanital. People all over the internet are sharing the image with aggression about the loudspeakers in the masjid and how it awakes the people of the valley at 4 a.m., how it is difficult for the people in the hospital to take rest and how nearly 30 years ago this masjid do not even exist.Many Facebook users shared the image with quite similar captions like,“This Masjid is located in Devbhoomi in Nainital…About 20-25 years ago this mosque did not exist…This fort-palatial mosque is situated right in front of the world-famous Naini Lake and Naina Devi of centuries ago… 16 big loudspeakers installed in this mosque since 4:30 in the morning don’t believe without waking you up…as this lake is surrounded by city from all sides. Surrounded by mountains, at 4:30 in the morning, the deafening sound of these 16 loudspeakers wreaks havoc on heart patients, BP patients, and patients admitted to nearby hospitals.The special thing is that this mosque is not on the purchased land.The then Congress government gave hundreds of meters of prime land (precious land) to the Muslims as a gift a lot.This mosque has been built…This is the situation everywhere in India…The whole of India has been filled with tombs, mazaars, pir dargah masjid, madrassas.”(Translates Hindi)Fact Check:Through reverse search image, we found this picture as of The Jama Masjid Nainital.It was originally built for Muslim soldiers in the British army as one can see the symmetrical Islamic architecture, the lush decoration, and the minarets from which the call the prayer is sounded.Jama Masjid Nainital, was built in 1882 during the British Era for Muslims around Nainital. Over the main entrance, one can see Arabic inscriptions. It was Beautifully reconstructed from 2004-to 2005.The picture was shared by the Uttrakhand tourism official Instagram account.Conclusion:The Jama masjid of nanital was originally built in 1882 and not 20-25 years back.Claim Review: jama madjid of nanital was built 25 years back.Claimed by: social media users.Fact chaeck: fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did Rahul Gandhi party with the Chinese ambassador of Nepal? Know the truth of the viral image. The news of former Congress President Rahul Gandhi, partying or going abroad on a personal tour, goes viral on social media, the video of Rahul Gandhi partying in a pub with the Chinese Ambassador to Nepal Hou Yanqi. Two videos are going viral, in one he is seen checking his mobile screen while in the other he is seen flirting with a woman who is taking a drink.People are claiming at this is the same ambassador who instigated India’s friendly country Nepal against India.Social media users are also demanding a probe by the National Investigation Agency (NIA) into Rahul Gandhi.‘Sanatan Dharma ki Jai Ho’ tweeted on May 3, 2022, at 10:36 am, tagging NIA, Home Ministry, Prime Minister’s Office, and Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leader Ashwani Upadhyay with a video, “ Rahul Gandhi Standing next to it, this Chinese woman is not a minor figure but China’s ambassador to Nepal, Hou Yanqi. He is the Chinese ambassador who instigated Nepal against India. There is an appeal to the central government to conduct an NI investigation of Rahul Gandhi.”On the other hand, on Facebook, a user named Sujit Paswan posted the video with the hashtag #congresiculture #RahulGandhi #RahulGandhiAtRaveParty #RahulGandh and wrote, “Rahul Gandhi partying with Chinese Ambassador Hou Yankee at a pub in Nepal. A few days ago Hou Yankee is accused of honey trapping Nepalese politicians including the PM of Nepal.Fact Check:On internet search we found that The Kathmandu Post published the news on its website on the evening of 2 May 2022 quoting sources that Rahul Gandhi is his friend, daughter of former Nepalese ambassador to Myanmar Bhim Udas and former CNN journalist Sumanima had gone to Nepal’s capital Kathmandu on a private tour to attend Udas’ wedding.According to The Kathmandu Post, apart from Rahul Gandhi, some other Indian VVIPs were also present for the wedding party.Dainik Bhaskar wrote on May 4 that Congress asked, will the friend’s wedding also have to go after asking BJP?Conclusion:This fact check proves that Congress leader Rahul Gandhi is not partying with the Chinese ambassador to Nepal, but he is attending his friend’s wedding ceremony. The claim being made by social media users by making his video viral is false, baseless and misleading.Claim- Rahul Gandhi is partying with Hou Yanqi, the Ambassador of China to Nepal.Claimed by- Social Media UsersFact Check – Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Was the 300-year-old temple demolished in Jaipur after Alwar? Rajasthan remains a topic of discussion in social media and mainstream media these days. There are many such incidents in the past, which are being discussed all over the country. After Karauli in Rajasthan, there have been reports of violence and confrontation in Jodhpur. At the same time, the controversy about the demolition of a 300-year-old Shiva temple in Rajgarh, Alwar also caught a lot of attention. After which BJP and Congress have become attackers of each other.After these controversies, there has been a flood of fake news on social media. Social media users are sharing a picture claiming that now a 300-year-old temple has been demolished in Jaipur, the capital of Rajasthan. It can be seen in this picture that the temple is being demolished by a JCB. Social media users are blaming the Congress government of Rajasthan for this.A user named Umakant Pandey wrote on Facebook – “It is called Sarkar.Three hundred years old paper was discovered by the Rajasthan government and found that this Shiv temple of Alwar was built by encroaching on the land. It was demolished yesterday. Here some people are not able to find only fifty-sixty years old papers. And they have to go straight to the court.. Well, the government’s turn seems to be from it… the paper will have to be shown.. If three hundred years old paper is found, then how can we not get fifty-sixty years old…”(Translates Hindi)Fact Check:On doing a reverse image search on Google for the picture going viral, we found a piece of news published on the website of ‘Aaj Tak’ This news was published on 14th June 2015 at 6.43 pm. This news has been given the title- “200 years old temple demolished for the expansion of Jaipur Metro”.Conclusion:This fact proves that the claims being made by social media users are false and misleading. Also, two facts are coming out from the news published on ‘Aaj Tak’-First- the Shiv temple was not demolished in the name of land encroachment but was demolished for the metro in Jaipur.Second- In 2015, there was a BJP government under the leadership of Vasundhara Raje, not the Congress government of Ashok Gehlot.Claim- 300 years old Shiva temple was demolished in Jaipur after AlwarClaimant- Social media usersFact Check – Fake
label: rumor

content: Fact Check : If Islamic Studies included in UPSC exam, then why not Vedas, Ramayana and Gita? Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has been constituted for the selection of administrative officers in India. Candidates who pass the UPSC exam are selected for all the administrative posts in the country including IAS, IPS, and IFS. Further, the UPSC exam is famous for being the toughest competitive exam in the world. In stage two of this examination, candidates are given the option to choose the subject of their choice as an optional subject to write the examination. Meanwhile, a claim is going viral on social media about the subjects covered for the UPSC exam. Users are claiming that UPSC has included the subject ‘ Islamic Studies ‘ in their syllabus. Apart from this, users are also asking that if the UPSC exam can be given from the subject of Islamic studies, then why are the subjects of Vedic studies, Ramayana, and Gita studies can not included?Moreover, a page named Sarva Hindu Parishad shared a post on Facebook on April 17. In which they wrote – “ If #Islamic Studies can make IAS”. So the study of Vedas, Ramayana, Geeta, and Upanishad should also be included in the UPSC exam. Why so much hatred for only Sanatan Dharma.. ?? I know for one thing, that no Sanatani will take this matter very seriously, but it is very important for all of you to awaken consciousness in your inner being. There must be someone who will think about this! It is with this intention that I am publishing this post.”Fact Check:Firstly , we did a Google search to investigate the claim going viral on social media . But we could not find any information about the inclusion of Islamic studies in UPSC there. After that we checked the topics available on the UPSC website. In which no separate information was found about the subject of Islamic studies anywhere. Although Urdu literature is definitely a subject.At the same time, IAS Somesh Upadhyay has also denied the news of the inclusion of this Islamic studies on social media. He wrote sarcastically – “ There is a parallel universe , where UPSC offers Islamic studies as an optional subject . It is called WhatsApp Universe . ,Also Read: List Of Fabricated stories of Sudhir Chaudhary and Zee News.Conclusion:This fact check proves that the claims of social media users are false and misleading. This has nothing to do with the truth, as the subject of Islamic Studies is not included as an optional in UPSC exam .Claim- Islamic Studies subject included in UPSC examClaimant- Social media usersFact Check – False and Deceptive
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Another False Claim About Elon Musk Got Viral. Ever since Elon Musk acquired Twitter, he is in the limelight. Meanwhile, a piece of news about him is surfacing on the social media house. The news claims that Elon Musk is going to shut shown Twitter and his next target is FB. Further, Facebook user Just Joel’s shared a screengrab of a tweet from him in which he wrote, “ Now that I bought Twitter, I’m deleting it. FB is next. Go outside and enjoy your life.”Similarly, many social media users have shared this screengrab all over the World.Fact CheckIn our fact check analysis, we first scroll through the official Twitter account of the new Twitter owner Elon Musk. To our amazement, we found no such news on his official handle.Further, we also checked in the archived, there also we did not found the viral Tweet. Also, there is no such media report of Musk acquiring Twitter. Hence, the tweet is fabricated. And, Mark Zuckerberg is still listed as the CEO and chairman of Meta, the platform’s parent company.ConclusionThe viral screengrab is fake and baseless. There is no reality in the claim that he is going to delete Twitter or going to buy Facebook.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: whole Truth behind the viral video of Zelensky’s desk with cocaine on it. A video of Ukraine’s president Volodymyr Zelensky is circulating throughout social media. In the video,it is shown that Zelensky is in a conference video call with the new owner of twitter Elon Musk.The video is spreading on the internet with the claim that, the white powder on the desk is actually cocaine.The video is shared by many social media users under various captions.https://www.facebook.com/100077903679147/posts/1032842444302215/https://www.facebook.com/100078434028231/posts/1328037957704064/Fact Check:To know the authenticity of the viral video, we reverse searched the video and found the original video on its official Instagram account of Zelensky. In that video no white powder can be actually seen.The video was also featured in the reports by Hindustan Times and The Guardian.Conclusion:The video clip was digitally morphed to include white powder on the desk.Claim Review: the white powder on the desk is actually cocaine.Claimed by: Social media users.Fact Check: fake.

content: Fact Check: Old Image Syrian Children Got Viral Misleadingly. An image of a young boy holding a baby in his arms is going viral on social media sites. Further, users are sharing the picture with the caption, “WE STAND FOR PALESTINE”.Similarly, many users are sharing the same picture.Fact CheckOn reverse image search we found the same picture on nbcnews. Further, the caption of the picture is, “A boy holds his sister who was saved from under rubble on Feb.14, 2014.”The title of the news was war on Children. The report was published on 2016. Moreover, the report was about Syrian war not Palestine.Hence, users are sharing an old image of Syrian Kids with misleading claim.

content: Fact Check: Are People Offering Namaz outside Bandra Station On The Eve Of Eid? An image of people offering Nawaz is going viral on the internet. Image available in public domain. But, people are sharing it in a misleading way.

content: Fact Check: Did Bhagwant Mann say he is unaware of who is running the government? A clip of Punjab’s CM Bhagwant Mann is getting viral on social media. The video claims that he has openly confessed that he is unaware of who is running the government.In a Thirteen-second long video, Bhagwant Mann gave a speech in Punjab that translates,“I don’t know what was done to make whom happy. But the thing that is not understandable is who is actually running the government! The scenario of the government is like a bus without a driver which can crash into any pit at any moment.”People all over the internet are sharing his video sarcastically.One person states, “Here, the change he has gone mad.”Fact Check:We reverse searched the video and found that the video is from the year 2017 when Congress was running the government. And he said it to attack the ruling party. The video plays at 13 minutes 07 seconds. He was questioned by a reporter to whose response he stated, “Please let me know (who is running the government) if you come to know. Nobody has any clue who’s actually running the government.” After the driverless bus jibe, he again takes a dig at Congress by saying, “Congress has lost all hopes as they know that they aren’t winning.”Conclusion:The video was the clipped part of the whole video, also it us from the year 2017.Claim Review: Bhagwant Mann say he is unaware of who is running the government.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: Misleading.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: The Reality Of The Video In Which Bike Riders In Saffron Are Hailing Swords. A video is getting viral on social media platforms. content: Fact check: Has Twitter restored the Twitter account of Donald Trump? Elon Musk has taken ownership of Twitter for $44 billion with a share price valued at $54.6 billion. After the massive takeover, Elon has evolved around a lot of controversies after his tweets over buying coco-cola and many more. The US Entrepreneur also made a statement, “Donald Trump’s Truth Social app exists because Twitter censored free speech.” Meanwhile, a claim is getting viral on social media that Musk has restored the Twitter account of US Former President Donald Trump.Western Chauvinist Memes Limited Edition posted a picture of the tweet made by Donald J. Trump, “It’s good to be back, Thanks Elon!”The picture has been circulated on social media platforms.Fact check:After cross-checking, we found that still, the Twitter account of Former President Trump has kept suspended. No such news has come around on the internet about it.Even though we have also checked on Twitter, no such verified account of Donald Trump has been found.Therefore, the claim is fake and the viral picture is photoshopped.Claim review: Twitter restored the Twitter account of Donald TrumpClaim by: Western Chauvinist Memes Limited EditionFact check: fake

content: Fact Check: Using Mind Control Weapons Were Iraqi Soldiers Forced to Surrender in the Gulf War? A video clip of a physics professor is going viral on social media. In which he is claiming that brain control weapons were successfully used to force Iraqi soldiers to surrender during the Gulf War.https://www.facebook.com/bishofans/posts/382688313726243/In the video a man can be heard saying that “there are four different techniques and technologies that can make a voice sound in a person’s head. And once you do that you can do that using neurolinguistic programming techniques.” can control them.The man seen in the video has been identified as Robert Duncan. who holds a Ph.D. Along with being Professor of Physics. Also appointed to Texas Tech University’s Department of Epidemiology and Public Health.”Fact Check:To investigate the viral video, we first inquired about Dr. Robert Duncan. We learned from the information provided on the Texas Tech University website that the man in the viral video is not Dr. Robert Duncan. Because Robert V. Duncan is a Professor of Physics at Texas Tech University, as well as Distinguished Chair of the Department of Physics and Astronomy.During an investigation into the video, we found that Dr. Robert Duncan, in an email to AAP FactCheck , told AAP FactCheck that “this ‘Dr. Robert Duncan’ is definitely not me. I have never and never been involved in research like this before.” I’ll do such research sometime.”At the same time, experts in the Gulf War have also denied the use of mind control weapons. On the use of mind control weapons in the Gulf War, Dr. Lawrence Potter, Professor of International and Public Affairs at Columbia University, said that “I am familiar with the events of the Gulf War (1990–91) but I have never heard of it. Although I am not familiar with all the weapons in the arsenal, this claim seems to me fictional.”Conclusion:Hence the claim made in the viral video is fake. Because experts have confirmed that at present there is no such weapon which can control the mind.Claim Review : Iraqi soldiers forced to surrender due to use of mind control weapons in Gulf WarClaimed by: DJ BishoFact Check: Fake
label: rumor

content: Fact check: Did a sign of OM hang on the walls of a Mosque? The month of Ramadan is going on. People of the Muslim community fast for the entire day and break it in the evening which is known as Iftar for a month. During the iftar, all the family members or crew members sit together and eat. Meanwhile, people often share the picture of Iftar, and likewise, a picture of army men having Iftari is getting viral on social media.Md Shadab Alam posted the viral pictures where army men of different religions are sitting in the hall during the iftar. In the caption, he raised a question of why the sign of OM which is a sacred spiritual symbol of Hinduism is hung on the wall of the mosque.Another user posted the same pictures with the repeated caption and also made a statement that Muslims of Ganga Jamuni Tahjeeb are making other people of the community do Kufr and Shirk.मस्जिद में ॐ का पोस्टर क्यों?गंगा-जुम्मनी तहज़ीब व हिंदू-मुस्लिम भाईचारा के नाम पर मुसलमानों से कुफ्फार अपनी शर्तों पर इस्लाम के विरुद्ध मुसलमानों से कुफ्र व शिर्क करवा रहा है,और तो और जुम्मनी तहज़ीब वाले "मुसलमान" ऐसे शिर्क व कुफ्र को खुशी खुशी एक्सेप्ट भी कर रहे हैं! pic.twitter.com/SZS0sN4rPh — Aƚιϝ Aʂʅαɱ✨ (@mr_atif45) April 29, 2022Fact checkAfter doing a Google image search, we found the viral picture in a tweet on Irfan Quraishi on Twitter. He claimed senior citizens at old air rifle hoisted an Iftar Party for the army men.#Army meets senior citizens at Old Air Field in #Srinagar. Hosts Iftar Party. @ChinarcorpsIA Commander Lt General DP Pandey also attended Nimaz (Prayers offered by Muslims). pic.twitter.com/q7yR7phiqY — Irfan Quraishi 🌙 (@irfanquraishi85) April 25, 2022PRO Defence Srinagar also posted the pictures from the iftari party hoisted for the army men. Therefore the claim is misleading as the Iftar was conducted in the hall and not in the mosque. Moreover, it was all done for maintaining peace and harmony among the people.Conclusion: The claim is misleadingClaim review: a sign of OM was found hung on the walls of a Mosque.Claim by: Md Shadab AlamFact check: misleading
label: truth

content: फैक्ट चेक: क्या मस्जिद की दीवार पर का ओम का पोस्टर लगा हुआ था? रमजान का महीना चल रहा है। मुस्लिम समुदाय के लोग पूरे दिन उपवास रखते हैं और शाम को इसे तोड़ते हैं। जिसे इफ्तार के नाम से जाना जाता है। इफ्तार के दौरान परिवार के सभी सदस्य या क्रू मेंबर एक साथ बैठकर खाना खाते हैं। इस बीच लोग अक्सर इफ्तार की तस्वीर शेयर भी करते है। इसी तरह सोशल मीडिया पर सेना के जवानों की इफ्तारी की तस्वीर वायरल हो रही है।मोहम्मद शाहदाब आलम ने वायरल तस्वीरें पोस्ट कीं जिसमें विभिन्न धर्मों के सेना के जवान इफ्तार के दौरान हॉल में बैठे हैं। कैप्शन में उन्होंने सवाल उठाया कि ओम का चिन्ह जो हिंदू धर्म का एक पवित्र आध्यात्मिक प्रतीक है, मस्जिद की दीवार पर क्यों लगा हुआ है।एक अन्य यूजर ने मिलते-जुलते कैप्शन के साथ वही तस्वीरें पोस्ट कीं और कहा कि गंगा जमुनी तहजीब के लिए मुसलमान अन्य समुदाय लोगों के साथ कुफ्र और शिर्क कर रहे हैं।गूगल इमेज सर्च करने के बाद, हमें ट्विटर पर इरफान कुरैशी के एक ट्वीट में वायरल तस्वीर मिली। उन्होंने दावा किया कि ओल्ड एयर राइफल में वरिष्ठ नागरिकों ने सेना के जवानों के लिए इफ्तार पार्टी दी।#Army meets senior citizens at Old Air Field in #Srinagar . Hosts Iftar Party. @ChinarcorpsIA Commander Lt General DP Pandey also attended Nimaz (Prayers offered by Muslims). pic.twitter.com/q7yR7phiqYपीआरओ डिफेंस श्रीनगर ने भी सेना के जवानों के लिए दी गई इफ्तारी पार्टी की तस्वीरें भी पोस्ट कीं।अत: ये दावा भ्रामक है क्योंकि इफ्तार मस्जिद में नहीं हॉल में आयोजित की गई थी। इसके अलावा, यह सब लोगों के बीच शांति और सद्भाव बनाए रखने के लिए किया गया था।Keeping high the #ethos #IndianArmy at the forefront of interfaith #CommunalHarmony. Prayers for #Peace and harmony in the #Valley #IndianArmyPeoplesArmy @adgpi @ChinarcorpsIA @NorthernComd_IA @SpokespersonMoD #Kashmir pic.twitter.com/GhLAv3Wa2g— PRO Defence Srinagar (@PRODefSrinagar) April 27, 2022
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did the Twitter account of Bill Gates gets suspended? After Elon Musk took over Twitter. content: Fact Check: The video of the murder of a Palestinian youth going viral was taken from a short film. A video clip is going massively viral on social media. The video clip is claimed to be a fake murder by Palestinians using actors to make it appear real. Which they will use to incite violence.A user shared this video clip and wrote that Pallywood is at its best. Palestinians are making scenes in which a child is shot by Israeli soldiers. I wish they had spent all these resources promoting peace rather than propaganda. – Hannay NaftaliAnother wrote, “Actors masquerading as Jews and @IDF killed Palestinians.” These fake images will be used to incite violence and misery.Fact Check:https://twitter.com/WarCrimeReportZ/status/1514065165519663106?s=20&t=E4AxSpNkpGTnKoyKJU75_gOn checking the viral video clip, we found that the clip does not depict Palestinians committing fake murders. Rather, it is the scene of a short film called “Empty Place” directed by Avni Ashtaiwe, which tells the story of Palestinian prisoner Ahmed Mascara. Ahmed Mansara was arrested in 2015 at the age of 13 after being hit by an Israeli police car.The viral video clip showed the shooting of the scene where Mansara got an arrest. The actor who plays Mansara is lying on the floor covered in blood all around him. As well as playing the role of the citizen of Israel and insulting the settlers around the actor.“We don’t know where they got the pictures from the shoot,” filmmaker Farah Theiler told The New Arabian about the video clip.“We immediately published the original clip of the shooting of the film with an explanation,” he said. He added further, “We were very surprised because the film had already gone viral and it was a no secret.”Let us tell you that Mansara was sentenced to 12 years in Jerusalem in 2016 for helping his cousin to stab an Israeli. His cousin was killed during the incident, while Mansara, who did not participate in the attack, was crushed by an Israeli police car and mobbed by Israeli settlers before being taken into custody by Israeli security forces had killed him. His sentence was later reduced to nine years.Hence the viral video clip is shared with a misleading claim.Claim review: The video of the murder of a Palestinian youth going viral was taken from a short film.Claim by: Susy HebnerFact check: Misleading
label: rumor

content: फैक्ट चेक: क्या सीटीवी न्यूज ने कहा- “फ्रीडम कॉन्वॉय” को कॉन्सपिरेसी थ्योरी ने हवा दी? Have any recent heavy rainfall and hailstones damaged roads and cars in Dehradun? Read the Fact-Check.

content: Fact Check: Truth behind the fight between people in the mosque during Ramzan. In the month of Ramzan, a video is getting viral on the internet. Also, the video is from the year 2019.We got the same news covered by a newspaper Morocco News World.The same was twitted by a user back then criticizing people those were indulged in fight.“For revival, no shyness, no respect for the mosque, and no appreciation for the holy month such people should be held accountable Allah is my suffice, and the best deputy.” Reads the Caption.#عند_مسجد_الغمامة_يوم_بعد_يوملإحياء ولا استحياء ولا احترام للمسجد ولا تقدير للشهر الفضيلامثال هؤلاء يجب محاسبتهمحسبي الله ونعم الوكيل pic.twitter.com/bwQwy8xNWQ — المؤرخ احمد امين مرشد (@murshid555) May 15, 2019Conclusion:The video is old and not from India.Claim Review: fight between people in the mosque during the month of Ramadan.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: fake.

content: Fact check: Did Marine Le Pen secure more votes than Emmanuel Macron during the second round of France’s election in 2022? After the election in France and Emmanuel Macron won the President’s seat by defeating Marine Le Pen. There have been many controversies revolving around them on social media.
