Meanwhile, a claim is going viral on social media about the result of the elections.David Kurten a verified account on Twitter, shared a small clip regarding the number of votes gained by the candidates. He raised a question of how Marine Le Pen who was in the lead during the counting went down by a decent margin.How is it possible that the number of votes counted for Marine le Pen went down from 14.4m during the live count to 13.3m at the declaration? https://t.co/UBmOR5A8sZ — David Kurten (@davidkurten) April 25, 2022Many other users also shared a snapshot of the live streaming of the election and claimed that initially Marine Le Pen was in lead but at the last minute Emmanuel won.https://twitter.com/Analemme84/status/1518440045061025792?s=20&t=eF9ZP6_HCP0oKwxpZvFU6AOk, this is ODD👇🏻How can Marine Le Pen end up with LESS votes in the final result than she had while voting was still going on??! pic.twitter.com/ucEnCmHnjj — Nat (@Arwenstar) April 25, 2022Macron was behind 217,571 votes. He won 30 minutes later. Am I the only one that have seen this movie before? pic.twitter.com/2zSY7aZ8Gq — Ole T-S (@Ole_TS_) April 25, 2022In short, users are sharing the count where at the last minute of the voting during elections, Marine Le Pen has secured more votes than the current president MacronFact checkAfter cross-checking, we found a tweet from Info France 2, which is a French public national television channel. The channel apologized for the computer error which lead to the error in numbers during the live streaming of the election 2022.Erratum : une erreur informatique nous a amenés à afficher des chiffres erronés lors de la soirée électorale de France 2, dimanche 24 avril. Nous prions nos téléspectateurs de nous en excuser. Voici quelques explications ⤵️ — Info France 2 (@infofrance2) April 25, 2022Therefore, the claim is misleading as it all took place due to an error on the computer screen.Conclusion: the claim is misleadingClaim review: Marine Le Pen secure more votes than Emmanuel Macron during the second round of France’s election in 2022Claim by: David KurtenFact check: Misleading

content: Fact check: Have Two boys sung the title song of Ramayana on the stage of Britain’s Got Talent? A video is going viral from the stage of an American show as per the users, wherein two boys were singing the title song of serial Ramayana and got a standing ovation from the audience during the performance.Hardik tweeted the viral video and also mentioned in the caption how tears were in the eyes of an audience.https://twitter.com/KyaSeKyaHoGya/status/1518620165394472961?s=20&t=cJwF9cJuB-VZ6uJrBQVq7QIndian idol जैसाअमेरिकन show में अमेरिकन बच्चो ने रामायण सीरियल का टाइटल song गाया और सब की आँखों ने अश्रुधारा आने लगी ….. pic.twitter.com/6kZkpV9L5q — Mamta Mishra (मोदी का परिवार) राष्ट्रहित सर्वोपरि (@Mamta0Mishra) April 16, 2022The video is massively going viral on social media platforms.Fact checkAfter cross-checking the claim, we found the original video of the viral performance. Under the “5, UNFORGETTABLE & AMAZING Britain’s Got Talent Auditions You MUST WATCH!” the video was posted in the year 2021. The boys sang an English song in the original video and not the song of Ramayana. Therefore the video is fake as it is edited with a different song. The claim is misleading as the performance is from Britain’s Got Talent and not from an American show.Here is the song of Ramayana which is used in the viral video.Conclusion: Hence proves that the claim is misleading.Claim review: two boys have sung the title song of Ramayana on the stage of Britain’s Got TalentClaim by: HardikFact check: Fake

content: Fact Check: Are Bangladeshi Muslims Demanding A Separate Country In Assam? A video of a procession is getting viral on the internet. Sharing the video people are claiming that the video of a protest in Assam where Muslims from Bangladesh are demanding a separate country. Further, sharing the image @SudhirKumarSuri wrote the caption which nearly translates into English, “Bangladeshi Muslims take out a procession in Assam to create a separate country and see their condition.”आसाम में बांग्लादेशी मुसलमानों ने अलग देश बनाने के लिए जुलूस निकाला और उनका हाल देखिए🤣🤣👇🏻👇🏻 pic.twitter.com/9LMn2ela7x — sudhir kumar suri (@SudhirKumarSuri) April 24, 2022Similarly, many other users have shared the same picture with many mocking comments.Fact CheckOn reverse image search of some screenshots taken from the video, we found the same video on the Twitter handle of @Sourabh3507. He uploaded this video on June 9, 2021, with the caption, “Hindu Hriday Samrat Hemant Biswa Sarma, the Chief Minister of Assam, the most respected Assam Chief Minister, reprimanded the Bangladeshi’s health. why??? Watch the video to know.”https://twitter.com/Sourabh3507/status/1402598280198983680After that, our team found that this video was being circulated since 2017. Moreover, we found a report of newsclick in which the same picture was used with the heading , ” Muslim Youth Killed in Police Firing in Assam’s Goalpara.”Both the picture are of the same incidence. Therefore, the claim regarding the video is fake. The video is people protesting in Goalpara, Assam against the ‘doubtful citizens and voters’ tag imposed by the government. And, a Muslim Youth was killed in alleged police firing during the protest.ConclusionHence, it is clear that users are spreading an old video with a false claim.

content: Fact Check The Reality Of The Image Claiming 25 Students Of Allahabad University Got Arrested For Making Bomb. An image is getting viral on the internet with the claims that Police arrested 25 people in Allahabad university who were making bombs. It is written in the image that Allahabad University has become the new center of terrorists. Twenty-five students were caught while making the bomb. And, fifty-eight rooms were sealed. But, the media is silent as no one among them is Muslim.Fact CheckOn reverse image search we found this image on a report of mandsaursandeshnewspaper. In the report, it was stated that police have arrested 15 men and 8 women for running a sex racket.Moreover, on keyword research, we found several media reports of 2019 where an incident of Police raiding the hostel of Allahabad University was reported. And, raw materials for making a bomb and crude bombs were also found.ConclusionThe information given in the viral picture is old and the image used is not related to the incidence.

content: Fact Check: Did the Statue of Lord Nandi was found in the excavation of the mosque? Social media is an ocean of misinformation. In this viral picture, it can be seen that a white building, which is being told as a mosque or a tomb, has an idol of Nandi at the carved site.One user wrote while posting – “This is the truth of every Mazar Masjid.” With the same claim, this tweet has been shared by many users on Twitter.Fact Check:After doing the fact-check of the picture going viral, we found a post shared from the Twitter page of Logical Indian. According to this post, the idol of Lord Nandi has nothing to do with the mosque or the tomb.The post reads- “The viral claim is false. The idol was recently found during excavations around the Selandiamman temple in Tamil Nadu. It has nothing to do with Muslim shrines or mosques.”The viral claim is false. The idol was recently discovered during the excavation around the Selandiamman Temple in Tamil Nadu. It has nothing to do with a Muslim shrine or a mosque.#factcheck #idol #tamilnadu #nandi #mandir #mosque pic.twitter.com/Thlc4K99DP — The Logical Indian (@LogicalIndians) September 10, 2021Conclusion:This fact check proves that the claim by social media users of finding an idol of Lord Nandi in the excavation of a mosque or a tomb is false and misleading. An idol of Nandi has been found in the excavations of a temple.Claim review: the Statue of Lord Nandi was found in the excavation of the mosqueClaim by: #भगवा#मारवाडी#प्रशासक_समिति(पवन)Fact check: Misleading

content: Fact Check: AAP MLA Atishi made a misleading claim about Kerala! Aam Aadmi Party leader Atishi is going viral on social media . Atishi is being trolled fiercely for his tweet. They were keen to understand and implement our education model in their state. This is @ArvindKejriwal Govt’s idea of nation building. Development through collaboration.”Fact Check:Atishi’s tweet came under controversy. In fact, soon after Atishi’s tweet, Kerala Education Minister Shivankutty raised questions on Atishi while retweeting her quote. Shinkutty tweeted- “ The Education Department of Kerala has not sent anyone to know about the ‘ Delhi Model ‘ . Along with this , all possible help was also provided to the officers who came from Delhi to study the ‘ Kerala Model ‘ last month. We would like to know which ‘ officers ‘ the AAP MLA has welcomed . ,Kerala’s Dept of Education has not sent anyone to learn about the ‘Delhi Model’. At the same time, all assistance was provided to officials who had visited from Delhi to study the ‘Kerala Model’ last month. We would like to know which ‘officials’ were welcomed by the AAP MLA. https://t.co/Lgh6nM7yL9 — V. Sivankutty (@VSivankuttyCPIM) April 24, 2022As soon as Atishi’s tweet went viral, many users started enjoying the matter. A user named Nanda Kishore wrote- “AAP leaders are giving competition to BJP leaders in spreading false news. Best time to delete this tweet is now.”https://twitter.com/GNandaKishore_/status/1518154166660595712?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw%7Ctwcamp%5Etweetembed%7Ctwterm%5E1518154166660595712%7Ctwgr%5E%7Ctwcon%5Es1_&ref_url=https%3A%2F%2Fdfrac.org%2Fwp-admin%2Fpost.php%3Fpost%3D12524action%3DeditOne user wrote – ” AAP party means shop of lies ”Another user wrote – ” All are lying.”A user named Rahul Upadhyay wrote that ‘ So it means your press release is correct and your tweet is not … as Kerala officials say ?’ At the same time, after these tweets went viral on social media, Atishi made another tweet. Clarifying in this tweet, he wrote – “ Dear Sivankutty ji, It would have been good if you had done a fact check before tweeting on this issue. You might want to have a look at our press release to see what we actually said! https://t.co/TAUo1zcX8N pic.twitter.com/ymV8zHJzsZ — Atishi (@AtishiAAP) April 24, 2022Conclusion:Fact check is proving that the tweet made by Atishi was misleading, as it appears from this tweet that the officials of Kerala had come on an official tour. content: Fact Check: Know the truth behind the pelting of stones by a group of Muslim people. 00Violence broke out in multiple states during Ram Navami and Hanuman Jayanti celebrations, photos and videos of stone-pelting have been shared widely on social media.Meanwhile, many videos and photos are shared on social media where people are pelting stones and provoking communal riots.People are claiming that a group of Muslims was pelting stones at a train after its horn interrupted their prayers.Many people shared the video of stone-pelting under various captions.“They were having trouble offering Namaz due to the sound of the train so throwing stones.”https://twitter.com/BlueEyed_Demn_/status/1517463696410234880?s=20&t=Su5wiTrwfGpxm_6lHnvdeAThe same video was shared on Facebook too.Fact Check:We at DFRAC reverse searched the video to know the truth behind stone pelting by a group of Muslim people.We found the same video covered under many news sites like India Today, ETV Bharat under the caption, “a group of Muslims were pelting stones at a train after its horn interrupted their prayers.”And, “Chennai students pelt stones at train amid scuffle as passengers panic.”The viral video of the stone-pelting shows a clash between two groups of college students that took place in Chennai a few days back.Conclusion:The viral video is not of any communal riots, but was a clash between two groups of collage students.Claim Review: people are pelting stones and provoking communal riots.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Woman drug inspector murdered after AAP government was formed in Punjab? After the formation of the Aam Aadmi Party government in Punjab, there has been a flood of misleading claims on social media. Some people support by taking the help of fake news, while many criticize Bhagwant Mann’s government for sharing misleading news. These days, the news is being posted on social media to criticize Bhagwant Mann Sarkar.According to the news going viral, after the formation of the government of Bhagwant Mann, the drug business is flourishing again in Punjab. The accused of the drug trade killed the female drug inspector Dr. Neha Suri. It is also being claimed in the post that Nera Suri was continuously taking action against the drug mafia and drug dealers.A user named Amit Tripathi (@amit4471) on Twitter wrote- “This is Mr. Kejriwal and his successor Mann Ka Udta Punjab Hai is Dr Neha Suri, who was posted as Drug Inspector in Punjab. Just a few months back, they raided some pharmacy outlets and got their licenses canceled for selling banned drugs.”ये Mr. केजरीवाल और उनके पिछलगु मान का उड़ता पंजाब है, ये है डॉ नेहा सूरी, जो पंजाब में ड्रग इंस्पेक्टर के पोस्ट पर तैनात थीं। कुछ हीं महीने पहले इन्होंने कुछ फार्मेसी आउटलेट्स पर छापा मारा था और प्रतिबंधित नशीली दवाओं की बिक्री के लिए उनके लाइसेंस रद्द कर दिए थे। कल, एक ड्रग pic.twitter.com/pnrNTYOzDP — अमित त्रिपाठी (@amit4471) April 15, 2022https://twitter.com/Modified_Hindu8/status/1513802963625857028Fact Check:DFRAC investigated the viral claim. Searching ‘Neha Suri’ on Google found a link to a news of Navbharat Times published on 30 March 2019. On opening this news, it came to know that Neha Suri was murdered three years ago.According to the news of Navbharat Times- “The murder of drugs officer Neha Shourie in Kharar, Punjab has shocked everyone. Due to a 10-year-old enmity, a man killed Neha Shourie, a woman officer posted on the post of Zonal Licensing Authority. Neha had canceled the license of the drug shop of the accused during his tenure as Drug Inspector in the year 2009, after which he started enmity with Neha.In the investigation of DFRAC, the claims being made by social media users were found to be misleading. Neha Suri was murdered 3 years ago. Which is now going viral.Claim- Drug Inspector Neha Suri was murdered after AAP formed the government in PunjabClaimant- Social media usersFact Check – Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Are Children Given Training To Use Guns In Madrassas? Social media is a web of misleading and fake information. The veracity and validity of the information disseminated here is questionable. This is also because many information is misleading, factless, and fake. Some people use this information to spread propaganda and lies, either in favor or against a particular person, sect, caste, political party, ideology, or religion. A video is going viral on social media. In this viral video, a man is training a child to use a gun. Social media users are claiming that students are being trained to use weapons in madrassas in India.Supporter Vijay Gupta’s Facebook account wrote – ” Students in madrassa while pursuing higher education.Moreover, we can see the hatred clearly in the comments of this post. Some people are talking about closing down mosques and madrasas without knowing the truth, while some people are talking to the Hindu community to train their children to use guns and weapons.Fact Check:To check the reality of this viral claim, we reverse-searched some of the frames of the video.Then, we found a link to the video on the website of “ Al-Jazeera ” . This is a documentary titled as ” ISIL and the Taliban ” , which was posted on 1 November 2015. The documentary shows about the Islamic State ( ISIS) giving weapons training to young children.In this video at 45 minutes 40 seconds, we can see the part that was viral.Conclusion:Hence, investigation of DFRAC has revealed that this viral video is not from India. But, it is from a documentary by Al-Jazeera, which was based on the IS training in Afghanistan. Therefore, the claim of social media users is misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Putin nationalizes bank to end Rothschilds control Amidst the invasion of Ukraine, a big claim has been made quoting Russian President Vladimir Putin. In which it is said that Putin has nationalized Russia’s central bank to end the control of the Rothschilds.A Facebook post said that “Vladimir Putin, he ended Rothschild’s (sic) control over Russia by nationalizing the Russian centralized bank.” “They banned GMO’S and created a currency to compete against the dollar.”This post has been shared more than 39,000 times so far.Fact CheckUpon investigation of the above claim, we learned that the Russian bank had been nationalized long before Putin’s first term. Indeed, Russia’s central bank was established by the former Russian Emperor Alexander II in 1860, originally named “State Bank”. After the dissolution of the Soviet Union in 1992, it was renamed “Bank of Russia”.At the same time, financial advisory Rothschild & Company has an office in Moscow for nearly a decade. The Rothschilds, however, had nothing to do with the origin of the bank. Also former Deputy Prime Minister Arkady Dvorkovich first announced the Russian government’s plan to ban GMO at an international biotechnology conference in 2015. Which Putin approved in 2016. Also, there is no evidence that Putin has created a new currency in Russia.ConclusionTherefore, Putin’s claim of nationalizing the central bank and creating a new Russian currency to end Rothschilds’ control is false.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Did Veerabhadreshwara Temple Remains Unearthed in Minar Masjid in Raichur, Karnataka? A picture is becoming massively viral on social media. In which a mosque can be seen with the rubble of the collapsed minarets. Referring to the pillars seen in the picture, it was claimed that the remains of the Veerabhadreshwar temple came out of the mosque.A user on Twitter shared the picture and wrote that “Old pillars came to the fore when a tower was demolished to widen the road in Raichur district of Karnataka. The structure and sculpture of the pillars are similar to those of the temple, which gives light to the truth of the ancestors of the people there that this was the original place of the famous Veerabhadreshwar temple at one time.Similar claims were made on Facebook as well.Fact CheckTo check the viral picture, we did a reverse search of the picture. Which showed that this picture is from 2016. In this regard, we got a tweet from Public TV. In which the caption was given by posting this picture that during the widening of the road, a Hindu temple was found in the mosque.On doing a keyword search on Google about this, we found a fact check by Alt News. In which the former District Magistrate posted in Raichur was quoted as saying that the information being shared on social media is wrong. When the demolition took place in Raichur, there were few traditional buildings. A minaret, which is a very old structure, was one of the buildings that was demolished for road widening. Such old structures have a variety of carvings and it cannot be concluded that it was originally a temple made of just one pillar. Some groups tried to make this claim, but when they were opposed, they did not pursue the claim.”Conclusion:Therefore, it is clear that the claim that the remains of the Veerabhadreshwar temple were found when the minaret of the mosque was demolished during the widening of the road in Raichur, Karnataka is misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did an IAS officer insult a female patient? A newspaper cutting is going viral on social media. In this viral cutting, it can be seen that a woman is sitting with a child on the hospital bed. At the same time, a person is standing with his feet on that bed.Users sharing the cutting of the newspaper are claiming that this picture is from Chhattisgarh, where a trainee IAS officer is insulting a female patient by stepping on her bed. Users sharing the post are demanding action against the officer by tagging the newspaper cuttings to CM Bhupesh Baghel.A Twitter user wrote- “Like where the river is, like where it is filled. Just as the Father went and looked at him like that. Being an IAS is not a guarantee that sanskars will also come. Respected @bhupeshbaghel ji please take note of @INCChhattisgarh”Fact CheckTo check the newspaper cutting going viral, we looked at the comment box of most Twitter posts. Many users wrote that this incident is old and action was taken against the accused IAS officer on this matter.After this we searched on Google about this incident. We found a news report dated 10 May 2016 from Deccan Chronicle website. According to this news, Dr. Jagdish Sonkar is a doctor by profession and has become an IAS officer after passing the UPSC exam. During the inspection of the hospital, he had set foot on the bed of a female patient.There was a lot of controversy on social media after the picture of this incident went viral. After which Dr. Sonkar had apologized by writing a Facebook post seeing the controversy growing. He wrote that I did not do this intentionally. It was not his intention to insult or hurt anyone.ConclusionAfter fact-checking the newspaper cuttings, it becomes clear that the claims of social media users are fake.Claim- IAS officer insulted female patientClaimed by- Social media usersFact Check – Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar talk about merging of Sri Lanka with India? Recently, India has sent another consignment of 40,000 tonnes of diesel under a line of credit to the financially troubled Sri Lanka. So that he can deal with the power crisis arising in the country.Meanwhile, a screenshot of the alleged tweet of India’s External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar is going viral on social media. In which it was claimed that the Indian Foreign Minister has offered to merge Sri Lanka with India.There is an offer!!But I love my Sri Lanka.Without these corrupted politicians, it's an absolute pearl in the Indian ocean.#GoHomeGota2020 #GoHomeRajapakshas pic.twitter.com/X6dJDhqzc2 — Amour street – Ameer nana. (@ValachaniNews) April 21, 2022The viral screenshot read that “If the people of Sri Lanka agree, India is ready to declare that Sri Lanka will become a state of India.” As a result, Indian Gas, Fuel, milk, food, fertilizers and many other essential commodities will be able to solve the problems that the country is facing. In addition, India will also look into all future issues of Sri Lanka.” It added, “India is extending a hand of survival to the people of Sri Lanka.”Fact CheckDuring the investigation of the viral screenshot, we found that no such tweet was made from the Twitter account of Indian External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar. At the same time, no press release was found in the media section of the website of the Ministry of External Affairs. However, we found a tweet from the official handle of the Indian High Commission in Colombo, Sri Lanka.We have seen a morphed image purported to be from the twitter handle of External Affairs Minister @DrSJaishankar. This is completely fake and fabricated. We strongly deny its malicious contents. Such mischievous attempts by desperate parties will never succeed in affecting (1/2) — India in Sri Lanka (@IndiainSL) April 20, 2022Regarding the viral screenshot in the tweet, it was said that “We have seen a distorted image purportedly from the Twitter handle of External Affairs Minister @DrSJaishankar. This is completely fake and fabricated. We strongly deny its malicious content. Such mischievous attempts by desperate parties will never succeed in sabotaging the close, friendly and age-old ties between India and Sri Lanka.”ConclusionTherefore, the claim of Indian External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar offering a proposal to include Sri Lanka in India is fake.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Viral video is not of Sarmat missile launch but of 2018’s Satan 2 A video is becoming very viral on social media. In which a Russian rocket can be seen taking off. It was claimed that Russia tested an intercontinental ballistic missile.The video was shared by the AZ Military News Twitter account saying that “the Ministry of Defense of the Russian Federation successfully launched a stationary intercontinental ballistic missile” Sarmat “from the Plesetsk Cosmodrome.”https://twitter.com/AZmilitary1/status/1516787689311379466This video has been viewed more than 11,000 times.At the same time, other users on Facebook also shared this video with similar claims.Fact CheckOn checking the viral video, we found that this video is from 2018. When Russia tested an intercontinental ballistic missile. The BBC has also shared the video footage related to the missile launch in its report.Russia successfully tested the new RS-28 Sarmat Inter-Continental Ballistic Missile from the Plesetsk cosmodrome. https://t.co/1aFSSa7Hyv pic.twitter.com/ADWbjejHYB — RT (@RT_com) April 20, 2022Russia on Wednesday announced the test of the Sarmat missile, carrying 15 warheads, amid rising tensions with Western countries over the Ukraine issue. Russia’s Defense Ministry says that Sarmat is the most powerful missile in the world with the longest range.ConclusionTherefore, the video going viral is not of the Sarmat missile test conducted on Wednesday, but of the 2018 ballistic missile test.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Picture claiming to be of first iftar party of Independent India got viral A picture of Rosa Iftar is going viral on social media. The picture shows India’s first Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru, the first President Rajendra Prasad, the first Law Minister Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar and the first Education Minister Maulana Abul Kalam Azad, including many other great leaders. It can be seen in this picture that all the veteran leaders are having food at the same table in a big hall.Social media users are claiming that this is a picture of India’s first Iftar party after independence, hosted by Maulana Abul Kalam Azad. Sharing the picture on Twitter, many users wrote – “Independent India’s first Iftar party”https://twitter.com/noushunnou/status/1514513751147429888First iftar party of independent India after independence in 1947 hosted by first education Minister Moulana #AbulKalamAzad pic.twitter.com/poPgOR25bC — Adv Shane illahi turky (@shaneilahi) April 12, 2022First iftar party after independence in 1947 pic.twitter.com/C4POELAOCW — Syed Asgar (@SyedAsg40342647) April 14, 2022Fact CheckAfter a reverse search on Google, this picture, which is going viral on social media, revealed that it is not of the first Iftar party of independent India but of a banquet organized for the cabinet of the Government of India. This banquet was organized to commemorate the appointment of C. Rajagopalachari as Governor General by Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.This picture has been shared on the Facebook page of Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar on 27 August 2020. According to this post, this banquet was organized to commemorate the appointment of C. Rajagopalachari as Governor General.ConclusionThis fact check proves that the viral picture is being shared with the wrong context. Hence the claim being made by social media users is misleading.Claim- The picture of the first Iftar of independent IndiaClaimed by- Social MediaFact Check – Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: A man making electricity from nuke for his house for years. A post is going viral on social media. In this viral post, the person is claiming that he has found a lost nuke and uses it to make electricity for his house since more than 27 long years. The man has been arrested for this crime.With this Facebook post going viral, the cutting of the reputed news channel CNN is engaged. According to this cutting, this man from Florida had found America’s lost atomic bomb. Which this person is making electricity by using it for 27 years.Fact CheckThe cutting of this news going viral is being told of CNN. It is also clear from this cutting that this news has been posted on 12 April 2022 at 11 am. So first we checked on CNN’s website and social media accounts. But on 12 April 2022, no such news or post was seen by CNN.After this we searched the ‘title’ of this news on Google. But we could not find any news matching its title. Although this news was found on some websites, but the news of those websites was published citing viral posts.After this, we investigated these pictures by doing reverse image search on Google. On searching, we found an article from ‘The Guardian’ about the man in the first picture. According to this article, this person is guilty of making racist comments. His name is Todd Warneken. It threatened and thrashed an American black woman during the US presidential elections in 2016.On searching the second picture, we found an article from Germany’s “DW”. According to this article- “Wartime ammunition still rotting in German waters”. In fact, the ammunition that fell into the sea during World War II is still present in German waters.Conclusion: Our investigation revealed that the claims being made by social media users are false and misleading. It has nothing to do with reality.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Is the Islamic party demanding to declare Belgium an Islamic country & follow Sharia law? A news report from Russia Today is getting viral on various social media platforms. The video is claiming that the new Islamic party in Belgium is planning to form an Islamic state.In the video, the anchor talks to the MP of Belgium asking about his views on the entire matter.A tweet reads, “If they win Elections, the Islamic party is demanding to declare Belgium an Islamic country & follow Sharia law. Huge protests have already started.”If they win Elections, Islamic party is demanding to declare Belgium🇧🇪 an Islamic country & follow Sharia law. Huge protests have already started. pic.twitter.com/GJERtWPg7G — Chittukuruvi (NaMo is part of my Family) (@chittukuruvi4) April 18, 2022Fact Check:We at DFRAC reverse searched the image using certain keywords and found that the incident did take place, but not recently. The video is actually a decade old. It is from the year 2012.We find similar videos on many youtube channels.https://youtu.be/D12Yhpq86_IWe also find that many reports on the same issue a report state, “Belgium: Two Newly Elected Muslim Politicians in Brussels Vow to Implement Sharia.”Conclusion:The issue was true, but it happened a decade old.Claim Review: the Islamic party demanding to declare Belgium an Islamic country & follow Sharia law.Claimed by: social media users.Fact check: misleading

content: Fact check: A video of a Muslim man arguing with Police got viral during the Delhi riot. Know the reality Delhi riot has created an atmosphere of terror and breakdown of another communal clash. After the case, much fake and misleading news is posted on social media platforms. A small video is going viral on the internet about the Delhi riot.Santosh Chauhan Sudarshan News posted the viral clip of 30 seconds, where a Muslim man was seen yelling at the police officers. The Muslim man said to take off the uniform and then talk to me to the police officer.Sudarshan News also posted the viral video, quoted the warning given to police officers, and claimed it to be a scenario of the Delhi riot in 2022.Fact checkAfter doing the reverse image search, we found that the video was released in 2018. The user also claimed that it is a sight of Mumbai.Conclusion: the claim is misleading.Claim review: A video of a Muslim man arguing with Police got viral during the Delhi riot.Claim by: Sudarshan NewsFact check: misleading

content: Fake vs Fact under Sri Lanka Crisis Sri Lanka ran out of the foreign reserve and yet, was indebted with the debt of $51 billion. Lankans are protesting against the government inherited by the Rajapaksa family. As per the sources, the Sri Lankan economy got severely damaged, thus people are demanding the resignation of the present President Gotabaya Rajapaksa. Meanwhile, the ministers of the Sri Lanka People’s Front have resigned in support of the movement. Amid the crisis, Rajapaksa appointed 17 new Cabinet Ministers to the party.Sri Lankan protest has been widely discussed on Social Media as astounding art and graphical representations were spotted at the protest site. Furthermore, the scope of fake and misleading news is always high on the wall of social media after the protest occurs.In this report, we are going to highlight the fake and misleading news spread during the crisis.Fake claim 1As per the record, the lack of foreign reserves has caused inflation in the price of fuel, and food medicine. Meanwhile, the news of former finance minister Basil Rajapaksa is getting viral on social media. NewsNow360 has tweeted that Basil Rajapaksa ran away from the island after he was admitted to a hospital in the country.#Breaking:Former Min Basil Rajapaksa has left the island via Rathmalana Airport, in a private jet registered under #America. He was admitted to Lanka Hospital due to #Covid19 as reported by media last evening. #lka #SriLanka #SriLankanCrisis #SriLankaProtests pic.twitter.com/lnJuLTsnoj — NewsNow360 (@NewsNow360) April 16, 2022Fact checkAs per the news, The Morning shared a confirmation about the minister staying in the country. The Chief Manager of the Colombo International Airport has denied the minister’s departure from the country.Cassilingham, Coordinating Secretary of the current Prime Minister has also confirmed the former finance minister’s stay in the county.https://twitter.com/CassilingamG/status/1515241904807444485?s=20&t=wBF_20espjt3U06JNCJLCgConclusion: Therefore the claim is fake. As Basil Rajapaksa didn’t leave the country.Fake Claim 2As we all know that Sri Lanka is facing inflation of 20% in terms of fuel and other amenities. Meanwhile, the news is getting viral on social media, where users are claiming that in the year 2017, an era of good governance was seen. As people were lined up in a queue while refilling petrol.Many other users are also sharing the picture and claiming it is a sight of a petrol pump in Sri Lanka.Fact checkAfter doing the reverse image search, we found that the image is from the year 2012. Reuters posted the viral picture and captioned it as a sight of Ahmedabad, India.Conclusion: Therefore, the claim is misleading as Lankan users were posting a picture of India and claiming it of Sri Lanka.Fake claim 3When protestors flounced into the house of President Gotabaya Rajapaksha, police released tear gases and water tankers on the public to stop them. In the process, a resident got injured. Meanwhile, another news is getting viral of a man who addressed the problem of protestors to the cops in Mirihana.Fact checkAfter cross-checking, we found that Rukshan Bellana, the deputy director of the Colombo South Teaching Hospital claimed that none of the protestors who got admitted was in serious condition.Furthermore, no such news came by over the death of the man.Conclusion: Therefore, the claim is misleading.Fake claim 4After the resignation of former ministers from the party, a rumour is getting viral on the Internet that Anura Kumara was invited by the ruling to become the new Prime Minister of the country.Fact checkAlthough Gotabaya Rajapaksa has asked for help from the opposition party members during the time of this crisis but no such news has been found over the internet about the claim.Conclusion: Therefore, the claim is fake.
label: rumor

content: Fact check: A fake video of the raid on Aditya Thackeray’s place got viral A video is getting viral on social media. The fan page of Sambit Patra, spokesperson for BJP posted a text saying that the Income-tax department has raided the places owned by Aditya Thackeray. He is the son of Maharashtra CM Udhav Thackeray and cabinet minister of Tourism and Environment of the state.Samkhya also posted a small video where a few girls are coming out of the enclosed room. Users are also claiming that the enclosed room was owned by Aditya Thackeray.Fact check:After doing the reverse image search of the keyframe, we found that the video was captured and released in 2021. When a bar’s underground or secret room was found by Mumbai Police. News Tak covered the news and also told that 17 girls were found caught inside the underground room.Another proofAlakh Bharat also posted a video of the incident.https://youtu.be/62p9Rp6Q2XoConclusion: Hence proves that the claim is misleadingClaim review: A fake video of the raid on Aditya Thackeray’s place got viralClaim by:Fact check: Misleading

content: Fact Check: The whole Truth behind the video of policemen with two saffron shawl guys. Clashes broke out between two communities during a Hanuman Jayanti procession in Jahangirpuri on Saturday, in which eight police personnel and a local resident got injured.The police have arrested the main conspirators Ansar and Md Aslam for this whole issue.1Meanwhile, a video of certain policemen with two persons following them in saffron shawls is getting viral on social media. People are sharing it with pride on the internet.Dharmarakshaks protecting Delhi Police with a sword in hand. (Translates Hindi) the caption reads.Fact Check:We reverse search the video and found that the video is old and from the year 2020.The video is actually from the corona times and the two guys in Saffron shawls are the corona warriors. They are going house to house to aware people of the corona and to follow all the corona norms.The video was shared by the official account of @budaunpolice (Budaun Police).Sho Kotwali told that both the persons shown in the above photo, Corona Warriors 1. Mukesh Kumar and 2. Sunil Gurjar visited the locality and appealed to the people to download the Arogya Setu App and stay in their respective homes. Both are Corona Warriors with the police.(Translates Hindi) the caption reads.Sho कोतवाली द्वारा बताया गया कि उक्त फोटो मे दर्शाये गये दोनों व्यक्ति कोरोना वारियर्स 1. मुकेश कुमार तथा 2. सुनील गुर्जर द्वारा मोहल्ले में भ्रमण कर लोगों से आरोग्य सेतु एप डाउनलोड करने तथा अपने-अपने घरों में रहने की अपील की गई । पुलिस के साथ दोनों कोरोना वारियर्स हैं। — Budaun Police (@budaunpolice) April 20, 2020Conclusion:Therefore old video is being shared with misleading context.Claim Review: the video of policemen with two saffron shawl guys.Claimed by: social media usersFact Check: Misleading.

content: Fact check: Did the Muslim women of Khargaon got arrested for stone-pelting the Hindu? A video is getting viral on social media. Users are claiming that some Muslim women have got arrested in MP’s Khargaon.Users are also claiming that these women have attacked Hindu women with stones and petrol.Fact checkAfter doing the cross-checking, we found that the video is from the year 2020. When a group of people attacked doctors in Moradabad.India Blooms News Service also posted the video on 15th April 2020. When the entire town attacked the health care workers and doctors who were serving during the time of Covid-19.Conclusion: Therefore the claim is misleading and no such incident took place in Khargaon.Claim review: the Muslim women of Khargaon got arrested for stone-pelting the Hindu WomenClaim by: Vikram Sony#प्रशासक समितिFact check: Misleading

content: Fact Check: Reality Of The Video Which Got Viral After The Delhi Riots On Hanuman Jayanti. After the communal violence video in Jahangirpuri, Delhi on the eve of Hanuman Jayanti social media is full of hateful posts. One such video of a procession is getting viral on the internet where people are asking for stricter police action after the Delhi riots. Further, along with the video, Manoj Parihar asked for a bulldozer baba in Delhi in the caption.Similarly, many people have shared this video on their social media handle.Fact CheckOn reverse image search, we found the same video on YouTube on the channel of Local Walk. The video was uploaded on 23th December, 2019 with the caption, “Support to CAA.”Therefore, the video is old and have no relation with the ongoing communal riots.Further, digging deeper into the matter we found out that the video is not of Jahangirpuri but it is of Laxminagar.Moreover, we found the same video on the Twitter handle of @jawaharyadavbjp. He posted the video on 26th December, 2019 with the caption, “The rally in Haryana is slightly different from the rallies in the country. “Modi ji, you play the stick, we are with you.”हरियाणा की रैली देश की रैलियों से थोड़ी अलग होती है। 😂 "मोदी जी तुम लठ बजाओ, हम तुम्हारे साथ हैं ।" pic.twitter.com/SJ79hu72Nw — Jawahar Yadav (मोदी का परिवार) (@jawaharyadavbjp) December 26, 2019ConclusionTherefore, the viral video is old. And, the claim that this video is related to the recent communal violence in Delhi’s Jahangirpuri is wrong.

content: Fact Check: Has Tennessee legalise child marriage? A piece of news is getting viral that Tennessee legislation will legalize child marriage. Social media is flooded with such posts. These posts claim that Tennessee Republicans are advancing a marry little kids’ bill that will allow them to marry children of any age.Further, many other social media users have criticized the news.Fact CheckOn our fact check analysis we found that there was an amendment in the Tennessee marriage law. This amendment added the phrase “who have both attained the age of majority,” which is 18 in their law.Further on our analysis, we got to know that the bill will set a higher required age for common-law marriages than that needed to obtain a marriage license, which is 17 in their law.Leatherwood’s office has not stated the reason for the amendment or the omission of the age requirement in the initial version yet.ConclusionTennessee has not legalized child marriage. Hence, the viral news is fake.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did French President Emmanuel Macron say sanctions on Russia will bring 60 million refugees to Europe? Quoting French President Emmanuel Macron A screenshot of BBC News is going viral on social media that due to sanctions on Russia, Europe needs to accept 60 million refugees, over the next twenty years.Be prepared to accept 60 million refugees from Africa and the Middle East in the next 20 years ,” said French President Macron , with a viral screenshot. He warned that sanctions on Russia are leading to economic collapse in Africa , which imports large quantities of Russian wheat.Similarly, many other users have also shared this screenshot with other similar claims.Fact CheckTo check the viral screenshot, we searched the news on BBC ‘s website. But we did not get any such news. Apart from this, no information about this was found on the official Twitter account of BBC.As Europeans, we are adopting new sanctions. And we will continue providing humanitarian, military and financial support to Ukraine. — Emmanuel Macron (@EmmanuelMacron) April 8, 2022To the contrary, we found a tweet by Macron . In which he talked about imposing sanctions on Russia. Moreover, he had earlier alsodemanded new sanctions on Russia. Information about this has been given in the report of Al Arabiya .conclusionHence the viral screenshot in the name of BBC is fake. Because French President Emmanuel Macron has not made any such statement .
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Did the Muslim mob attack Hindus in Delhi? On the auspicious occasion of Hanuman Jayanti. A picture is getting viral on the internet. It is claimed that a Muslim mob attacked Hindus in Delhi.One Twitter user wrote, “Muslim mob attack Hindu in Delhi & all people say Muslim is in danger in India.https://twitter.com/RajShek71685391/status/1515623670185889792?s=20&t=ToV64rci7rY7ndIQ4eVd8gAnother one wrote, “They’ve cleared one thing, either stop celebrating your festival or get ready to be keeled. It’s an open war against Hindus.https://twitter.com/SujinEswar1/status/1515588717963988992?s=20&t=AccMCuaET3u1B2XjK7ud7QFact Check:We Reverse Search the image by using a reverse search image. We found the same picture on a news by THE HINDU from the date 18th of August 2021.The headline reads, “Mob goes berserk in Lucknow, targets media.The Times of India covered the same news, which reads, “Protest in Lucknow over Assam riots, curfew imposed in Allahabad.Conclusion:Therefore, the picture getting viral is not from the latest Delhi riots, but from old riots in Lucknow in the year 2021.Claim Review: the Muslim mob attack Hindus in Delhi.Claimed by: Social media users.Fact Check: misleading

content: Fact Chek: Video Of A Man Threatening Hindus Got Viral Under The Karauli Violence. Know The Reality. After the Karauli riots, many cases of violence were seen in different cities. Fearing the people of other community in fanatic gestures.”Hence, the video is old and not related to recent Karauli violence.Also Read: Fake Pakistani Accounts and their Pro China NarrativeConcusionUsers are sharing the viral video video with fake and misleading comments.

content: Fact check: Do Rajasthan’s people take the oath for boycotting Congress due to unemployment in the state?   After the breakdown of Karauli violence, social media was filled with fake, misleading news and hatred all around. content: Fact check: Did BBC hold Ukraine responsible for the missile attack on Kramatorsk Railway Station? The war in Ukraine continues as Russia likely seem to have no plan to cease the attacks. Many people have already died during the war, and few have fled away. Ukraine is also facing an economic crisis and a shortage of weapons.Meanwhile, a video supposedly of BBC is going viral over a missile attack on Kramatorsk Railway Station in Ukraine. As per the users BBC has claimed that a missile attack was done by Ukraine itself on the station.https://twitter.com/Based_ENG/status/1514172754425176065?s=20&t=Or_xrlrQRRfVPB21Bk2Q9ghttps://twitter.com/WilhelmOrmstein/status/1514270467451875335?s=20&t=b6fS2Ew3IJGbkaFaHGRawAFact-checkAfter cross-checking, we got a tweet from British Broadcasting Corporation wherein they have dined the claims of stating that Ukraine was responsible for the missile attack on Kramatorsk Railway Station. 52 people were killed in the attack and mostly the crowd was filled with women and childrenWe are aware of a fake video with BBC News branding suggesting Ukraine was responsible for last week’s missile attack on Kramatorsk train station. The BBC is taking action to have the video removed. We urge people not to share it and to check stories on the BBC News website. — BBC News Press Team (@BBCNewsPR) April 13, 2022After checking the feeds of BBC on the official Twitter account, we found that no such tweets were made by BBC.Conclusion: Therefore, the claim is misleadingClaim review: BBC held Ukraine responsible for the missile attack on Kramatorsk Railway StationClaim by: Wilhelm Gottsreich Sigismond von OrmsteinFact check: misleading
label: rumor

content: Fact check: Did the old image of protest in Malaysia against the persecution of Indian Muslims go viral? Every communal clash gives heat to an agenda on social media. Huzaifa posted a picture of a protest sight. Wherein people are holding a poster with a warning for stopping the persecution of Indian Muslims. Further, they also added that Caliphate will punish him if he condemns the warning.South Asian Journal also posted the viral picture and claimed that the people of Malaysia are protesting against the persecution of Muslims in India. Users are also using the #IndianMuslims. #Malaysia #IndianMuslimsUnderAttack.https://twitter.com/sajournal1/status/1513792380708667392?s=20&t=R1g7IJagz6SbKU_-Ern28AFact checkAfter cross-checking we found that the protest in Malaysia regarding the massacre of Indian Muslims was held in 2020, in front of the Indian High Commission of India in Kuala, Lumpur. The reason behind the protest was claimed to be the oppression of Muslims after they protested against Citizenship Amendment Act 2019.The above-given information was found in the press release by Hizbut Tahrir Malaysia. They also posted the picture of the protest side and which is also similar to the viral image.Therefore, recently, no such protest in Malaysia took place for the persecution of Muslims.Conclusion: The claim is misleading.Claim review: the old image of protest in Malaysia against the persecution of Indian Muslims go viralClaim by: South Asian JournalFact check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Celebrations in the entire Mumbai during Ram Navami. True or False. A video is getting viral on social media sites. In the video, people are seen dancing and celebrating.it is getting viral with the claim that the scene is from Mumbai during Ram Navmi.People all over the social media sites are sharing the video with utmost pleasure.Moreover, background music can also be heard during the celebration.One of the tweets reads, “Just #Mumbai being awesome again, and pretty much the same scene throughout #Bharat #JaiShreeRamhttps://twitter.com/Aadhiraspeaks/status/1513028648365805571?s=20&t=T59sgyazEL6-hTUjLSLGHQSame posts are also being shared on Facebook.Fact Check:We at DFRAC reverse searched the image and found that the video is old and from the date 5th august 2020. Also, it was during Ganesh Chaturthi festival.We found the same video on YouTube from the year 2021.Conclusion:An old video showing a massive crowd dancing beneath a flyover in Mumbai during Ganesh Chaturthi festivities has gone viral with misleading claims that the video shows a Ram Navami procession this year.Claim Review: the video shows a Ram Navami procession this year.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Was Joe Biden Celebrating The Defeat Of Pak PM Imran Khan and Victory Of Shahbaz Sharif? A video of Joe Biden celebrating the defeat of Pakistan’s Prime Minister Imran Khan is going viral on the Internet. Users are making many types of comments over the video. In the video, Joe Biden was with a Woman. Further, along with the video @zbcheema wrote the caption, “Live from White House US President Joe Biden celebrating the defeat of PM Imran Khan and victory of Shahbaz Sharif.”Similarly, many other users have shared this video.Fact CheckWe took a screenshot from the video and after reverse image search of that screenshot we found the same video on the official account of President Biden. The video was of the time when Ketanji Brown Jackson was confirmed as the next Supreme Court Judge by the Senate.Historic moment for our courts and for our country. Congratulations, Judge Jackson. pic.twitter.com/eLSfs1QoHB — President Biden (@POTUS) April 7, 2022Moreover, looking closely at the screengrab from the video we found that the television screen was morphed.Therefore, it is clear that the viral video is edited. The actual video is not of White House celebrating the defeat of Imran Khan. But, they were celebrating the news of Ketanji Brown Jackson as next Supreme Court Judge. But, some users are posting edited video with the wrong claim.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: The Reality Of The Viral Tweet Of British Culture Secretary Nadine Dorries. A tweet from British Culture Secretary Nadine Dorries is going viral on the internet. In the tweet, she said, “I am fed up with, the loony left moaning about the rising demand for food banks. Every family needs to live within their means. Food doesn’t grow on trees!”. Further, along with the post @archer_rs wrote in the caption, “Ladies and Gentleman, I give you, once again, Her Majesty’s Secretary of State for Digital, Culture, Media, and Sport, Nadine Dorries.”Ladies and Gentleman, I give you, once again, Her Majesty's Secretary of State for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport, Nadine Dorries. pic.twitter.com/j1CXrbUv96 — RS Archer (@archer_rs) April 11, 2022Many social media users shared this picture on their handles.Also Read: DFRAC EXCLUSIVE: Khaled Beydoun And His Hateful Narratives Against IndiaFact CheckOn our fact check analysis we went through the official twitter handle of Nadine Dorries. We found no such tweets done by her. We also searched for the archived tweet if in case she might have later deleted her tweet. But, there also we didn’t found any such tweet.ConclusionHnece, there is no evidence othat she did the viral tweet. Hence, users are spreading fake tweet.

content: Fact Check: Did Rahul Gandhi say that Pakistan can be bought for $1 billion? A screenshot of a purported tweet by former Congress President and Kerala’s Wayanad MP Rahul Gandhi is going viral on social media. In that, he was quoted as saying that at this time Pakistan can be bought for less than 1 billion dollars?https://www.facebook.com/permalink.php?story_fbid=685767869513649&id=100042413252299The screenshot of the tweet that is going viral read that “Modi should explain to the nation why he spent billions of USD to buy huge weapons in the name of fighting Pakistan when the whole of Pakistan can be bought for less than USD 1 billion.” May #NationWantToKnow.”Many users have expressed regret on Rahul Gandhi by sharing this screenshot.Fact Check:To corroborate the claim made in the viral screenshot, we did a tweet search on Rahul Gandhi’s official Twitter account with certain keywords. But we could not find any such tweet.On April 8, Rahul Gandhi had only one tweet. This tweet was about police torture in police custody in Madhya Pradesh.Hence the viral screenshot of Rahul Gandhi’s alleged tweet is fake.Claim review: Did Rahul Gandhi say Pakistan can be bought for $1 billion?Claim by: Social Media UserFact check: Fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check:  Pete Buttigieg’s picture with the dogs and the truth behind it. A screenshot of Pete Buttigieg, U.S Transportation Secretary getting viral on social media sites.It is claimed that @PeteButtigieg posted a tweet from his official Twitter handle that reads, “Time for “therapy”!!!”https://twitter.com/ChillStableGuy/status/1512418979276636161?s=20&t=-N3MwhgzFpp-PibuZuGlZwHe is wearing military gear and holding a gun while standing in front of dogs.Many Facebook users are too posting this image under the caption, “This is so unnecessarily ominous Why didhe post this!?Fact Check:When we searched the word therapy for a keyword search, we found no such post on his official Twitter handle.Instead, we found a post like this.Make no mistake—a federal Equality Act is still urgently needed. The struggle for equality did not end with marriage, nor did it end today. Conversion therapy persists. Black trans women are at grave risk daily. The administration is rolling back protections at every turn. — Pete Buttigieg (@PeteButtigieg) June 15, 2020We too found the picture of dogs on Facebook with no Buttigieg in the picture.Conclusion:The picture of Pete Buttigieg was digitally altered.Claim review: @PeteButtigieg posted a tweet from his official Twitter handle that reads, “Time for “therapy”!!!”Claimed by: Social media users.Fact Check: fake
label: rumor

content: Fact check: Did Arvind Kejriwal promise to give 1000rs to the ladies of Himachal Pradesh? After Aam Adami Party has declared that they intend to contest for all the 68 seats in the Himachal Pradesh Election 2022. A roar of news and claims have been witnessed for the Himachal Pradesh election2022.Nighat Abbass is a verified account and a spokesperson for BJP who tweeted while inserting a picture of a billboard carrying Arvind Kejriwal saying ladies of Himachal will get 1000rs per month.Many other users posted the same picture claiming it is a new election campaign of Kejriwal to win the election.https://twitter.com/doctorrichabjp/status/1512327825419767815?s=20&t=w1hEt85MymofFtJ9T0fqPwFact checkAfter doing the reverse image search, we found that the image is from the year 2015. When Kejriwal won the election and was about to take oath as per India Today.After seeing the picture, it is clear that the picture is edited and has a misleading claim.Conclusion: the claim is misleadingClaim review: Arvind Kejriwal promised to give 1000rs to the ladies of Himachal PradeshClaim by: Nighat AbbassFact check: misleading
label: truth

content: Fact check: Did Muslim women were forcefully made to wear saffron shawls   A claim is getting viral on social media where people are claiming about how a Christian student was forced to offer Namaz in the prayer. Nitin Singh posted a video of 2 minutes where a supposedly MNS worker of Raj Thackeray took revenge and made Muslim women wear saffron shawls.Many other users also posted videos and claimed the same.Fact-checkAfter cross-checking we found the original video was released by TIMES NOW Navbharat. In the video, we found the original story about how a group of ladies wore saffron shawls and came to theatres for watching The Kashmir Files.Another proofNews18 also covered the news of how police removed their saffron shawl and gave a legal notice to them.ANI also tweeted about the news and interviewed a woman who joined a group for watching The Kashmir Files and the group had a uniformity of wearing saffron shawls as a symbol their group.A woman says, "The women had joined a group that was helping them watch 'The Kashmir Files'. The group had no badge or anything of that sort, so they provided them with saffron stoles for their identification as part of the group. There was nothing else behind it." (2/2) pic.twitter.com/U4zMuWhiga — ANI (@ANI) March 23, 2022Therefore, the news is misleading.Claim review: Muslim women were forcefully made to wear saffron shawlsClaim by: Nitin SinghFact check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact check: Viral picture of Murtaza and the reality behind it. A picture got viral all over social media. The picture is getting viral with the claim that the picture is of Murtaza Abbasi, who’s accused of attacking pro attacking provincial armed constabulary jawans at Gorakhnath temple.People are angry over the picture and sharing it with the caption that reads, “This is the attacker on Gorakhnath temple IIT-ian Murtaza Abbas #गोरखनाथ_मंदिर #GorakhnathTemple (translates Hindi)0ne more tweet reads, “Seeing this picture, it does not seem that this person IIT-ian Murtaza, who attacked the police and common Hindus by saying Allah hu Akbar at Gorakhnath temple, was a mental illness” (translates Hindi)ये तस्वीर देख कर नही लगता कि गोरखनाथ मंदिर पर अल्लाह हु अकबर बोल कर पुलिस और आम हिन्दूओ पर हमला करने वाला ये शख्स IIT-ian मुर्तजा कोई मानसिक बीमारी थी 👇 pic.twitter.com/BHAD8abU4s — Gaurav Singh (@GauravS78712238) April 7, 2022Fact Check:We at DFRAC reverse searched the image of the man in the blue t-shirt and found that his name is Vinod Kapri who is a well-known, journalist, filmmaker, and author.Conclusion:The guy in the picture is not Murtaza, but Vinod kapri .Claim Review: The viral picture is of Murtaza Abbasi, who’s accused of attacking pro attacking provincial armed constabulary jawans at Gorakhnath temple.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: fake.
label: truth

content: Fact check: Did a Muslim woman was Caught with a Pistol on the street in Mainpuri? Cases of Communal clashes are often heard in the news. Another video is getting viral by pointing out a particular religion on the internet.अयाचक posted a small clipping of 15 seconds and claimed that a Muslim teacher was seen carrying a gun and roaming around the street in Mainpuri.https://twitter.com/eternalroute/status/1513923094938677250?s=20&t=tvU6Bsat_PGmM2egHSUg3AOther users also spread the video and claimed that the teacher was caught by the police and used #Muslimterrorist.https://twitter.com/SUDHIRV91474043/status/1514137440486715394?s=20&t=tvU6Bsat_PGmM2egHSUg3AFact checkAfter doing a google reverse image search, we found the video in the article of Jsnewstimes. Through the report, we got to know her name is Kashmira Yadav and she resides in Firozabad. Therefore, the news about her being Muslim is fake.Another proofNews24 also posted the viral video and in the caption, they nowhere mentioned that the girl/teacher was Muslim.Conclusion: the claim is misleadingClaim review: a Muslim woman was caught with a pistol on the street in MainpuriClaim by: अयाचकFact check: Misleading
