content: Fact check: A fake picture of a Protest site in Turkey against the US is getting viral Imran Khan was removed from the position of Prime Minister by using a no-confidence motion against him and Shahbaz Sharif became the new Prime Minister of Pakistan. After the incident, much news has evolved on social media regarding it.@russia_urdu posted a picture of a protest site where he claimed that people are protesting against the US for showing support to the opposition party in Pakistan for a change in the regime of Turkey.https://twitter.com/russia_urdu/status/1511552744200577028?s=20&t=CC52xNoCsMVbol_A7HiK3gMany other users also spread the same picture where people are holding the picture of Imran Khan and on the other hand, an appeal for not involving other countries in the personal matter is written.https://twitter.com/mak_pak1/status/1511652157300387841?s=20&t=F7g5rW8JZRlpZbRt3EeXAAروس کے بعد ترکی میں امریکی رجیم چینج کے خلاف مظاہرے pic.twitter.com/LJ3G7i2ZAR — sadaf Khalid (@MaliknazK) April 8, 2022Fact checkAfter cross-checking the claim, we found the same picture on AFP. The picture was of 15 June 2017 when citizens of Turkey were protesting against the imprisonment of one of its MP’s in Istanbul.After looking at the picture we can conclude that the picture was edited and it is an old picture of a protest site in Turkey.Conclusion: therefore the claim is misleading.Claim review: A fake picture of a Protest site in Turkey against the US is getting viralClaim by: @russia_urduFact check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Whole truth behind the bloodshed in JNU. On the occasion of Ram Navami, students of ABVP got violent and demanded to take off Non-vegetarian dishes from the menu of Kaveri Hostel at JNU. Both the right-wing and left-wing students got into a heated argument over freedom on this matter.JNU students also claimed of being attacked by ABVP members. In the midst of all this, a picture is getting trolled on Twitter of a girl. It is claimed that the injury on the girl’s head is fake and instead of blood there is sauce on her head.Below are some related posts:Tomato Sauce & the JNU passed out Doctors Dressing .@narendramodi ji declare National Award in Best Actor category to all these ppl 😂#JNU #JNUViolence pic.twitter.com/VkekwPB6PE — BigScreen (@BigScreenTicket) April 11, 2022So many pics of 1 injured girl 😂Projecting Tomato sauce as blood will not make it Blood.#JNU has become narrative breeding ground for Left. #JNUViolence #JNUAttack #JNUClash pic.twitter.com/OrRRsK3elW — Raman Vishnoi (@IMVishnoi29) April 11, 2022Fact Check:We reverse searched the image to know the authenticity of the claim. We find the same pictures circulating on many news sites.The news site like The Wire, Hindustan Times.Madhurima Kundu (the girl in the blue kurta) too shared on her Facebook account the whole incident.Similarly, Akhtarista Ansari tweeted about her health o her official Twitter account.I have been discharged from AIIMS and i am better now. Thanks to everyone for checking on me.The fight against the Sanghi goons and fascist forces will go on.Inquilab Zindabad.#ArrestSanghiGoons — Akhtarista Ansari (@AktaristaAnsari) April 10, 2022Conclusion:Therefore, the picture is getting viral with the fake claim.Claim Review: Whole truth behind the bloodshed in JNU.Claimed by: social media students.Fact Check: fake.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: The Viral Video Of Imran Khan Being Displayed On The Burj Khalifa. Know the Truth. In our fact check analysis we checked official the site and social media handle of Burj Khalifa but we did not find any such news. Further, on keyword research, we found the same video on the handle of Noxious_Numaira. She had also uploaded the viral video on her YouTube Channel on March 24, 2022.Then, we found another tweet on her account in which she had shared a screenshot. And, she had clarified that the video was edited. Along with the screen grab she wrote, “This is amazing. In the Video my Twitter handle is watermarked & my YouTube channel is linkedAt both the places I’ve mentioned that I have edit videos/pics. Still, if people think that it is real then I’m the Goddess of VFX. It’s not my fault if people think it is real.”This is amazingVideo mein mera Twitter handle watermarked hai & my YouTube channel is linkedDono jaga I've mentioned that I edit videos/picsAb agar phir bhi logon ko sach lagta hai toh bhai phir I'm the Goddess of VFX 🤓It's not my fault if people think it is real pic.twitter.com/tm0kP06whC — ημ₥₳ĩŘα (@Noxious_Numaira) March 27, 2022Moreover, we found many other edited videos of Imran Khan on her handle.FaAlso Read: Trend Of #boycotthalalproducts And Increased Hate Against Muslims.ConclusionTherefore, the claims of the viral video are false. And, the video is edited. Imran Khan was not displayed on the Burj Khalifa.
label: truth

content: Fact check: Did FIFA World Cup 2022 extend the time duration from 90 minutes to 100 minutes in the match? As the news says FIFA 2022 will be hosted in Qatar. It also becomes the first Muslim and Arab country to host the event. Social Media is filled with different news regarding FIFA but most commonly news over the time duration of the football match is going viral on social media.SPORTbible a verified account posted the picture of the FIFA trophy and claimed that the duration of the match has been extended from 90 minutes to 100 minutes.FIFA plan to extend World Cup matches in Qatar from 90 minutes to 100 minutes… 🤯 Via Corriere dello Sport pic.twitter.com/v5Ze7Aj5BJ — SPORTbible (@sportbible) April 6, 2022Many other sports accounts containing followers have also spread the viral news of changes in time duration of the match.🚨 FIFA plan to extend World Cup matches in Qatar from 90 minutes to 100 minutes this winter. (Source: Corriere dello Sport) pic.twitter.com/TMHJKGBWlR — Transfer News Live (@DeadlineDayLive) April 6, 2022Fact-checkAfter cross-checking the news, we found that it was fake as FIFA Media denied the news of time changes in a match of 2022 on 6th April.FIFA Statement Following some reports and rumours spread today, FIFA would like to clarify that there will be no changes to the rules regarding the length of football matches for the FIFA World Cup Qatar 2022™️ or any other competition. — FIFA Media (@fifamedia) April 6, 2022Therefore, the news is fake as no such news came into existence.Claim review: FIFA World Cup 2022 extended the time duration from 90 minutes to 100 minutes in the matchClaim by: SPORTbibleFact check: fake
label: truth

content: Fact check: Fake pictures of Arvind Kejriwal and Bhagwant Singh having alcohol at dinner got viral After Bhagwant Singh became the Chief Minister of Punjab and Arvind Kejriwal claimed that the development of Punjab can be seen within 10 days of his tenure. There has been much news involving both of them on social media.Praveen Srivastava posted a picture of Arvind Kejriwal & Bhagwant Singh having dinner along with a man. For the dinner, chicken and alcohol are served and the user is making comments on the development of Punjab.Many other users are also posting the same viral picture and raising questions about the development of Punjab by pointing out alcohol in the picture.Fact checkAfter doing the reverse image search, we found that the image got viral in the year 2021. When Delhi CM and Bhagwant Singh were invited to a dinner by a driver of an auto-rickshaw.TOI Chandigarh posted the video of both of them while having dinner at the house of the driver in the tweet on 22 November 2021.In the report of TOI, we can also see the viral picture and found no such things as chicken or alcohol served in the dinner. Therefore, the picture is photoshopped.Conclusion: Hence proves that the claim is misleading.Claim review: Fake pictures of Arvind Kejriwal and Bhagwant Singh having alcohol at dinner got viralClaim by: Praveen SrivastavaFact check: misleading
label: rumor

content: Fact check:  Did people ignore Biden after the appearance of Obama in the white house? The White House has celebrated its event based on the Affordable Care Act in the US. Former President Barack Obama gave his first public appearance and shared a few words on the stage. Meanwhile, a short clip of Joe Biden is getting viral on social media. Users are claiming that US President was ignored by the crowd after the entry of Obama.RNC Research a verified account shared a clip of Biden and claimed that no one wants to talk to him.Literally no one wants to talk to Joe Biden pic.twitter.com/ApZ2saHt71 — RNC Research (@RNCResearch) April 5, 2022https://twitter.com/JackSparrowCCP/status/1511579458318536708?s=20&t=WTKa27TvZRZLwEEN4bsncgThis man has the codes of USA nuclear arsenal Literally no one wants to talk to Joe Biden pic.twitter.com/CllGho8ED7 — Τουίτερ TV 🇩🇪 🇬🇷 (@ertflix) April 5, 2022Fact checkAfter watching the video of the conference, we found that no such ignorance has taken place. In fact, Biden and vice President Kamla Harris were the major hosts of the event. From 39:27 minutes to 40:01 minutes, we can how people are paying respect to Joe Biden.Therefore, the video is spread with a misleading claim.Claim review: people ignored Biden after the appearance of Obama in the white houseClaim by: RNC ResearchFact check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did Indian Oil issue a warning to not fill the fuel in the tanks to its maximum limit? A picture was all over the internet which is claimed to be a warning from a fuel company Indian Oil.A Facebook user writes, “Note: Important message from IndianOil Petroleum. FYI: The heat is going to increase a lot in the coming few days, so do the math on your bikes with petrol or diesel tank full. Fill half tank petrol in this week, due to the intensity of the heat, 5 vehicles were torn apart or open the petrol tank of the vehicle once a day.”Many images with warnings are shared on Twitter so that other people take caution from it.Fact Check:While only looking at the viral picture one can tell it as a edited picture.We still reverse searched to check the authenticity of the picture and found no such picture on the official Twitter account of Indian oil.But, as the picture was widely circulated Indian oil told the consumer not to believe in any such news.It tweeted, “There are rumours in social media that Indian Oil has given a warning to the following effect: Due to increase in temperature please don’t fill petrol to the maximum limit of the tank; it will cause an explosion in the fuel tank. If you want petrol, fill the half tank and leave the rest for air. IndianOil would like to disown this statement and clarify it as follows.” “Automobile manufacturers design their vehicles considering all aspects of performance requirements, claims, and ambient conditions with built-in safety factors. The maximum volume specified in the fuel tank for petrol/diesel vehicles is no exception. It is therefore perfectly safe to fill the fuel in vehicles up to the full limit (max.) as specified by the manufacturer irrespective of winter or summer.”The tweet is shown below:Important announcement from #IndianOil. It is perfectly safe to fill fuel in vehicles up to the limit(max) as specified by the manufacturer irrespective of winter or summer. pic.twitter.com/uwQFDtjTdi — Indian Oil Corp Ltd (@IndianOilcl) June 3, 2019Conclusion:No such warning was issued by the official Indian oil account.Claim Review: Indian Oil issued a warning to not fill the fuel in the tanks to its maximum limit?Claimed by: social media users.Fact check: fake.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Has BCCI Announced A New Mixed Cap For The Best All-Rounder Of IPL? A piece of news is getting viral on social media that BCCI has announced a new mixed color cap for the best all-rounder in IPL. Further sharing the post @zaidrahmaaan wrote Best in the caption, “Wowww, BCCI has announced new ‘Mixed Cap’ for the Best All-rounder of IPL.”Wowww, BCCI has announced new 'Mixed Cap' for the best All-rounder of IPL. 🏏👏#IPL2022🖼️: (sportsgully) pic.twitter.com/M7KtJzJeFZ — Zaid Rahman (@zaidrahmaaan) April 1, 2022Similarly, many other users have shared this post.Also Read: DFRAC EXCLUSIVE: Khaled Beydoun And His Hateful Narratives Against IndiaFact CheckOn keyword research, we found no such news. Further, we checked the official websites of BCCI as well as IPL but we found no such news. Moreover, there is no such announcement on the social media handle of BBCI president Saurav Ganguly and secretary Jay Shah. Therefore, there is no evidence from any credible source that BCCI has announced a new cap for the best all-rounder in the IPL.ConclusionIt is highly unlikely that BCCI has made such a decision but had not announced it on any of its official platforms. Therefore, in our fact check analysis we found that this news is baseless. And, there is no such announcement of a mixed-colored cap to honor the best all-rounder in the IPL yet. Hence, the viral claim is fake.
label: rumor

content: Fact check: Did Russia hold a protest against America’s interference in Pakistan’s affairs?   After Imran Khan visited Moscow, Russia, there has been a lot of controversy on social media. Russia is alleged of many atrocities during the Ukraine invasion. Social media is filled with news related to the invasion. Meanwhile, a poster is getting viral on the internet about America interfering in Pakistan’s matter.Users are sharing a picture where Russians are protesting against America’s interference.Fact checkAfter a reverse image search, we found that the viral picture was of the protest side that occurred during the detention of Alexei Navalny in January 2021. The protestors majorly involved teenagers as the Navalny a Russian-based lawyer and politician immediately got arrested over his YouTube video criticizing Putin’s luxurious villa.As you can see the TSN, a Russian news portal posted the viral picture. After seeing the picture we can easily conclude that the picture was edited and the picture of Alexei Navalny was replaced by Imran Khan.Conclusion: Hence proving that the claim is fakeClaim review: Russia hold a protest against America’s interference in Pakistan’s affairsClaim by: Sumia?Iftikhar??✨Fact check: fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Know The Reality Of The Viral Video With The Caption Yogi Ji’s Poultry Farm. A video is getting viral on the internet with people taking their hands via the bottom of their thighs and holding their ears in a squat position. They are moving slowly and some policemen are monitoring them. By sharing the video users are claiming that they got punishment for reciting their prayers on the road. Further, along with the video @sbsaraswati wrote in the caption, “Punishment for offering Namaz on the road… This is UP Yogi Ji’s poultry farm.”https://twitter.com/sbsaraswati/status/1512047562190065665Similarly, many other users have shared this videos with a lot of mocking comments.https://twitter.com/Yogisaransh_1/status/1512010907181715460Fact CheckOn taking a screenshot of this video and doing a reverse image search on it we found that this video is from Mansehra, Pakistan. We found a video on YouTube on the channel named Urdu Updates. The video was shared on YouTube on March 29, 2020, with the caption, “How Mansehra police punish who violate lockdown, video is viral now. ”https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eHwiSLVnJ1sMoreover, we also found a report of geo.tv.Therefore, the claim with the viral video is misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Is a Muslim man assaulting a Hindu woman in Mirzapur? A video is allegedly shared on the internet where it can be seen a man is brutally assaulting women.The video is shared with the claim that the man seen in the video is a Muslim named Abdul whereas the woman who is facing the assault is a Hindu.The incident is said to catch fuel when the Hindu family told Abdul not to throw garbage in front of their home.The video is all over Facebook.Fact Check:We at DFRAC reverse searched the video and found that the news was found on several local news channels on 22nd January 2022. It was then found the it was not a fight of a Muslim against Hindu, but only between two Muslim families.An official YouTube channel ZMDM News shared same video.https://youtu.be/6zUDM-7Og_sConclusion:The video is getting viral with a misleading claim of communal roits, but in actuality it was between the same communities.Claim Review: Muslim man assaulting a Hindu woman in Mirzapur.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: misleading
label: rumor

content: Fact check: Is a Muslim guy beating a traffic police officer? A picture is circulated on social media sites with a claim that a Muslim guy is beating a traffic police officer.Pushpendra kulshreshta , a Facebook user shares a picture that writes, “Be independent, stay organized. Never rely on the police for security. Watch this attitude carefully. The picture is of the Ghantaghar area of ​​Jodhpur.. Orders to remove the encroachment, But when action was taken on the carts standing in disarray, the jihadis surrounded and this behavior happened with the police constable. The policeman is a traffic constable, named Shobharam. It is enough to be afraid that the attitude he is showing and the people standing around him … belong to the dear special-72 community of the government.Where is this courage coming from? Because of its religious belief? Or because of its strong social shield….? One-way voting? These are only 8% in RajasthanIt is known that even if this constable is killed, this system cannot spoil it in any way.”(Translates Hindi)Fact Check:Through reverse image search we found that the news on famous Hindi newspaper Dainik Bhaskar .From that news, we got to know the name of the person in the picture who was beating the traffic police officer. His name was Premchand Mali, son of Dharmendra, hence cannot be a Muslim.Also, the news of this incident was 6 years old and not of recent times.Conclusion:The picture is getting viral with the misleading claim.Claim Review: Muslim guy beating a traffic police officerClaimed by: Facebook users.Fact check: fake.
label: truth

content: Fact check: Did the right-winger rally near the mosque after the Karauli Violence? The communal clash in Karauli has created tension in the wind of Rajasthan as well as hate and opinions on the walls of social media. After the incident, many people are raising questions about why people remain silent when Muslims are attacked and protest when the house of Hindus are burned.Harun khan هارون خان posted a short clip of 27 seconds in which right-wingers are raising saffron flags in front and shouting in front of the mosque. Users are claiming that they are human right activist and keen to protest against the violence that happened to Hindus in Karauli Rajasthan.Where are the so-called champions of Human Rights when houses of Muslims are being burned in India.#Karauli #Karauliviolence https://t.co/774PV5huvh pic.twitter.com/gqjnI9r52p — هارون خان (@iamharunkhan) April 5, 2022Many other users also posted the same video and claimed that the video is of Karauli violence.https://twitter.com/MediaDnow/status/1510912493824229380?s=20&t=KPHyhd0sTfJ3Iq6yv48sdQFact checkAfter doing the reverse image search, we found an article of Aljazeera in which they have inserted the image of the viral protest. As per the article, Tejasvi Surya organized a cycle rally where he along with other BJP MP’s rallied from Bangalore city to Kolar city in Karnataka under the name of Fit India Movement on 27th March.Cyclists from Kolar led by their energetic MP Shri @bjp_muniswamy joined the #Cycle2Freedom ride at Narsapura in large numbers. Grateful to them for adding strength & joining the #FitIndia movement.#AzadiKaAmritMahotsav @BJYM pic.twitter.com/FuXnn8obpe — Tejasvi Surya (ಮೋದಿಯ ಪರಿವಾರ) (@Tejasvi_Surya) March 27, 2022Further, when they came near the Mosque, bikers started dancing, shouting or behaving in an undisciplined manner. While this incident took place in Kolar city of Karnataka and comes under the case where Muslims were aggressive after hearing about the Muslim women selling App.Mohammed Irshad also posted the viral clip of saffron flag holders protesting in front of the mosque on 29th March.Tejasvi Surya had organised a cycle rally from Bangalore to Kolar on March 21. When the rally reached the Hussaini Makan Masjid of Kolar the people who participated in the rally stopped and started doing this nuisance. What is the message? pic.twitter.com/9UwiZlGbEm — Mohammed Irshad (@Shaad_Bajpe) March 29, 2022Hence proves that the video is old and does not have a connection with the Karauli incident as violence in Karauli happened near the 4th of April and the viral video got on air on the 29th of March.Conclusion: Therefore, the claim is misleading.Claim review: the right-winger rally near the mosque after the Karauli ViolenceClaim by: Harun khan هارون خانFact check: Misleading
label: truth

content: FactCheck: Did Pentagon Say that Volodymyr Zelenskyy is a cousin of George Soros? A piece of news is getting viral on the internet with the claim that the Ukrainian President is the cousin of George Soros. Further, @OsintUpdates wrote in its tweet, “Volodymyr Zelensky is a cousin of George Soros. Pentagon official says.”Similarly, many other users also posted this news on their social media handles.https://twitter.com/RRVerma97907517/status/1511630986030706688Also Read: DFRAC EXCLUSIVE: Khaled Beydoun And His Hateful Narratives Against India.Fact CheckOn keyword research, we found no such news. George Soros is a Hungarian-born American billionaire investor and philanthropist. And, Volodymyr Zelenskyy is a Ukrainian politician and former actor and comedian. He is currently serving as the sixth president of Ukraine. There is no evidence that Soros and Zelenskyy are cousins.Further, we checked the official sites of the U.S. Department of Defense, official Twitter and Instagram sites. There is no such statement there.ConclusionTherefore, on our fact check analysis we found that there are no such statements released by the Pentagon. And, there is no evidence of both of them being cousins. Hence, the viral news is false and baseless.
label: rumor

content: Fact check: Is Australian Captain Aaron Finch about to declare his retirement from Cricket? Aaron Finch, captain of the Australian cricket team in T 20 has made a half-century against Pakistan in T-20. Many controversies have been involved against him not being in form yet heading the team. Meanwhile, News of his retirement or a decision not to play in any cricket match is going viral on social.Aaron Finch has decided to retire from all forms of cricket. He has arranged for a press conference tomorrow. pic.twitter.com/T2ZnJjllQg — MiSsI17_02 (@K_MiSsI17_02) April 3, 2022The news of his retirement was getting viral around 3 April and users also claimed that he was supposed to call out for a press conference a day after the news.Fact checkAfter Aaron’s win in the T20, he stated not to question his batting skill during the match. He mentioned that although he was going through a rough patch in the past matches yet he believes in his training and a comeback.The below-given video is of a T20 match against Pakistan where Australia won by 3 wickets. In the whole video, he didn’t mention anything about his retirement.Hence proving that Finch has made no such announcement about his retirement.Claim review: Australian Captain Aaron Finch about to declare his retirement from CricketClaim by: MiSsI17_02Fact check: fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did A Chopper Showered Flowers On The Eve Of The Hindu New Year Celebrations In U.P? A video of the chopper showering flowers viral on the internet. Sharing the video a user wrote, “A wonderful sight of flowers showering on the Sanatanis on the auspicious occasion of “Hindu New Year and Navratri festival” under the rule of bulldozer Bale Baba.”Similarly, another user wrote, “On the auspicious occasion of “Hindu New Year and Navratri festival” under Yogi’s rule, flowers are showered on the Sanatanis.”Jai Sri Ram.”Also Read: Fake tweet regarding Barack Obama’s statement over Donald Trump got viral.Fact CheckOn our fact check analysis, we found the same video on the You Tube channel of Ranchi Clips. Moreover, the video was uploaded on March 25, 2018 with the caption Ramnavmi live at Ranchi.Further, we also found the same video on the Youtube channel of Chanchal’s Biology with the caption,”Ramnavami 2019 Ranchi.”Hence, it is clear that this is an old video but users are sharing it the wrong claim. There was no such news of choppering showering flowers the on the eve of the Hindu New Year celebrations.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: The reality behind the viral picture of Mamata Banerjee with sexiest comments. A viral picture of Mamata Banerjee, CM of Bengal in her youth is vividly shared on various social media sites with the sexiest comments all over.The collage considers a picture of Mamata in her youth and the second picture in weird facial expression.The collage is shared by many Facebook users whose links are provided here and here. Under the caption that reads, “if not married on time, even an angel turns into a demon. Had this photo reached a suitable groom in time, only one household would have been ruined today, not the entire Bengal?” (Translates Hindi)Twitter too is filled up with the claims like this.अगर वक्त पर शादी न की जाये तो अप्सरा भी ताडका बन जाती है।अगर यह फ़ोटो ठीक समय पर किसी लड़के वाले के घरपहुँचती तो आज सिर्फ़ एक घर ही बर्बाद होता, पूरा बंगालनहीं…!!! pic.twitter.com/bwUYq78JQM — 🚩शरारती छोरा 🚩 (@real_vijay85) March 31, 2022https://twitter.com/Raviverma8696/status/1509573988686897152Fact Check:We reverse searched the images separately and found a picture of young Mamata on the site of IndiaToday (25/42)under the headline, “West Bengal CM Mamata Banarjee’s Political Journey.”From simply looking at the picture we could see how edited the picture is in the collage. The skin is seen more brighter and lips can be seen more red.When the second picture of the collage was reverse searched we found that picture from an Rath Yatra in the year 2015.in the picture Mamata is seen pulling the chariot of lord Jagannath.The news was also covered in INDIATV with same picture and same pictures were shared by ZEE news gallery (5/10)Conclusion:The image is getting viral with the misleading claime.Claim Review: the viral picture of Mamata Banerjee with sexiest comments.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: fake.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Is Smiriti Irani calling “Petrol Hike” a masterstroke toward Rich people? A video of Smiriti Irani, Minister of Women and Child Development of India is virally shared over the internet. In that video, Smriti is giving an interview about the petrol hikes and called it a masterstroke for the rich.People are sharing it on their social media accounts in agitation. A Facebook user states,“Every day in the opposition, I used to protest on inflation on the road, now inflation is starting to look good, why it is now eating the cream of power, shameful statement.”(Translates Hindi)Same video was shared on twitter too under the same claim.Fact Check:By only looking at the video, one can tell the video is doctored. The wording and the lip-syncing were not at all same.it seems like the voice is added to the old video.We at DFRAC then advanced searched the video. And found this video on the official Twitter handle of ANI News.The caption reads, “The spiteful & vengeful politics of Rahul Gandhi which insults not only the people & voters of Amethi but seeks to create a divide between the north & south India is to be condemned by every Indian citizen,” says Union Minister Smriti Irani.”"The spiteful & vengeful politics of Rahul Gandhi which insults not only the people & voters of Amethi but seeks to create a divide between the north & south India is to be condemned by every Indian citizen," says Union Minister Smriti Irani pic.twitter.com/A3kuQ93lDZ — ANI (@ANI) February 24, 2021Conclusion:The video getting viral on social media is doctored, as no such interview was given to ANI.Claim Review: Smiriti Irani calling “Petrol Hike” a masterstroke toward Rich peopleClaimed by: social media users.Fact Check: misleading
label: truth

content: Fact check: Fake tweet regarding Barack Obama’s statement over Donald Trump got viral A tweet over Barack Obama is going viral on social media. Roshan Rinaldi posted a tweet supposedly of Former US President Obama where he has raised a question regarding Donald’s Russian birth certificate.I can't believe he tweeted this. Wow. pic.twitter.com/zXFr50RcFN — Roshan Rinaldi (@Roshan_Rinaldi) April 2, 2022Many other users have also given a shocked reaction while posting it.Fact-checkAfter doing the reverse-image search, we found the creator of this image. Carroll Carpenter an account on Reddit posted the viral Obama tweet in March 2022.After checking her profile, we found that she wrote about how she makes fake tweets, ads etc. She also claimed that whatever she posts is written by her.Therefore, the viral image is edited and Barack Obama himself did not made any such tweet on Twitter.Claim review: Fake tweet regarding Barack Obama’s statement over Donald Trump got viralClaim by: Roshan RinaldiFact check: Fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did Telangana Police Waiving The Flags Of BJP? A video of people waving the flag of the BJP inside a police car is getting viral on the internet. The users are claiming that it is the car of the Telangana State Police. Further, along with the video, Hyderabad 24X7 News wrote in the caption, “waving BJP flags on Telangana State Rachakonda police car…Why did the police do this? Do police also have an interest in politics?“Similarly, many other users have shared this video.Fact CheckIn our fact Check analysis, we took a screenshot of the same video. The screenshot clearly shows that the person holding the flag is not wearing any police uniform.Further, on keyword research, we got a video of Zee Telugu News. The video was uploaded on 27th March 2022 with a Telugu caption that can be translated into English as, “BJP flags on a police vehicle.”In the video, they stated that the BJP supporter who were detained by the Police were waiving the Flag. Further, it also state that they were detained for participating in a rally against the government. Hence, the claims of users is misleading.
label: rumor

content: Fact check: Did a communal riot occur on the occasion of the New Year by the Hindu calendar? 2nd April is considered to be the beginning of the New Year in the Hindu calendar. Many Hindu families and especially Maharashtriyan celebrate the day with the utmost celebration. A video claiming a communal riot taking place on the occasion is going viral on social media.India Thought posted the viral video on 2nd April of 4 minutes and claimed that on the Hindu New Year rally, the mob attacked by a particular community, did not allow the rally to go ahead or to be continued.https://youtu.be/yCrHoDnk3oYFact checkAfter doing the reverse image search of the snapshots taken from the video, we found that the video was published in 2016 for the first time during the communal crash that occurred in Phagwara. After seeing the news coverage done by TV84, we saw the clipping of a viral video.The background story behind the riot was people of Shiv Sena attacked the mosque in Phagwara, Punjab.Hindustan Times also covered the news of a fight between Shiv Sena activists and Muslim men who were also supported by Sikhs of the area.Hence proving the claim over the video is misleading as the video belongs to the time of Communal clash taking place in Phagwara and not of hindus new year.Conclusion: The claim is misleadingClaim review: Phagwara & Sikhsa communal riot occurred on the occasion of the New Year by the Hindu calendarClaim by: India ThoughtFact check: misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Truth behind the viral picture of unemployment rates 2020-2021 in the governance of Modi. A picture is getting viral all around the internet in which there are unemployment rates from the year Jan-Mar 2020 to July-Sept 2021. People are posting it to show their agitation against the failure of the Modi government in providing employment.A page named Rahul Gandhi Fans on Facebook too posted the same picture.Will Modi ji make India a world guru by raising an army of unemployed? (translates Hindi) the caption reads.Fact Check:In India NSSO (National Sample Survey Organization) surveys every 5 years. It collects data on the employment and unemployment rates from 1972-73.The Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) was designed with two major objectives formeasurement of employment and unemployment. The first was to measure the dynamics in the labour force participation and employment status in the short time interval of three months for only the urban areas in the Current Weekly Status (CWS). The second one was, for both rural and urban areas, to measure the labour force estimates on key parameters in both usual status (ps+ss) and CWS.The data that is claimed is true to some extent but not totally correct as such. As this data included the quarter Jan-Mar 2020 (the quarter before the COVID-19 lockdown) is compared to the July-Sept 2021 quarter, which is after the initial lockdown.Recently PSLF has released its recent data.The unemployment rate declined from 6.1% in 2017-18 to 4.8% in 2019-20. The male unemployment rate declined from 6.2% to 5.1% and the female unemployment rate declined from 5.7% to 4.2% in the last few years.The initial lockdown in 2020 and the second wave of COVID-19 have impacted the unemployment rates. The unemployment rates were high during these periods.The whole article in details can be read under this article.https://factly.in/plfs-data-unemployment-rate-remains-unchanged-between-2017-18-2019-20-according-to-the-cws-approach/Conclusion:The viral picture is misleading as it is not considering the lockdown scenario.Claim Review: Truth behind the viral picture of unemployment rates 2020-2021 in the governance of Modi.Claimed by: social media users.Fact check: misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Drunk Video Of Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann gone Viral. Know The Complete Reality. A video is getting viral on the internet of a drunk man. Users are claiming that he is Punjab’s chief Minister Bhagwant Mann. Further sharing the video Sandeep Goswami, wrote the caption, “In the joy of victory, flowers have come out tight, the next Chief Minister of Punjab.”Similarly, many other users have shared this image with sarcastic comments.Fact CheckOn our fact check analysis we found the same video on the profile of @TajinderBagga. But the video was shared on March 4, 2017. Further, the caption of the video is, “I don’t drink, I haven’t drink. I have been given a drink, yes, I have been given a drink.”Maine Pi nahi hai, Maine Pi nahi hai. Mujhe pila di gai hai, hanji mujhe pila di gai hai pic.twitter.com/qwcQNjYpT7 — Tajinder Bagga (Modi Ka Parivar) (@TajinderBagga) March 4, 2017Hence, seeing the post it is clear that the viral video is from 2017. Bhagwant Mann is Punjab’s newly elected Chief Minister. In the past also DFRAC has already covered many fake or misleading claims related to Bhagwant Mann.Also Read: Is Bhagwant Mann canceling all the pensions for former MLAs and ministers?ConclusionTherefore, users are sharing old videos with misleading claims about Punjab’s Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Is Zelenskyy holding a T-shirt with a Swastika Sign? A picture of Ukraine’s president got viral. He was holding a T-shirt. It is claimed that the T-shirt is having a sign of Swastika on it.The t-shirt is of yellow color with blue color Swastika made on it.Which team is it? The caption reads (Translates French)https://twitter.com/ThejoneOne/status/1498356995853852672?s=20&t=fB-b4V7oiegsO-DJyeIriwFact Check:When at DFRAC reverse searched this image and found that the image was getting viral with the misleading claim.The actual thing that was written on the t-shirt was the number 95, which was morphed to the sign of a swastika.The same picture was found on the official Instagram handle of Zelenskyy.The picture was clearly morphed in nature. Hence, misleading.Conclusion:Claim Review: Zelenskyy holding a T-shirt with a Swastika SignClaimed by: social media usersFact Check: Misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Is the owner of Himalaya Company provoking people to boycott Reliance Jio. A video of a man giving a speech is getting viral on social media platforms. In the speech, he is provoking people to boycott Reliance Jio and switch to other brands.The video is getting viral with the claim that the man giving the speech is the owner of the Himalaya Company.The owner of the Himalaya Company is a Muslim & listen to his speech! He asks to boycott Reliance Jio & switch over to other brands, saying those funds go to RSS which uses it to buy arms to fight Muslims. If we boycott Himalaya for Halal Compliance??? #BoycottHimalayaThe caption reads.The owner of Himalaya company is a Muslim & listen to his speech! He asks to boycott Reliance Jio & switch over to other brands, saying those funds go to RSS which uses it to buy arms to fight muslims. If we boycott Himalaya for Halal Compliance??? #BoycottHimalaya pic.twitter.com/N8MjzHpx80 — Chandrasekhar S 🖐️ (@chandraleoroyal) March 31, 2022The same kind of caption and post were posted on Facebook by many users.Fact Check:To know the authenticity of this video we reverse search the Image and used certain key words.We found the same video on YouTube channel of Times Express from the year 2020. The man giving the speech is a well-known lawyer Bhanu Pratap Singh who gave the speech to the crowd sitting in the protest of NRC-CAA after the verdict of the Supreme Court.We too check the official site of Himalaya to know the name of the owner of the company and found his name to be Mr. M Manal.Conclusion:Hence, the video is getting viral with a misleading claim.Claim Review: the owner of Himalaya Company provoking people to boycott Reliance Jio.Claimed by: Social media users.Fact check: misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did supporters of former MLA Sunita Singh enter the mosque and beat up the worshippers in Ghazipur? A video is getting viral on the internet. Users are sharing the video with a claim that Former MLA Sunita Singh entered the mosque with hundreds of supporters to beat up the worshippers.Further, along with the video @UzmaParveenLKO wrote the caption, “The work of disturbing the peace of the country, in Ghazipur Gahmar, former MLA Sunita Singh entered the mosque along with hundreds of supporters and beat up the worshippers, the government should take this into cognizance, take strict action against Sunita Singh.”Moreover, this tweet was retweeted thousands of times. In the same vein, many users shared this video on their social media handles.Also Read: Are The Himalayan Product in India Halal Certified?FactCheckOn our fact check analysis we found a tweet from the official account of the Gazipur Police.https://twitter.com/ghazipurpolice/status/1510794243203235844In the tweet, they have clarified,” There is no such incident, nor has any complaint been given by the local people at the Gahmar police station. Additionally, the Superintendent of Police Rural was directed to investigate the video. If anyone is found guilty after investigation, then strict action will be taken against him.”Further, we also found the same posts on the Instagram account of Rana Ayyub with the same video and the claim that the video is of Karauli Rajasthan.Hence, some users are sharing the video with a misleading claim.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did Jason Derulo Falls Down At The Red Carpet? American singer and dancer Jason Derulo got the limelight in recent days. But, this time he got fame for falling at the Oscars. @SE0KJINSTAN shared a post on Twitter with the caption, “JASON DERULO JUST FELL AT THE RED CARPET.”https://twitter.com/SE0KJINSTAN/status/1508218010884096006Similarly, many other users have shared this picture on the internet.Fact CheckIt is quite hilarious that such news of Jason’s falling went viral in 2021 also. On keyword research, we found many tweets with the same picture. And, the caption of the post is, “Jason Derulo just fell down the red carpet at the Grammys .“jason derulo just fell down the red carpet at the grammys pic.twitter.com/PpAQwLkm2I — javier (@MLMPHOBE) March 14, 2021Jason himself clarified that this news is fake. He posted on Twitter,” Let’s clear one thing up, that was NOT me at the #Metgala y’all play too much, I was right on my balcony in MiamiLet’s clear one thing up, that was NOT me at the #Metgala 😂😂 y’all play too much, I was right on my balcony in Miami pic.twitter.com/1TNAZYXsYs — Jason Derulo (@jasonderulo) May 8, 2019Further, we found a video on YouTube from 2015 in which Jason Derulo Reacts to Met Gala Fall Rumour.Also Read: Is Arvind Kejriwal showing anger towards Gujrat?ConclusionTherefore, the viral news is fake and was spread before also.

content: Fact Check: Did Chris Rock apologize to Jada Pinkett Smith for the joke in Oscars 2022? The news of Will Smith slapping Chris Rock on the 94th Oscar awards 2022 for making a joke on his wife Jada Pinket Smith is the talk of the town in recent days. Meanwhile, many news and fake news related are all over the internet.Again a claim is getting viral stating that Chris Rock issued an apology statement to Jada and her family.The tweet reads, “Chris Rock issues statement regarding the incident with Will Smith during the 94th Academy Awards.”This is what the tweet looked like:https://twitter.com/PHDailySun/status/1508746488914259971Facebook too is filled with the same claim.Fact Check:We at DFRAC, reverse searched this image and found that no such statement was issued from the official Website, FacebookPage or Twitter handle of Rock.Also when we searched the keywords. We found a tweet by @ThatRebecca, The Hollywood Reporter Senior Film Editor, alumna Vanity Fair, LA Times, Time, author of books on Young Frankenstein + James Cameron.Chris Rock has not yet issued a statement. There is a statement going around purporting to be from Rock that is not from him, per his team. It’s the one that starts, “As a comedian, it can be difficult to understand.” The Tweet reads.Chris Rock has not yet issued a statement. There is a statement going around purporting to be from Rock that is not from him, per his team. It’s the one that starts, “As a comedian it can be difficult to understand…” — Rebecca Keegan (@ThatRebecca) March 29, 2022Conclusion:The circulated picture of Rock is fake in nature as nothing like this was found on the official social media accounts of the Rock.Claim Review: Chris Rock apologize to Jada Pinkett Smith for the joke in Oscars 2022.Claimed by: social media Users.Fact Check: Fake.
label: truth

content: Fact check: Old video of Narendra Modi over EVM got viral with fake claims A video by PM Narendra Modi is going viral on the internet about Electronic Voting machines. Bains Singh posted a short clipping of 30 seconds and in the video, PM is saying how Americans read the name before giving votes. Users are claiming that the viral statement was made before he became the Prime Minister of India.Many other users are also sharing the video of Narendra Modi’s speech and using the #BanEVMFact checkAfter doing the reverse image search, we found that the video was taken from the live streaming of the PMs Rally in New Muradabad, Uttar Pradesh. The video was posted on the official YouTube channel of Narendra Modi.The video was released in 2016 after Narendra Modi became the Prime Minister of India. Therefore, the claim is misleading.Conclusion: the claim is misleadingClaim review: Old video of Narendra Modi over EVM got viral with fake claimsClaim by: Bains SinghFact check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Are The Himalayan Product in India Halal Certified? A controversy regarding Himalayan Products is surfacing the internet. People are claiming that Himalayan products are Halal certified. Further, @TheAtulMishra shared a picture with the logo of Himalaya and Halal Policy as the heading. Along with the post, he tagged and wrote the caption, “Please tell me this is fake news @HimalayaIndia My whole family loves Himalaya Products.”Please tell me this is fake news @HimalayaIndia. My whole family loves Himalaya Products. pic.twitter.com/MxIx80BMtV — Atul Kumar Mishra (@TheAtulMishra) March 30, 2022This picture was circulated n the internet thousands of times. And, some users started to tweet to stop using Himalayan Products.https://twitter.com/ss_santu/status/1509238791810158593Celebrities like Paresh Rawal also took part in this #BoycottHimalaya trend.Fact CheckOn our fact Check analysis, we got a tweet from the official Twitter of the Himalaya Wellness CompanyIn the above tweet Himalaya has clarified that in certain countries, halal certification is mandatory. Hence, the halal certification is obtained as per the respective regulations for such countries only. Further, it has also clarified and confirmed that none of the Himalayan products contain meat as alleged on some of the social media platforms, this is factually incorrect. Halal certification does not imply that a product contains animal-derived ingredients.Moreover, we have also found that many companies in the market sell Halal-certified products but that doesn’t mean that they contain Halal meat. Products of companies like Tata, Reliance and Hindustan Unilever limited are also Halal certified.Hence, the claim by users is misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Were There No Deaths In Gujarat In The Third Wave As Claimed By Amit Shah? Home minister Amit Shah while addressing the public in Gandhinagar praises PM Narendra Modi and Chief of Gujarat Minister Bhupendra Patel. Further, @tv9gujarati posted three minutes and thirty seconds long video of his speech. The caption of the post was, “#COVID19 vaccination drive resulted in less death rate during the third wave, Union Home Minister @AmitShah.” At 1 minute and 34 seconds, he said in Gujarati that During the COVID period, the BJP government of Gujarat has set an example of the vaccination drive in front of all(states) in India, due to this reason when the third wave came, there was no death loss.”Also Read: Is Saral Patel’s statement of taxes on petroleum true?Fact CheckIn our fact check analysis we looked for the details from Government’s official sources. The third wave of Covid was from January 4 to February 14. People got affected by it and many lost their lives also.Cases during this wave peaked during January 18-25, 2022, with the highest number of cases (3.47 lakh) registered on January 20, 2022.Moreover, the graph which is taken from the official website of https://covid19bharat.org/ shows the deceased in Gujarat due to Covid-19 in the past 90 days. In this period there were 699 deaths in Gujarat. Then, the number of deaths in Gujarat averaged around 17 per day.ConclusionTherefore, we can clearly see that the deaths were not zero as stated by Amit Shah.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Is Arvind Kejriwal showing anger towards Gujrat? A video is getting viral on social media of Arvind Kejriwal, CM of Delhi. In the video he is sounding in anger against Gujrat and its population.People all over the internet are posting the video under the caption, “Why Kejriwal ji hates Gujarat so much. (Translates Hindi)Fact Check:By only looking at the video we can predict that the video is morphed part of the whole speech presented by Kejriwal.We at DFRAC reverse searched the image and found the same video on the official YouTube channel of Aam Admi Party.The section of the speech starts from 14:43 minutes where Kejriwal was targeting Amit Shah.The difference between both the videos was also posted by the official page of AAP.See this @BJP4Gujarat low-level work of Surat MLA @sanghaviharsh ji – Seeing the increasing popularity of the Aam Aadmi Party in Gujarat, they are misleading the public by sharing such fake videos. Reads the caption. (Translates Hindi)The video is also 5 years old, hence misleading in nature.Claim Review: Arvind Kejriwal showing anger towards Gujrat.Claimed by: social media Users.Fact Check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: A sneak peek into a global factory of phishing websites that even impersonate the Finance Ministry During the first and the second wave of the Covid-19 pandemic, the Centre announced schemes to provide economic relief to people and businesses. The economy right now is still struggling for a number of reasons. Consequently, new relief schemes being announced are a believable idea.And some people have been taking advantage of that. One such website pretending to be the Finance Ministry of India announced a financial aid of Rs. 30,628 and many believed it to be true.advertisementOf course, the Finance Ministry did not announce any such aid. The Press Information Bureau called this website fraudulent.But the story doesn’t end there. It has only just begun.As we peeled off the layers of this website, we came across a global nexus of hundreds of fraudulent websites, extending their tentacles to several countries.Here, we will dive into the world of those running these websites and figure out their modus operandi.Same scam, many sitesThe aforementioned “Finance Ministry” website appears to be built primarily for mobile devices. And fraudulent websites like these thrive on instant messaging apps like WhatsApp. Case in point, when you share the URL of that website, the preview mentions “finmin.nic.in”, the URL of the Finance Ministry website. And that is meant to trick people. Of course, if you look at the actual URL that’s been shared — indiangotrs.blogspot.com — you’d immediately recognise it does not belong to a government organisation.But that’s not the only URL. There are also “indiarsgot.blogspot.com” and “indiagetingrs.blogspot.com” and both websites were active at the time of writing this.All three links are designed similarly to impersonate the Finance Ministry of India. Their archived versions can be seen here, here and here.Squid Game beginsInside these sites, when you click on the registration button, you will be asked to enter your name and share the link with either 15 WhatsApp friends or forward it to five WhatsApp groups. As you do this, another window will open, leading you to a page featuring the design from the globally acclaimed Netflix show “Squid Game”.When you click on the page with the “Squid Game” visual, two different links open. The first link asks you to enter your phone number and call to receive further instructions for participation. Such tricks to gather phone numbers are often used to harvest data.The second link will also ask you for your phone number. As you enter a phone number (which you shouldn’t) and proceed, a warning will flash on your screen claiming this malicious website could steal your passwords, emails, or even credit card details.Reading between the lines of codeThe websites impersonating the Finance Ministry are hosted on blogspot.com. This has been intentionally done to make it difficult to unmask the people behind them.If someone tries to find the details of the website using domain investigation tools, only the details about blogspot.com would be revealed and it won’t be possible to find anything about the website being hosted on it or its creator.We then decided to look into the source code of these websites. Here, we found links to three profile pages hosted on blogspot.com: od107, od.company79 and od.company81.Scanning the websites listed on these profiles revealed several other Blogspot profile links such as od.company6, od103, od.company42 and od102.Pandora’s boxThese Blogspot profile pages turned out to be a warehouse of scams! They contain a long list of scam websites personalised for different countries of the world.In total, we were able to find 150 active links to scam websites. We compiled the list of these websites that can be seen here.The screenshots of some such websites can be seen below. It is noteworthy that a large chunk of these websites is in Arabic. This means that the person operating these sites could have an Arabian connection.advertisementAmong the scam links, we found some websites running fake schemes in the names of Global leaders like Abdullah II bin Al-Hussein, popularly known as the King of Jordan, and the Prime Minister of UAE Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum.Scams are being run in the name of brands and organisations from multiple countries of the world like Saudi Arabia, UAE, Egypt, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Morocco, Qatar, and Yemen. For instance, fraud schemes are being run in the name of the ‘Touch’ and ‘Alpha’, leading telecom operators in Lebanon. Another fake website is being run in the name of Carrefour Jordan, a supermarket in Jordan.While we were not able to identify who is behind these scam websites, it is clear that fraudulent websites advertising government financial aid and other schemes around the world are being run by one person or group.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: KL Rahul didn't cry following LSG's IPL exit, Snapchat filter did the trick The stage is set for the summit clash of the 15th edition of the Indian Premier League (IPL) on May 29, Sunday. Meanwhile, a video of Lucknow Super Giants captain KL Rahul has started making rounds on social media. The video shows Rahul getting emotional following his team's defeat in the first eliminator game against RCB.While sharing this video, Facebook users have claimed that the LSG captain could not hold back tears following their exit from the tournament. A user posted this video with a caption that read, "You never know this pain."advertisementThe same video was shared on YouTube with some similar claims.An Archived version of such claims can be seen here and here.India Today Anti Fake News War Room (AFWA) has found these posts to be misleading as the video is altered. A Snapchat filter was used to make KL Rahul teary-eyed.AFWA ProbeWe conducted a keyword search to know if any news reports have been published on the incident. However, there were no articles that supported the claim.We checked the repeat telecast of the match available on the streaming platform Hotstar next. Towards the end, losing captain KL Rahul appeared in front of the mike for the post-match reaction. At the 6 hours and 20 minutes mark, Rahul talks before the camera without expressing many emotions. It can be identified that scenes from this portion are the same as those in the viral video.So, is the video manipulated?To find out, we ran a few searches on platforms and software available to make people look emotional. Results suggested that a 'crying' filter of the popular social media app Snapchat could make this happen. The filter can make anyone look emotional even if they were happy faced in the original footage.When we applied this filter on the face of KL Rahul from the post-match conversation, it looked similar to the video now in circulation. A comparison of the original scenes and its copies applying the 'crying' filter can be seen here.Thus, it is safe to conclude that the video of KL Rahul getting emotional is an altered version created using a Snapchat filter.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: No, cops DID NOT ban BJP workers from entering a Meerut police station The media cell of the Samajwadi Party (SP), the principal opposition party in Uttar Pradesh on Friday, May 27, tweeted a photo of a police station in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh. A banner outside the police station announced that Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) workers were not allowed inside. It also had the name of Sant Saran Singh, the officer in charge of the Medical Police Station.advertisementThe SP Media Cell tweet claimed that frustrated with the hooliganism of BJP workers, the officer-in-charge at the police station was forced to install that sign outside.SP chief and former UP Chief Minister Akhilesh Yadav also tweeted the photo, criticising the Yogi Adityanath-led UP government.A similar claim has been archived here.The India Today Anti Fake News War Room (AFWA) found the claim was misleading. The Meerut police confirmed that no police personnel installed the banner. Rather, it was placed there by a group that included BJP workers protesting at the station over a property dispute.AFWA ProbeThis incident was widely reported. On May 27, Aaj Tak, BJP workers caused an uproar outside the Medical police station in Meerut after cops allegedly misbehaved with a widow who came to file a complaint against her dead husband's brother about a property dispute.Following this, the group that claimed to be BJP workers gathered outside the station in her support. Some people who supported the woman's brother-in-law also assembled outside. It was during this that the aforementioned banner first appeared.Meerut Police denied placing the banner and said it was put there by unidentified people. “Police have identified some people for their alleged involvement in the matter and action will be taken against them,” Senior Superintendent of Police Prabhakar Chaudhary told PTI.The Twitter handle of Meerut Police also issued a statement regarding the banner. The statement said that anti-social elements were trying to pressurise the police to take a side in the dispute. It also said that legal action would be taken against those who installed the banner.On May 28, the Indian Express reported that Meerut Police arrested six local BJP workers on Saturday, a day after the poster was put up by them outside the police station.SSP Chaudhary said in a press statement, "The anti-social elements who put out the said banner also created a ruckus inside the police station. They have been identified from video footage and six people have been arrested. Other people involved will also be arrested.”advertisement 00 212/22 147/352/353/505(2) 7 CLA Act 1. 2. 3. 4. 5. 6. pic.twitter.com/xIkRKbnoSj — MEERUT POLICE (@meerutpolice) May 28, 2022Meerut BJP leader Anuj Vashishth, who was among the protestors at the police station, told India Today that policemen did not place the banner there. He added, “Yes, there are BJP workers among the arrested but not any office bearers. We are the biggest national party; everyone wants to join us and work with us.”Thus, we confirmed that the banner that announced BJP workers weren't allowed at a police station at UP's Meerut was not installed by cops at all. It was done by civilian protestors that included BJP members who were there.(With inputs from Yash Mittal and Usman Chaudhary)
label: truth

content: Fact Check : No court has ordered the demolition of Afzal Khan’s tomb in Maharashtra The Maharashtra government recently tightened security around the grave of Afzal Khan in the Satara district of Maharashtra following political controversies over Aurangzeb's tomb in Aurangabad and the Gyanvapi mosque in Varanasi. content: Fact Check: No court has ordered the demolition of Afzal Khan’s tomb in Maharashtra The Maharashtra government recently tightened security around the grave of Afzal Khan in the Satara district of Maharashtra following political controversies over Aurangzeb's tomb in Aurangabad and the Gyanvapi mosque in Varanasi.Amid this, people shared a post that states: “Court had ordered to demolish the tomb of Afzal Khan at Pratapgad in Maharashtra. But the Maharashtra government still continues to protect it.”advertisementThe India Today Anti Fake News War Room (AFWA) found that this claim was misleading. No court in India ordered the demolition of the tomb of Afzal Khan in Satara. Following Public Interest Litigations (PIL), the Bombay High Court had ordered to take legal actions against encroachments around the tomb.Archived versions of posts with similar claims can be seen here and here.AFWA ProbeAn old report by OneIndia, published in 2007, stated that the Bombay High Court had directed the Conservator of Forests to take legal action within four weeks against all illegal constructions surrounding Afzal Khan's tomb.A 2017 India Today report said that the Bombay High Court on February 2, 2017, directed the Maharashtra government to do away with illegal constructions around Afzal Khan's tomb.The report stated that the bench was hearing a contempt petition filed by petitioner Milind Ekbote against illegal construction on forest land around the grave of Afzal Khan. Neither report mentioned orders for the demolition of the tomb itself.On the website of the Bombay High Court, we found a series of orders and judgments related to this issue. While many of these orders did not mention the exact appeal of the petitioners, we found one order, dated January 30, 2008, that quotes: “As the petitioners contended that in the name of the original tomb of Afzal Khan, certain persons were encroaching upon the land and using it for their benefits.”Varsha Laxmanrao Deshpande was the petitioner of this PIL and Uday Warunjikar was the advocate for the petitioner. India Today contacted Deshpande, who is also an advocate.He said, “I had not made an appeal to demolish the tomb of Afzal Khan. Following my PIL, the court ordered to take legal steps against illegal encroachments surrounding the tomb. Such encroachments include a few rooms and even a Dargah.”To further confirm the claim, we got in touch with the district administration of Satara. “We have never received any court order that directs us to demolish the original tomb of Afzal Khan,” Sekhar Singh, the district collector of Satara, told India Today.advertisementAfzal Khan was a commander who served the Adil Shahi dynasty of Bijapur, and fought against Shivaji. Khan was killed and his army was defeated in the Battle of Pratapgad on November 10, 1659.Thus, we concluded that the claim was misleading. No court ordered the demolition of the tomb of Afzal Khan in Maharashtra.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Is the Indian flag at Attari-Wagah border visible from Lahore? WhatsApp forwards aren’t always factual A photo of the Indian flag at the Attari-Wagah border went viral on social media. Harsha Kakar, a retired Major General of the Indian Army, tweeted the photo that contained the text, “India’s Tallest Flag On Wagah Border Is Seen From Lahore’s Market”. Kakar claimed he received the photo on WhatsApp.Other social media users shared the photo with the same claim. Some of those posts are archived here, here, and here.advertisementThe India Today Anti Fake News War Room (AFWA) found that while the image was indeed from Pakistan, it was from the Attari-Wagah border and not Lahore. The Indian flag at the Attari-Wagah border is not visible from Lahore at all.AFWA PROBEIn the photo, we found a ‘C24’ logo in the bottom left corner. Using this, we searched and found a video from March 23, 2017, on the YouTube channel of Pakistani news outlet City 24. This video, titled “Wagah Attari border Indian flag disappeared,” contained the viral photo and reported on how the Indian flag usually visible from the Pakistani side of the border allegedly disappeared for some time.An India Today report from August 2017 stated that the 360-foot-tall tricolour erected by the Punjab government in March that year suffered wind damage and had to be taken down and replaced several times. In August 2017, Pakistan installed its own 400-feet-tall flag to rival the Indian one.To make sure if the Indian flag was visible from Lahore, India Today contacted Pakistani journalists who confirmed that the photo was from the Pakistan side of the Attari-Wagah border. Imran Gabool of the Pakistani daily Dawn and Lahore-based journalist Waris Paracha added that the Indian and the Pakistani flags at the border were not visible beyond a ten-kilometre radius. The distance from Lahore to the border is more than 20 kilometres.Thus, we concluded that the viral photo was not from Lahore but from the border itself and the Indian flag at the Attari-Wagah border is not visible from Lahore at all.(With inputs from Yash Mittal and Pathikrit Sanyal)
label: truth

content: Fact Check Video: Texas school shooting followed by transphobic rumours about the shooter In this detailed report, India Today’s Nalini Sharma explains the legal grounds behind the Delhi High Court’s decision to suspend the life sentence of former BJP MLA Kuldeep Singh Sengar in the Unnao rape case. The court ruled that Sengar did not fit the definition of a 'public servant' under the POCSO Act, rejecting the trial court's reliance on the Prevention of Corruption Act for this definition. Despite this relief, Sengar remains in jail due to a separate 10-year sentence for the custodial death of the survivor's father. The report also highlights that the CBI and the survivor, who recently met Rahul and Sonia Gandhi, will challenge this verdict in the Supreme Court.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: First Bihar, now Chennai, 2020 ‘Go Back Modi’ graffiti from Kolkata continues to play musical chairs Amid the Prime Minister’s Chennai trip on May 26, a photo of a “Go Back Modi” graffiti went viral with the claim that this was how people in the city protested Narendra Modi’s visit.Several people on Twitter and Facebook shared the photo with hashtags like #GoBackModi and #GoBackFascistModi.The India Today Anti Fake News War Room (AFWA) found that this photo was neither new nor from Chennai. In January 2020, anti-CAA protesters in Kolkata painted this graffiti to express their opposition to the PM’s visit there.advertisementThe viral posts are archived here and here.AFWA ProbeOur first clue was that the people in the photo could be seen wearing winter wear, which is unlikely to happen in Chennai in May.A reverse image search led us to an Ei Somoy news report from January 12, 2020. The Bengali news portal reported that the location of the graffiti was near Metro Channel. A brown structure visible in the photo bearing the words, “METRO CHANNEL CONTROL POST, HARE STREET POLICE STATION,” could be seen in the viral image.When we searched Google Maps for “Metro Channel Control Post, Hare Street Police Station”, we found stark similarities between the photos we found and the viral shot.A Times of India report from the same time featured a different photo of what appeared to be the same “Go Back Modi” graffiti in Kolkata. Per the report, in January 2020, anti-CAA protesters expressed opposition to PM Modi’s visit to the city through graffiti.“The idea was simple. We wanted to shout out a message that was loud and clear — any leader or organisation that tries to divide people on the basis of religion is not welcome in this state or city,” a protestor present at Metro Channel in Esplanade, Kolkata, told ToI at the time.India Today reported at the time that hundreds participated in the protest at the Kolkata airport against PM Modi’s visit. Protests were also staged in other parts of West Bengal.This was not the first time this photo went viral with a misleading claim. In fact, AFWA has previously debunked false claims about this photo being from Bihar.Thus, we concluded that a 2020 photo from Kolkata was repurposed as an anti-Modi graffiti in Chennai amid the PM’s recent visit to the city.
label: truth

content: Fact Check Video: No, ceiling of Congress Chintan Shivir didn't resemble Pakistan flag As the curtains fell on the Congress party's three-day Chintan Shivir in Udaipur, Rajasthan, on Sunday, May 15, many on social media criticised the party over the choice of colours at the venue of the event.People alleged that the roof of the tent that hosted the meet was green and white — resembling the national flag of Pakistan, while the carpet on the floor was saffron. "Both colours of the Pakistan flag above and saffron on the floor! This is a picture of the Congress Party's Chintan Shivir in Udaipur, Rajasthan," one such tweet read.The India Today Anti Fake News War Room (AFWA) found the claim was misleading. The roof of the tent incorporated all three shades of the Indian national flag.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Texas school shooting followed by transphobic rumours about the shooter At least 19 children and two adults were killed in a shooting at an elementary school in Uvalde, Texas, in the United States on May 24. Following the school shooting, a photograph made the rounds on social media with the claim that the shooter was a transgender woman. In the photo, the person could be seen holding a transgender flag.advertisementArizona Republican congressman Paul Gosar also tweeted, “We know already fool. It’s a transsexual leftist illegal alien named Salvatore Ramos. It’s apparently your kind of trash.” He has since deleted the tweet.The archived version of the post can be seen here and here.The India Today Anti Fake News War Room (AFWA) found that the photo was not of the shooter. The person whose photo was shared as the shooter took to social media to clear her name.AFWA ProbeMany Twitter users claimed Gosar’s tweet was a lie. Others also claimed that photographs of a trans woman were falsely shared as those of the Texas school shooter. Tweets also carried screenshots of comments and posts the woman purportedly made on Reddit about how her photos were being misused.rightwingers including @DrPaulGosar have been spreading misinformation that the shooter in texas was a trans woman, using random photos they pulled from reddit. the person in the photos is currently posting on reddit in apparent horror that her photos were used in this way. pic.twitter.com/riDoQsmHM3 — Molly White (@molly0xFFF) May 25, 2022We searched for the woman’s Reddit account and found the photo that was circulated was shared by her in April 2022.The Reddit account contained links to her Instagram accounts. Both Reddit and Instagram bios identified her as a trans woman.Following the school shooting and the subsequent rumours, on both Reddit and Instagram, she stated that her photos were being misused and that she did not even live in Texas. In a Reddit comment, she wrote, “They are my pics. People are using to make trans people look like murderers and blaming me for the shooting.”When India Today reached out to her on Instagram, she confirmed the same. She also mentioned that she was an artist from the state of Georgia in the US.A photo of the suspected shooter obtained by ABC News from law enforcement officials can be seen below. The photo of the shooter and those of the trans woman are clearly not the same.What do we know about the shooter?According to law enforcement authorities, the alleged shooter, Salvador Ramos, was an 18-year-old student at Uvalde High School. The Associated Press reported that Ramos was shot and killed by a US Border Patrol official who was nearby when the shooting began. Per reports, before the school shooting, Ramos shot and wounded his grandmother and then fled the scene.Hours before the shooting, Ramos reportedly sent cryptic texts from an Instagram account that has since been deleted to another user, hinting at what he was about to do. The Instagram account also reportedly posted photos of guns and magazines. Texas State Senator Roland Gutierrez told reporters that Ramos, who turned 18 days ago, purchased two assault rifles on his 18th birthday.With the available information, it is clear that the photo of a trans woman shared across social media was not that of the Texas school shooter.(With inputs from Pathikrit Sanyal in New Delhi)
label: truth

content: Fact Check Video: This public Namaz photo is from Bangladesh, not Nainital Uttarakhand’s Nainital has always been a cherished destination for travellers. The hill station has witnessed an episode of communal tension recently. Amid this, a collage of two images that claim to compare the current scenario in Nainital with that 12 years ago has gone viral on social media.The collage is shared by many on Twitter and Facebook with captions like "Hindu families are brainwashed by 'hum do humare do'. This weakens the family system. Day by day, we are losing to them." Here, "them" refers to the Muslim community.India Today Anti Fake News War Room (AFWA) has found this collage to be misleading as the second image was not taken from Nainital.
