content: Claims suggesting Kurnool MLA Hafeez Khan forced nurse to wash Imam’s feet proven false Spread the truth:Several social media users have posted an image of a nurse that appears to be washing the feet of a man wearing a skull cap. Every person in the image can be seen wearing a face mask, except for the man in question. It is also being claimed that the man standing in the center of the image is MLA Hafeez Khan, who is forcing the nurse to wash the man’s feet, who users are claiming is a local Imam. Hafeez Khan is the current MLA from Kurnool district in Andhra Pradesh, and is a member of the YSR Congress. It is also being claimed that the said incident occurred in ‘Vishwa Bharti Medical College’.TWITTERSeveral twitter users have posted this image, along with varying claims and accusations.(Archive)FACEBOOKThe following post claims that the nurse in question is being made to beg for forgiveness by the Imam for ensuring that the attendees of the recent Tabligh Jamaat event in Delhi’s Nizamuddin are quarantined.(Archive)Another post that has since been deleted has also made similar claims.(Archive)The caption of the image, written in Telugu, can translated as the following in English:-“What is happening in the city of Kurnool in the state of Andhra Pradesh? The politics in the city is feeding the businessmen for profits and encouraging religious superstitions for votes. In the middle of these politics, the middle class is getting squeezed and is buying the required food and domestic materials from different people and paying extremely high prices. In a recent incident, an MLA from Kurnool made a nurse touch the feet of a religious head. But why did he do that and who gave him that authority? What wrong did she do to make him commit such an act? According to the recent ordinance brought about by the Central Government, the MLA can be subjected to a trial and the Kurnool politics is not letting it happen. What exactly is happening in Kurnool? The people of Kurnool are perplexed if the government of Andhra Pradesh is completely oblivious of the situation about politics in Kurnool or they do not want to address the issues at all.”TRUTHThe MLA in question, Mr Hafeez Khan took to Facebook to clarify the ‘fake news’. The following post was made on 23rd April, containing a video of the man in the skull cap, who according to these viral posts is a religious leader. The caption along with video reads, “Fake news alet/Fact news of the incident”. In the video, that man can be seen sitting while resting the foot that users were claiming was being washed by the nurse. The man looks visibly hurt, as a huge quantity of cotton has been applied to the ankle, while blood is dripping from the leg to the floor.(Archive)A Facebook post about the misinformation was also made by the Kurnool Police. According to the police, the man in the skull cap is a diabetic patient who had because of weak eye sight hit his foot with a gate and had started bleeding. At the time of the incident, he was at Rayaleseema University. The hostel there has been converted into a quarantine facility. When the bleeding didn’t stop, he was immediately shifted to the Government General Hospital in Kurnool by ambulance. They added that the nurse was just doing her job and tending to the patient. The post also warned users of spreading fake news as it could lead to “strict action” being taken against them.(Archive)A video was also made by the nurse in question, and has been posted on Mr. Khan’s Facebook page, where she has clarified what had happened in the incident. She has also claimed that she was just doing her job while attending to the hurt diabetic patient.(Archive)Several other videos can also be found on Mr. Khan’s official Facebook page where he is clarifying the misinformation regarding the incident in a press meeting.Thus, it can be proven that the claims being made with the viral image of a man wearing a skull cap have been found to be untrue. It is an image of a hurt man in a quarantine facility being attended to by a nurse while several people, including the Kurnool MLA Hafeez Khan are observing.Related
label: truth

content: Claim of TikTok banned in the US is false Spread the truth:Claim: “अमेरिका ने चीनी कम्पनी Tik, tok को बैन कर दिया है!भारत में भी बैन किया जाना चाहिए?Yes or No रिप्लाई जरूर कर के बताऐ?”Translation: “America has banned Chinese owned ‘TikTok’! It should be banned in India too? Reply in Yes Or No”.The post has gone viral on social media with the claims that The United States of America has banned TikTok and has been asking people in India whether it should be banned here.FACEBOOKThis particular post explains the social concerns of using TikTok, with an image saying that “America has banned Chinese app TikTok, and should India ban it as well?” The post is shared with over 5K shares, and 7.2K likes with most of them agreeing in the comment section.The post was shared widely,TWITTERMany people on Twitter asked the same question,अमेरिका ने चीनी कम्पनी Tik, tok को बैन कर दिया है! भारत में भी बैन किया जाना चाहिए? Yes or No रिप्लाई जरूर कर के बताऐ? — Pushpendra Kulshrestha (@iArmySupporter) April 6, 2020Archiveअमेरिका ने टिक टॉक को प्रतिबंधित किया !!भारत मेंTIK TOK को BAN करवाने के समर्थन में कौन-2 हैं ?? — सौर्य मिश्र (StayHome Staysafe)🇮🇳 (@BjpSauryaMishra) April 7, 2020The archive of the tweet can be found here.TruthTiktok, a Chinese owned app with over 1.5 billion downloads worldwide, is banned for United States Army soldiers, not entire country. The ban came in December 2019. The soldiers could not use the app on government-owned devices. The move was done amidst the worry that the Chinese owned app could comprise national security.“It is considered a cyber threat,” Army spokeswoman Lt. Col. Robin Ochoa told Military.com, which broke the news on December 30th, 2019. Both the Navy and Defense Department sounded alarms on TikTok in early December, 2019.The Navy previously told its members not to add the app, and to delete it from government-issued devices if it was already installed. The Defense Department also instructed employees to “be wary of applications you download, monitor your phones for unusual and unsolicited texts, etc., and delete them immediately and uninstall TikTok to circumvent any exposure of personal information,” according to military.comHence, the claim that the TikTok app has been banned completely in the United States of America is false. It is to be noted that the app is only banned for the US Army.Related

The captions along these viral images are calling this an act of Hindu terrorism.However, this is not a real scenario but a scene from an Indian movie called Parzania which was made in 2005 and is based on the Gujarat riots of 2002.TWITTERSeveral tweets with anti-RSS and anti-Hindu captions were surfacing on twitter. Most of them were tweeted by verified accounts leading to more widespread of the wrong image.This tweet has been archived here.One tweet retweeted the above tweet and added,“#India terrorist group #RSS must be declared as #Terrorists group just like the world did with #ISIS The producer is same has no religion or race. @UN”The tweet can be seen here and has been archived here.Khaled Beydoun, Law Professor and Author, tweeted the image with text “The RSS are terrorists. They’ve always been so. Now they control the government in # India “This tweet can be seen here and has been archived here.FACEBOOKFacebook pages against Hindu religion are using this image as profile picture also.Several websites also used this image to support their articles with an anti-Hindu narrative. Click here and here. These articles were posted in 2018 and 2015 respectively.TRUTHThis image is a still from 2005 movie Parzania which is based on 2002’s Gujarat riots which can also been seen on IMDb page for the film.There is also an article published in 2007 by The New York Times titled ‘Using Bollywood Ideas to Portray Today’s India’ which uses the same image with a caption that says ‘A scene from “Parzania,” one of the films playing in the “India Now” festival at the Museum of Modern Art’.Here is the link of the full film, Parzania from where the scene of a mob with saffron scarves is going viral.Thus, the image along with anti-RSS captions was misleading as it was a still from an Indian movie and not an actual scenario.

We remain in solidarity with our Afghan brethren at this time of global pandemic. — Spokesperson 🇵🇰 MoFA (@ForeignOfficePk) April 4, 2020Other eminent figures such as Danyal Gilani also tweeted the video of the Torkham border crossing.This is what happened when Torkhum was opened today 😱 pic.twitter.com/vAye7kHsOJ — Danyal Gilani (@DanyalGilani) April 7, 2020Related

content: A 6 year old photo of stamped rotis is viral as post Covid-19 lockdown meal to poor. Spread the truth:Photos from year 2014 of Indian bread ‘Roti’ with “Abki Bar Modi Sarkar” stamped on it is viral falsely complaining the government to be ashamed such publicity in such tough times i.e. Corona Pandemic.Claim: “क्या शर्म नहीं आनी चाहिए इस सरकार कोदूसरों को नसीहत दे रहे है, कि इस वक्त कोई राजनैतिक प्रचार प्रसार ना करें ।और इन लोग ने तो रोटी में ही राजनीति घोल दी।”Translation: “Shouldn’t the government be ashamed, they are advising other parties not to spread propaganda during these tough times, but they themselves dissolved politics and propaganda in these rotis.”Actress Kavita Kaushik retweeted a tweetSince PM Modi announced the lockdown, due to COVID-19 pandemic, the survival of the migrant labor became hard, some of them began their journey on foot to their homes, while some of them stayed where they are.A series of posts came up where it was claimed and implied that the Bhartiya Janata Party(BJP) served rotis to the poor with, “Ab ki Baar, Modi Sarkaar” stamped on it during the lockdown because of COVID-19.The image went viral on Facebook and Twitter several times, with the texts changing but with the same implication, where people claimed that the BJP was doing so for its party politics and popularity during the time of a pandemic.FacebookThe post read, “Branding the bread, जिस देश मे सरकार जनता के पैसे से जनता को दी हुई रोटी पर खुद की मोहर लगाकर दे रही हो ,उस देश का भविष्य अपने आप दिख जाता …”Translation: “Branding the bread, in the country where the government serves stamped food to the public, from the money given to them by public, it shows the country’s future.”The text changed in one of the post, it read,“भाजपा वाले गरीबों की रोटी पर भी अपने चुनावी प्रचार का ठप्पा लगा रहे हैं। यह ठप्पा मजदूरों की रोटी पर ही नहीं बल्कि मुल्क के गरीबों एवं मजदूरों के गाल पर तमांचा भी है। बहुत ही शर्मनाक कृत्य! – सूरज कुमार बौद्ध”Translation: “BJP people are offering their election propaganda on the bread of poor people. This slap is not only on the bread of the workers but also on the cheek of the poor and workers of the country. Very Shameful Act!– Suraj Kumar Buddhist.”The image was widely shared on Facebook:TwitterThe image and the post were also widely shared on Twitter, read,“भाइयो बहनो,तुम मेरे गिरने की बेहद सी हद तो देखो !हम भूखों की रोटी को भी प्रचार का साधन बना लेंगें!!”Translation: “Brothers and sisters, look at this limit of my fall, we publicize the poor’s food.”भाइयो बहनो,तुम मेरे गिरने की बेहद सी हद तो देखो !हम रोटी को भी प्रचार का साधन बना लेंगें !! pic.twitter.com/AilbKsR4gM — Jai Singh Bhadauria (@bhadauriajai786) April 2, 2020ArchiveTruthUpon looking at the image, we did a Google Reverse Image Search, we came across a video news report by NDTV, which was reported in 2014. The image made viral is a screenshot taken from the video.The video was shot as a news report in Varanasi by NDTV during the 2014 General Election. It is of Hotel Yadav, Varanasi, where these Rotis were made, according to the hotel owner the Rotis were becoming quite popular but soon they started receiving backlash from other political parties and people. The hotel was then forced to stop making the rotis with the stamp.Even though the image now that is going viral, does not mention any date or place but in the given scenario of the lockdown, it wrongly suggests that it is a recent work. Hence, the conclusion that is has been wrongly circulated to blame the BJP, to show that they are trying to spread propaganda by circulating an old image.Related
label: rumor

content: Did Sri Lanka release a stamp honouring the Kerala CM Pinarayi Vijayan? Spread the truth:A viral post doing the rounds on social media platforms like Facebook shows that the Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan has been featured in stamps used in Sri Lanka. The post is as follows :Translation : ” Dear Mr Pinarayi Vijayan, respectful wishes from the Sri Lankan government.The Sri Lankan government in a move to appreciate the efforts by the CM, has released a postal stamp in his honour. This is the first time the government of Sr Lanka has used an image of a Malaylee to be featured in their postal stamp. Our heartiest congratulations to the CM for making Kerala proud with your achievements.”FacebookWhatsAppTruthThis is a digitally edited image and is not true. The following observations can be made :The time stamp on the post shows that the postal stamp was issued back in 2017. Records (https://stamps.slpost.gov.lk/) show that no such stamp has been circulated in the country.The image also mentions the Ceylon Blue Magpie on the side of the stamp where the name of the supposed featured image is to be entered as per the template followed by Sri Lankan stamps.There is a noticeable font difference as well.On a closer look, it can be easily understood that the image has been edited onto the stamp.The official Facebook page of Anti Fake News, Division of Kerala has also released a statement stating that this viral post is fake.News organisations like Asianet’s fact checking division along with The Indian Express had debunked the same stating that the post was indeed an edit and is fake.Related
label: truth

content: Video Claiming Owner of Himalaya Drug Co. saying he is ‘Maalik’ of India is False Spread the truth:Claim: Recently a video went viral on social media, purportedly of the owner of the Himalayan Drug Co. Mohd Manal with the statement, ‘Owner of Himalaya Drug Co- He says he is not loyal to India, but he is the Maalik of India’.He is heard saying in Hindi, “We are Muslims first, then Indians. If any conflict arises, we will abide by Islam and not follow the constitution. We are masters of the country, not loyal. Loyalty is for dogs; we are masters of the country.”With India crossing the 6000 mark of the COVID-19 cases, and with the recent Tablighi Jamaat incident, social media has seen a furor and a lot of hate speech against the Muslim community.WhatsappTwitterThe video was also shared widely on Twitter.TRUTHThe video claims that the person in the video is not Mohammed Manal, owner of the Himalaya Drug Company.By closely looking at the video, the video is of Maviya Ali, who is a former Congress MLA, of the Deoband Constituency, Uttar Pradesh. In the 2017 UP Assembly elections, Ali represented the Samajwadi Party.To confirm that the claim is false, NewsMeter did a Google Reverse Image search with his name and relevant keywords, the search comes up with various news articles and videos.The news reports are from August 2017, when Maviya Ali gave the statement, fueling fire to the Uttar Pradesh Government’s circular to video record the Independence Day celebrations in the madrasas which he claimed to be Anti-Islamic.There is also a media video report by India Today to the statement given by Maviya Ali.A more detailed version of the video was uploaded on Facebook in January 2017, the video is approximately 2 min long. The text with the video –“देखो इस वीडियो को क्या बोल रहा है माविया अली अब भी आँख खोल लो भाइयो की हम मदरसों पर तिरंगा नही फरायेगे ओर वंदे मातरम नही बोलेगे ओर हम इस देश के वफादार नही है हम मालिक है इस देश के यो मालिक है क्या बातो भाइयो यो मालिक है क्या इस देश का।। यो जब तिरंगा नही फेरा सकता तो ये क्या इस देश का हो जाएगा।।”The same video had resurfaced in January 2020, during the Anti-CAA protests in India, wherein many posts mistook Ali as Congress leader Nasimuddhin Siddiqui who has no relation to the video, it was later debunked by Boom Live.Related

content: Fake viral Whats app message is being circulated about how you can cast your vote. Spread the truth:A message about voting is viral on Whats app with three claims.“👉 When you reach poling booth and find that your name is not in voter list, just show your Aadhar card or voter ID and ask for ” challenge vote” under section 49A and cast your vote.👉 If you find that someone has already cast your vote, then ask for “tender vote” and cast your vote.👉If any polling booth records more than 14% tender votes, repolling will be conducted in such poling booth.👉 Please share this very important message with maximum groups and friends as everyone should aware of their right to vote 👏👏“V IMP : 1/2 👉 When you reach poling booth and find that your name is not in voter list, just show your Aadhar card or voter ID and ask for " challenge vote" under section 49A and cast your vote.👉 If you find that someone has already cast your vote, then ask for "tender vote" — Brinda (@b4politics) April 4, 2019TruthElection Commission(EC) officials replied to SMHoaxslayer’s query on Twitter who claimed that claim 1 and claim 3 are false while claim 2 is true.Claim 1:“When you reach polling booth and find that your name is not in voter list, just show your Aadhar card or voter ID and ask for ” challenge vote” under section 49A and cast your vote.”Sanjoy Basu, spokesperson of Chief Electoral Office(CEO) West Bengal said “ In case of claim 1 where it was mentioned that a voter can cast their vote even if their name is not on the electoral poll by just showing Aadhar card or voter ID card and ask for a challenge vote under section 49-A is completely fake. A person cannot vote unless his name has been enrolled in the electoral roll.”According Election Commission’s handbook for presiding officers , it has been mentioned that the first presiding officer will establish the identity of the elector with the help of the electoral photo identity card issued by ERO.Below is the screenshot of EC’s handbook.Source : EC Handbook for Polling AgentsClaim2: “If you find that someone has already cast your vote, then ask for “tender vote” and cast your vote”.According to Basu , this claim is true . The EC’s handbook also mentions that the presiding officer has the authority to tell the voter to cast his vote in ballot paper if he/ she finds herself that his/her vote has been casted.Source : Election Commission handbook for Polling Agents .Here is the twitter link of Election Commission of India.Anyone whose name is not on the Voters' List can not vote.There is a provision in the Law for a voter to cast Tendered vote, if on reaching the polling station, s/he finds that somebody has already cast a vote in her/his name. https://t.co/SBDKcD3K21 — ECI #DeshKaMahaTyohar (@ECISVEEP) April 7, 2019Claim 3: “ If any polling booth records more than 14% tender votes, repolling will be conducted in such poling booth”Basu said “ There is no legal provision for a repoll if the polling booth records more than 14 percent tender votes. EC can ordered repoll if it notices serious breaches. Example: A repoll can be conducted in a booth if Election Commission(EC) finds out that there has been mass scale rigging and violence in the area by scrutinising all videos, images and taking information from concerned poll officials who were on duty.”SMHoaxSlayer also spoke with Sheyphali Sharan, official spokesperson of Election Commission of India(EC) who claimed that Claim1 and Claim 3 are absolutely fake and are being circulated to confused voters . We are aware of this fake Whatsapp message that has went viral and we will soon issue our official statement on this regard.”On 5 April , Dr SY Qureshi former Election Commissioner of India has tweeted his views regarding the wats ap message that went viral.Here is the twitter link of Dr SY Qureshi and below is the screen shot of the tweet.If your name is NOT in the voter list (for whatever reason), you cannot do anything. content: Pakistan flag waved in Kolkata under CM Mamta Banerjee ? Spread the truth:This image claims “Pakistan’s flag in Kolkata. This is the result of appeasement politics of Mamata Banerjee. The agitators have been demanding the release of 62 children, who were intercepted by Sealdah station GRP after they failed to produce any valid documents.On Sunday, Sealdah railway station GRP intercepted as many as 62 children and a cleric. The children were travelling from a madrasa in Purnia, Bihar to another madrasa in Satara, Maharashtra. Since they were travelling without documents, the GRP officials shifted them to the state-run Child Welfare Commission’s home in Barasat. Kolkata Police have been trying to contact the children’s parents to know more about the case.On the other hand, protestors staged a demonstration at Rajabazar, Park Circus seven-point crossing, Moulali and Sealdah. The situation turned grim by the end of the day as more and more agitators assembled demanding immediate release of the children.Agitators pelted stones at Sealdah station resulting in closure of the main gate for several hours. The railway tracks were also blocked by the protestors, because of which all south-bound trains from Sealdah station were held up. Several vehicles were vandalised across the city. Shops adjoining the Sealdah-Moulali area too were forced to close doors.Meanwhile, top officials of Kolkata Police have said that the children would be released and sent back to Bihar by Monday night itself, to avoid any untoward incident. “We are sending the children back to Bihar tonight itself. There are reports of certain sporadic incidents. We are in full control of the situation,” Rajeev Mishra, Special Additional and Joint Commissioner of Kolkata Police (Headquarters) told dna.Major thoroughfares remained clogged with thousands of demonstrators putting up road blocks, bringing the city to a grinding halt. Commuters faced trouble as major arterial roads of North and Central Kolkata remained blocked since Monday afternoon.Related

content: Did lady recently strip in Gorakhpur as protest under CM Yogi Gov ? Spread the truth:An article is published on website muslimworld.in claiming a lady protested in Gorakhpur by stripping down to her underwear against teasing by goons under Yogiraj i.e. Governance of CM Yogi Adityanath.Although the image is genuine, unfortunate event did happen but rest all is false.No, lady didn’t strip in Gorakhpur, nor recently and certainly not under Yogiraj.This happened a decade back, year 2007, in Rajkot.Pooja chauhan chose this method of protest against police inaction, by stripping out of frustration as Police was not paying heed to her complains, how she was being beaten and abused by her husband and in-laws for dowry and not bearing child.And then protest did bear fruits, as Police immediately arrested her husband.RAJKOT: Conservative Rajkot went into convulsions on Wednesday when alleged mental and physical abuse by her husband’s family drove a 22-year-old woman to strip to her underwear and walk through the city in protest.Pooja Chauhan said she had taken to this unique protest after being constantly harassed for not bringing dowry and bearing a girl-child.The effect was immediate. The police arrested her husband Pratapsinh Chauhan, parents-in-law and neighbours Veji Bharwad and Vinu Dalit on Wednesday, after she threatened to scale up her protest and march nude to the police commissioner’s office if she did not get justice.“The arrests were made on the basis of Pooja Chauhan’s complaint. We are also planning to take action against Pooja for indecent behaviour in a public place. However, we will examine her mental condition before taking any action,” said Rajkot police commissioner K Nityanandam.Residents in the busy thoroughfares of Race Course Road and Yagnik Road were left gaping in shock on Tuesday evening as Pooja walked in her inner-wear, wielding a baseball bat and bangles, headed for the police commissioner’s office.She walked for about an hour and went home later as the police commissioner was out of station.Police sources said Pooja had a love marriage with Pratapsinh, a resident of Gandhigram area, about three years ago, but her in-laws kept harassing her for dowry. The harassment increased when she gave birth to a daughter eight months ago. She finally left home five months ago and has been living on her own with her daughter, Anjali.Sources said police inaction on her complaints had driven her to stage such a protest. “When her complaint against her in-laws failed to evoke any response, she tried to immolate herself at the office of the police commissioner last Friday but police personnel stopped her,” said a source in the commissionerate. मुख्यालय में घुसकर कार्रवाई की थी, तब कुछ पुलिस वाले बिना बिना नेमप्लेट वाली वर्दी पहने नज़र आए थे.कांग्रेस नेता सौरभ चौधरी ने वायरल कोलाज ट्वीट कर लिखा, (आर्काइव)दिल्ली पुलिस ने बीच में RSS के गुंडे घुसा कर कांग्रेस दफ्तर पर हमला किया है. ये बिना नेम प्लेट वाले पुलिस की वर्दी में घुसकर कौन हमला कर रहे हैं. सबका हिसाब होगा, वक्त का इंतजार हैं. नकली पुलिस भेज कर भाजपा सरकार ने हमला करवाया. भाजपा ट्विटर यूज़र हिम्मत सिंह गुर्जर ने वायरल कोलाज के साथ लिखा,सावधान सतर्क रहें. अब संघी पुलिस वर्दी पहनकर आपके आंदोलन को कुचलने आ सकते है, किसान आंदोलन में भी पुलिस वर्दी में संघी गुंडे भेजे थे. दिल्ली में कांग्रेस के विरोध प्रदर्शन को रोकने इसी तरह आये पुलिस यूनिफॉर्म में कौन हैं ये लोग ?अगर वे पुलिसकर्मी है, तो नेमप्लेट और बैज कहां हैं ?हिम्मत सिंह गुर्जर के ट्वीट का स्क्रीनशॉट.अब बात उस ट्वीट की जहां से इस कोलाज को सबसे ज्यादा रीच मिली. कांग्रेस की नेशनल कोऑर्डिनेटर रितु चौधरी ने 15 जून 2022 को रात 10 बजकर 4 मिनट पर ट्वीट किया था और पड़ताल लिखे जाने तक इस ट्वीट 19 हजार लाइक्स और 8 हजार से ज्यादा रीट्वीट्स मिल चुके हैं. हालांकि रितु ने अपने ट्वीट में दिल्ली पुलिस और कांग्रेस मुख्यालय जैसे शब्दों का इस्तेमाल नहीं किया है. (@TakeTheJab) June 15, 2022 तस्वीर के बारे में ज्यादा जानकारी के लिए हमने केरल पुलिस में जनसंपर्क प्रमुख वी पी प्रमोद कुमार से बात की. उन्होंने बताया,'तस्वीरें केरल पुलिस से जुड़ी हुई हैं. वर्दी में कंधे की आस्तीन के प्रतीक चिन्ह को देखकर इस बात की पुष्टि की जा सकती है. हालांकि यह बता पाना मुश्किल है कि ये तस्वीर केरल में किस जगह की है. बीते एक सप्ताह में केरल में कई जगह विरोध-प्रदर्शन हुए हैं, संभवत: ये तस्वीर उसी दौरान खींची गई है.'सर्च से हमें फेसबुक पर कुछ ऐसे पोस्ट भी मिले जिनमें साल 2018 में सबरीमाला विवाद के दौरान केरल पुलिस को बिना नेमप्लेट के देखा जा सकता है.फेसबुक पोस्ट का स्क्रीनशॉट.नतीजाहमारी पड़ताल में वायरल कोलाज के साथ किया जा रहा दावा गलत साबित हुआ. वायरल कोलाज में मौजूद तस्वीरों का दिल्ली पुलिस से नहीं बल्कि केरल पुलिस से है. खुद केरल पुलिस के जनसंपर्क विभाग ने वायरल तस्वीरों को केरल पुलिस से जुड़ा हुआ बताया है.  AdvertisementAdvertisement()

Advertisementवायरल दावे का स्क्रीनशॉटअंशुल सिंह9 जून 2022  (Updated: 10 जून 2022, 06:29 PM IST)SmallMediumLargeSmallMediumLargeदावामोईन अली (Moeen Ali). इंग्लैंड के ऑलराउंडर और IPL में चेन्नई सुपर किंग्स के लिए खेलने वाले खिलाड़ी. सोशल मीडिया पर मोईन अली से जोड़कर एक ट्वीट जमकर वायरल हो रहा है. इस ट्वीट को कई यूज़र्स मोईन की भारत को धमकी बताकर शेयर कर रहे हैं. ट्वीट के साथ एक तस्वीर भी है जिस पर लिखा है- आइ लव पैगंबर मोहम्मद.ट्वीट का कैप्शन अंग्रेजी में है, जिसका हिंदी अनुवाद है-अगर भारत अपने ईशनिंदा वाले बयान के लिए माफी नहीं मांगता है तो मैं फिर कभी मैच खेलने के लिए भारत नहीं जाऊंगा. मैं  IPL का भी बहिष्कार करूंगा और मैं अपने साथी मुस्लिम भाइयों से भी ऐसा करने की अपील करूंगा.वायरल ट्वीट का स्क्रीनशॉट.कुछ सोशल मीडिया यूज़र्स ने मोईन अली की फोटो के साथ वायरल ट्वीट वाला बयान लिख एक ग्राफिक्स कार्ड को भी शेयर कर रहे हैं.इंग्लैंड क्रिकेट टीम के क्रिकेटर मोइन अली ने कहा है अगर भारत हजरत मुहम्मद स.अ.व. पर बोले गए अपशब्द पर माफी नहीं मांगता तो वो कभी भी भारत में क्रिकेट नहीं खेलेंगे और अपने साथी खिलाड़ियों से भी ये करने को कहा है pic.twitter.com/M4Tbc9JH8J— Hasim Khan (@hasimbhai) June 8, 2022 अब इस ट्वीट को लेकर सोशल मीडिया पर अलग-अलग तरह की प्रतिक्रियाएं देखने को मिल रही हैं.पड़तालआखिर इस ट्वीट का सच क्या है? अगर ये ट्वीट मोईन अली ने किया है तो उन्हें इस तरह का ट्वीट करने की जरूरत क्यों पड़ी?  इन तरह के सभी सवालों का जवाब मानने के लिए 'दी लल्लनटॉप' ने पड़ताल की.सबसे पहले हमने वायरल ट्वीट को गौर से देखा. ट्वीट जिस अकाउंट से किया गया उसकी प्रोफाइल में मोईन अली की तस्वीर है और ट्विटर हैंडल है @Moeen_Ali18. इसके बाद इस यूज़रनेम से जब हमने ट्विटर पर सर्च किया तो जो अकाउंट हमें मिला वो सस्पेंड हो चुका है.                                                                                             सर्च से हमें archive.today पर इस अकाउंट से जुड़े हुए आर्काइव मिले. अकाउंट के बायो में स्पष्ट रूप से लिखा है - NotOfficial. ये अकाउंट ट्विटर पर May 2022 को अस्तित्व में आया था.                                                                                 इसके बाद हमने वायरल हो रहे बयान से जुड़ीं मीडिया रिपोर्ट्स को इंटरनेट पर खोजा. सर्च से हमें एक भी ऐसी विश्वसनीय रिपोर्ट नहीं मिली जो वायरल ट्वीट के सच होने की पुष्टि करती हो. मोईन एक अंतर्राष्ट्रीय क्रिकेटर हैं और भारत समेत पूरी दुनिया में अपने खेल के लिए जाने जाते हैं. अगर ऐसा कुछ होता तो मीडिया में खबरें जरूर छपतीं.इसके अलावा हमें मोईन अली से जुड़ा कोई भी आधिकारिक ट्विटर अकाउंट नहीं मिला. इंग्लैंड क्रिकेट बोर्ड की वेबसाइट पर मोईन अली की प्रोफाइल पर एक ट्विटर अकाउंट का लिंक है. लेकिन इस अकाउंट पर न तो कोई ट्वीट है, न ही वेरिफाइड है और न ही कोई प्रोफाइल पिक्चर है.                                                                                    29 जुलाई 2020 को ब्रिटिश मीडिया संस्थान The Guardian को दिए इंटरव्यू में मोईन अली ने बताया था कि वो कुछ समय पहले पूरी तरह से सोशल मीडिया छोड़ चुके हैं. The Guardian में Moeen Ali का इंटरव्यू.हमने मोईन अली के ट्विटर अकाउंट को लेकर इंग्लैंड क्रिकेट बोर्ड से ई-मेल के जरिए संपर्क किया है. जैसे ही हमें ECB की तरफ से कोई जवाब मिलता है उसे स्टोरी में अपडेट कर दिया जाएगा.नतीजाकुल मिलाकर हमारी पड़ताल में वायरल दावा गलत साबित हुआ. जिस ट्वीट को आधार बनाकर मोईन अली द्वारा ईशनिंदा पर भारत के बॉयकॉट करने की बात की जा रही है वो ट्वीट मोईन अली ने नहीं किया है. साथ ही ट्विटर अकाउंट @Moeen_Ali18 से मोईन अली का कोई लेना-देना नहीं है.वीडियो: शाहरुख खान को अमेरिका के एयरपोर्ट पर रोकने का दावा वायरलAdvertisementAdvertisement()

content: गर्मियों में गाड़ी का टैंक फुल कराने से हो सकता है विस्फोट? वायरल दावे का सच जानिए गर्मियों में गाड़ी का टैंक फुल कराने से हो सकता है विस्फोट? वायरल दावे का सच जानिएइंडियन ऑयल से जुड़ा वायरल दावाभारत में पेट्रोल-डीज़ल की कीमतें लगातार बढ़ रही हैं. ऐसे में आम आदमी पेट्रोल-डीज़ल से चलने वाले वाहनों के बजाय इलेक्ट्रिक स्कूटर्स और इलेक्ट्रिक कारों में भी दिलचस्पी दिखा रहा है. बीते दिनों नासिक में Jitendra EV के 20 इलेक्ट्रिक स्कूटरों में लगी आग इलेक्ट्रिक वाहनों की सुरक्षा पर सवाल उठा रही है. इससे पहले भी Ola S1 जैसे ई-स्कूटर्स के आग पकड़ने की ख़बर आई थी. अब सोशल मीडिया पर पेट्रोल-डीज़ल से चलने वाली गाड़ियों से जुड़ा एक दावा वायरल हो रहा है.वायरल दावे में इंडियन ऑयल के लोगो के साथ एक चेतावनी शेयर हो रही है. दावा है कि,चेतावनी भरे मैसेज में लिखा है -गाड़ी की टंकी फुल कराने से जुड़ा वायरल दावा.वायरल दावा.कई और सोशल मीडिया यूज़र्स ने ऐसे ही दावे शेयर किए.वायरल दावा‘दी लल्लनटॉप’ ने वायरल दावे की पड़ताल की. हमारी पड़ताल में वायरल दावा गलत निकला. इंडियन ऑयल ने गाड़ी में पेट्रोल-डीज़ल का टैंक फुल न कराने के लिए कोई चेतावनी नहीं जारी की है.वायरल दावे की पड़ताल के लिए हमने दावे से जुड़े कीवर्ड्स से सर्च किया तो हमें इंडियन ऑयल के आधिकारिक फेसबुक एकाउंट से 9 अप्रैल, 2022 को किया गया एक पोस्ट मिला. content: Fact Check: The Man On The Ground Is NOT The Afghan... A picture of a few people is doing the rounds on social media, where one of them can be seen squatting on the ground. It has been claimed that the man on the ground is Sirajuddin Haqqani, Home Minister of Afghanistan, serving his people.The caption with the picture in Hindi reads: “ये ज़मीन पर बैठा शख़्स, #अफ़ग़ानिस्तान के गृहमंत्री सिराजुद्दीन हक़्कानी हैं, यहां पॉवर का मतलब कुर्सी नही बल्कि इंसानियत के लिए इंसाफ करना है। काश ऐसा अपने नेता/मंत्रीगण समझ पाते।” (English translation: This person sitting on the ground is Afghanistan’s Home Minister Sirajuddin Haqqani. Here power does not mean chair but justice for humanity. I wish our leaders/ministers could understand this.)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above image, and found the claim attached to it was false.On putting the picture through the Google Reverse Image Search, we found the same picture on Nitter, dated February 9, 2022. According to the caption in Urdu, the man in the picture is governor of Helmand province in Afghanistan, who was interacting with the civilians during a patrol.The caption in English translation reads as: “The governor of Faghan, Helmand province, shakes hands with a civilian during a patrol, while others issue orders on the spot. It is the blessing of the Islamic system that ideal peace has been established in Afghanistan and the nation is moving towards economic, political and social development”On digging further, we found the same picture in a tweet, dated November 29, 2021, by the official Twitter handle of the Department of Borders and Tribal Affairs of Helmand province. In the series of tweets, the concerned Department stated that the man in the picture was Governor of Helmand province, Maulvi Abdul Ahad, during his visit to the southern districts.وویل چې ستاسو جهاد، قربانۍ او خدمتونه د هېرېدلو نه دي، موږ به تل ستاسو منندوی او شکر ګذاره یو، تاسو په ډېرو سختو حالاتو کې زموږ سره همکاري کړې ده. او موږ مو یوازي نه یو پرې ایښي. نوموړي د خپل خوا هم د هر راز همکارۍ ډاډ ورکړ. pic.twitter.com/ZYAaaFplPX — دهلمند ولایت دسرحدونو او قبایلو چارو ریاست (@Helmand_BTA) November 29, 2021Hence, it is clear that the man in the picture is NOT Afghanistan Home Minister Sirajuddin Haqqani, but Helmand province Governor Maulvi Abdul Ahad.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Video Of People Moving In Neck-deep Water Falsley Linked... The unprecedented rainfall has led to severe flooding and waterlogging in several parts of Assam, affecting over 4.5 million people. Against this backdrop, a video showing people movement in neck-deep water is being shared on social media, linking it to the present Assam floods.The video is shared with a Bengali caption: “এই নদী তই ভাঙিলি আমাৰ ঘৰ…. তোৰ পাৰতে থাকিব আহোতে কৰিলি আমাক পৰ #TnlNews #News #Assam” (English translation: River you destroyed our house. When I came to stay beside you, you made us go away #TnlNews #News #Assam)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile did the fact-check, and found it to be misleading.On breaking the video into multiple keyframes and doing a Google Reverse Image Search, we found the same video — published in Arabic.EuroNews on September 5, 2019 — with the title: “The hell of the Rohingya Muslims: 125,000 people flee amid official negligence and UN concern”The Voice of America also shared the video on its YouTube channel on September 5, 2017, with a description: “The UN estimates that over 120,000 minority Rohingya refugees have crossed the border from Myanmar’s northern Rakhine state into Bangladesh in the last two weeks. Myanmar’s de-facto leader Aung San Suu Kyi says there has been “a huge iceberg of misinformation” about the violence in her country’s Rakhine state. Ankara is pressing Bangladesh to give sanctuary to all Rohingya Muslims fleeing Myanmar. Turkish Foreign Minister Mevlüt Çavuşoğlu is to fly to Dhaka on Wednesday for talks”Hence, we can ascertain that an old video is widely shared with a misleading claim.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Video of Rahul Gandhi Falsely Linked to Protest Against... A video clip of Congress leader Rahul Gandhi is being shared on social media with a claim that the protest, which took place following the announcement of the Agnipath scheme, was planned by the Congress.The post reads:“#RahulGandhi #creator #Voilance of #Agnipath#वीर# Armylovers# stopvoilance”The text embedded in the video reads: ” पहले से प्लान था कांग्रेसका और विपक्षी जितने भी पार्टी सबका #अग्निपथयोजना India has, indeed, been set on fire.” (English translation: Congress and all the opposition parties had planned this beforehand #AgneepathScheme)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the video, and found it to be fake.We noticed that the video had a date and location tag: May 15, 2022, Udaipur, Rajasthan.Based on this, we ran a keyword search and found the original video on the official YouTube channel of Indian National Congress. The video was uploaded on May 15, 2022, with the title: “Shri Rahul Gandhi’s valedictory address at the ‘Nav Sankalp Chintan Shivir’, Udaipur.”In the original video, the viral clip can be heard at 32:22 minutes. He can be heard saying: “Our fight is for ideology. It’s not an easy fight and this is not even a political fight. This is a fight for the future of the country and a fight to save the country. And you will see, now this fight has started. In the coming time, you will see, there will be a fire in India. I spoke of COVID-19, remember. I’m telling you the more they destroy institutions, the more they suppress conversations between our states, between religions, and between castes, and the more the fire will be. And the job of the Congress party is to restart these conversations. Our job is to protect this institution.”From the above information, it is clear that Rahul Gandhi was not talking about the Agnipath scheme, which was approved by Central government on June 14, 2022.Hence, it can be concluded that the post is misleading.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Image Of 2015 Post-Glastonbury Music Fest Erroneously Linked With... An image of a ground — littered with what seems like plastic bottles and bags — is being shared on social media with a claim that it is the Pyramid stage at Glastonbury after the speech of Swedish climate activist Greta Thunberg.Thunberg made a surprise appearance at the Glastonbury festival and delivered a speech on June 25, 2022.The image is being shared with the caption: “The Pyramid stage at Glastonbury following Greta Thunberg’s environmental speech”.Here’s the link to the above post. Similar posts were shared extensively on Facebook.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the post, and found the image to be an old one.We put the image through a Reverse Image Search and found the same image in a 2015 report by Daily Mail.The caption of the image reads: “Abandoned: After more than 100,000 people packed in to watch Lionel Richie perform last night, the Pyramid Stage cuts a lonely figure.” The image was credited to David Hedges and SWNS.On digging further, we found a blog post on Fujifilm from 2015 with the title: “Press photographer & Canon user David Hedges shoots Glastonbury with the Fujifilm X-T1” The blog post had a similar picture with the caption: “Revellers begin to head home through a sea of rubbish near the Pyramid Stage as Glastonbury Festival comes to an end at Worthy Farm, Somerset. June 29 2015.”Moreover, press photographer David Hedges confirmed to Reuters that he could not have captured the image after this year’s event, because he was not in the country at the time. Thus, it is clear that the image is not from 2022. content: Fact Check: Viral Clip Does Not Show Tunnel on Mumbai-Goa Highway;... A video with people cheering and entering a tunnel is being shared on social media with a claim that it shows a newly-opened Kashedi tunnel on the Mumbai-Goa highway.The video is shared with a Marathi caption: “कोकण कशेडी घाट बायपास 👆👆👆कोकणातील सर्वात मोठा भोगदा😍😍माननिय श्री नितीन गडकरी – रोड, ट्रान्सपोर्ट – हायवे, केंद्रीय मंत्री यांच्या प्रयत्नाने.” (English translation: Konkan Kashedi Ghat bypass is the largest project in Konkan, thanks to the efforts of Hon’ble Shri Nitin Gadkari, Union Minister of Road, Transport and Highways)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the post, and found it to be false.We extracted the keyframes of the video and put them through a Reverse Image Search. We found similar videos of the same tunnel uploaded by multiple YouTube channels in 2021. The videos can be seen here, here and here.As per the video, it is the Kuthiran tunnel in Kerala. We also found a video report by The News Minute, dated August 6, 2021, with the title: “Kerala’s Kuthiran tunnel road on Thrissur-Palakkad NH open for traffic”.The description of the video reads: “The 1.6 km-long tunnel is the first road tunnel in Kerala, and it will also reduce the travel time between Coimbatore and Kochi.”On searching further, we found similar visuals shared by Union Minister Gadkari on July 31, 2021, with the caption: “We will open one side of the Kuthiran tunnel in Kerala today. This is the first road tunnel in the state and will drastically improve connectivity to Tamil Nadu and Karnataka. The 1.6 km-long tunnel is designed through Peechi-Vazahani Wildlife sanctuary.”Hence, it is clear that the video of the Kuthiran tunnel in Kerala is being shared with a false claim.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Video of A Swept-away Bike Is Falsely Linked To... content: Fact Check: This Video Clip On ‘FASTag Scam’ Is NOT True FASTag is an electronic toll collection system, which employs radio frequency identification technology for making toll payments directly from the prepaid or savings account linked to it or directly to the toll owner. The system is operated by the National Highway Authority of India.In the above context, a video is widely being shared on social media, in which a trickster poses as a person cleaning cars and scans FASTag wallets. The video is widely circulated with the claim that FASTag wallets can be scanned and tricksters can steal money.The video is shared with a caption: “#Fastag #scam वाला #viral_video”The link to the post can be seen here.FACT CHECKNewsMobile did the fact-check, and found it to be fake.Searching through the functioning of a FASTag, we found that around 75% of toll collected on National highways comes via FASTags. As a result, any vehicle without a FASTag or with an invalid FASTag, entering into the specified lane, would be liable to pay two times the fee applicable to the category. The fine has been laid down in the NH Fee Rules, 2008.The system was introduced in 2014, and the RFID-based FASTags were affixed on vehicle windscreens to enable tolls to be debited from a linked account, without any stoppage of the vehicles for transaction.We also found that NETC’s website mentioned, “NETC FASTag is an RFID passive tag used for making toll payments directly from the customers linked to prepaid or savings/current account.”The video in question was first uploaded by a Facebook page, Baklol Video and was later deleted.FASTag_NETC in a reply had also tweeted: “Hi, NETC FASTag transaction can only be initiated by the registered merchants (Toll & Parking Plaza operators) which are onboarded by NPCI only from the respective geo-locations. No unauthorised device can initiate any financial transactions on NETC FASTag. It is absolutely safe.”Further, Paytm had also tweeted refuting the viral claim. The tweet reads: “A video is spreading misinformation about Paytm FASTag that incorrectly shows a smartwatch scanning FASTag. As per NETC guidelines, FASTag payments can be initiated only by authorised merchants, onboarded after multiple rounds of testing. Paytm FASTag is completely safe & secure.”Hence, we can ascertain that the viral claim is fake.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: 2017 Video Of Nirahua Campaigning For SP Viral As... A video is being shared on social media where Dinesh Lal Yadav ‘Nirahua’ can be seen campaigning for the Samajwadi Party. The video is being shared in context with the recent by-polls for Rampur and Azamgarh Lok Sabha seats in Uttar Pradesh. Dinesh Lal Yadav ‘Nirahua’ was BJP’s candidate for Azamgarh seat by-polls.The caption in the post claims that Nirahua was campaigning for Samajwadi Party recently.The caption in Hindi read: “आदरणीय धर्मेंद्र यादव जी के सम्मान में निरहुआ और अमरपाली दुबे ने आजमगढ़ में साइकिल पर वोट देने की जनता से अपील करते हुए कहा की साइकिल का बटन दबाइए और धर्मेंद्र जी को विजई बनाइए। अखिलेश यादव जिंदाबाद धर्मेंद्र यादव जिंदाबाद धर्मेंद्र सोलंकी जिंदाबाद”(English Translation: In the honor of respected Dharmendra Yadav ji, Nirhua and Amarpali Dubey appealed to the people to vote on cycles in Azamgarh and make Dharmendra ji victorious. Akhilesh Yadav Zindabad Dharmendra Yadav Zindabad Dharmendra Solanki Zindabad)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the post and found the video to be old.We ran a keyword search and found a similar video of ‘Nirahua’ campaigning. The video was uploaded on YouTube in November 2017. As per the title, the video was taken during a road show in Saidpur, Uttar Pradesh.On searching further, we found the same viral video on YouTube that was uploaded on November 26, 2017. The title read, “Dinesh Lal Yadav and Amrapali ji SP campaign in Saidpur.”This proves that the video in circulation is from 2017.Moreover, we also found that Dinesh Lal Yadav ‘Nirahua’ joined the Bharatiya Janta Party (BJP) ahead of the 2019 Lok Sabha election. In the 2019 Lok Sabha elections, he contested against Akhilesh Yadav in Azamgarh and lost.On June 26, 2022, BJP candidate Dinesh Lal Yadav ‘Nirahua’ won the Lok Sabha by-election from Azamgarh. He defeated Dharmendra Yadav of SP by over 8000 votes. The by-polls were necessitated due to Akhilesh Yadav resigning from the seat after was elected to the Assembly during the Uttar Pradesh assembly election in 2022.Hence, from the above information, it is clear that the video is old and is being shared with misleading claims.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Old Video Of Tripura Protest Falsely Linked To ‘Agnipath’... A video showing a man warning authorities and later being taken away by the police is circulating on social media. The video is being linked to the protest against ‘Agnipath’ scheme.The caption of the read, “अग्निवीर जो असल अग्निवीरों के हत्थे चढ़ गया…”(English Translation: Agniveer who was caught by real Agniveers…)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the post and found the video to be old.We extracted keyframes of the video and put them through a Reverse Image Search. The search led to the longer version of the video. The original video was uploaded by the YouTube channel TRIPURAINFOWAY TIWN on August 3, 2021. The title of the video read, “Education Minister Ratan Lal Nath’s residence was gheraoed by Students.”The video description read: “Education Minister Ratan Lal Nath’s residence was gheraoed by Madhyamik candidates who could not pass in Board Exams. They have alleged scams and partiality with students. TIWN Video Aug 3, 2021″On searching further, we found another video on the same channel, where he can be seen being taken away by the police. The video was shared with the title, “Tripura Board Exam Results: Forceful arrests of Students in Agartala.”Thus, from the above information, it is clear that an old video of a protest from Tripura is being shared with a false claim.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

The same video was also uploaded on YouTube, dated June 23, 2022, with the title: “Heavy rain in Karachi — Motorcycles slip in Johar Mor bridge due to heavy rain – Global TV”We ran another search and found a report on the same by Pakistan’s Geo TV, dated June 23, 2022, with a headline: “WATCH: Multiple motorcyclists fall on slippery Karachi roads amid rain”The video was taken at a flyover on Rashid Minhas Road near Millennium Mall in Karachi, according to the report. The description of the video reads: ” Meet 10-year-old climate activist Licypriya Kangujam from Manipur. Her one tweet forced the Agra authorities to clean the garbage around Taj Mahal. Standing with a placard, Licypriya had highlighted the trash behind the Taj Mahal”India Today had also uploaded a video on June 26, 2022, with a description: “After climate activist from Manipur Licipriya Kangujam shared a photograph showing plastic pollution near Taj Mahal, Agra officials took this step”Licipriya Kangujam had also quote tweeted Samajwadi Party’s social media coordinator Manish Jagan Agrawal, refuting the claim that she is a foreigner. The Tweet reads: “Hello Sir, I’m a proud Indian. I’m not a foreigner”Hence, we can ascertain that the viral claim is misleading.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

The video was shared with a caption that read, “Shri Narendra Modi addressing a massive Rally in Baghpat, Uttar Pradesh.”Hence, we can ascertain that the viral video is old and is being shared with misleading claims.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: No, The Viral Image Does NOT Show Aftermath Of... Afghanistan was rocked by a strong earthquake on June 22 reducing hundreds of homes to rubble. The maximum devastation occurred in the remote, mountainous area of eastern Afghanistan, killing over 1,000 people, leaving over 1,500 wounded.In this backdrop, an image of a broken road has gone viral on social media with a claim that it shows the aftermath of the quake.The Facebook caption read, “Afghanistan me 6.1 zalzale ki shiddat se 1000 se ziyada logaun ki jaan gayi or 1500 se ziyada log zakhmi hain. Kacche makaan zameen doszz hogaye or sadkau’n per draade’n….pad gayi..”(English Translation: 6.1 magnitude earthquake in Afghanistan has killed more than 1000 people and 1500 people are injured. Houses and lands are gone and roads have fallen.)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile did a fact-check and found the post to be misleading.On doing a Google Reverse Image Search, we found that the same image was uploaded by LiveMint on September 25, 2019. The image was shared with a caption that read, “Shortly after the tremor hit, Pakistan’s military dispatched troops and medical teams to the quake-affected area to assist civilian authorities in helping victims (Photo: PTI).”We also found the same image was published by NDTV on September 25, 2019. The title of the article read, “37 Dead, Nearly 500 Injured In Earthquake In Pak-Occupied Kashmir, Pak.” According to the article, an earthquake shook Pakistan occupied Kashmir and other places in Pakistan killing around 37 people.Hence, we can say that an old image of an earthquake that rocked Pakistan Occupied Kashmir has gone viral by falsely linking it to the recent quake in in Afghanistan.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Mock Drill Video Goes Viral As Terrorist Being Nabbed... A video has surfaced on the internet, which is shot from inside a metro train. The video shows armed personnel nabbing a man. It claims that security forces are nabbing a terrorist at a metro station in Faridabad.The caption in Hindi reads: “फरीदाबाद में एक आतंकी गिरफ्तार फरीदाबाद मेट्रो स्टेशन” (English translation: A terrorist arrested in Faridabad, Faridabad Metro Station)The above post can be seen here.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above post, and found it to be misleading.We initiated our probe with a keyword search on Google, but we did not find any reliable report of a terrorist being arrested. The Reverse Image Search with keyframes also did not lead us to any substantial evidence.NewsMobile then contacted Faridabad Police’s Sube Singh, who confirmed that the video in question was being shared with a misleading claim. In fact, it was a mock drill which was conducted at the Faridabad Metro Station.On June 26, 2022, in a tweet, Faridabad Police also rubbished the claims of a terrorist being arrested.So, in conclusion, it is proved that the claim attached to the video in question is FAKE.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Video of Crocodile On Vadodara Street Flasely Linked To... Unprecedented rainfall has led to severe flooding and waterlogging in several parts of Assam, affecting over 4.5 million people. Against this backdrop, a video is being shared on social media showing some people as controlling a crocodile on a submerged road in a residential area, and claiming that it is from Assam.The caption reads: “ অসমৰ বানপানীত এইবাৰ ঘৰিয়ালো (কুম্ভীর) ওলাইছে… Assam Floods#Copy” (English translation: In Assam flood this time Ghiyalo (crocodile) has come out. Assam Floods #Copy)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above post, and found it to be misleading.With the help of the InVID tool, we extracted the keyframes. On putting the keyframe through the Google Reverse Image Search, we found the same video on YouTube, uploaded by DeshGujaratHD, on August 31, 2019, claiming that a stray crocodile was captured during the Vadodara flood.Further, with the help of the keyword ‘crocodile found Vadodara’ on YouTube, we found another video by NDTV, on August 3, 2019, claiming that a crocodile was rescued from the flooded streets in Gujarat.Another news report was uploaded by TOI, dated August 4, 2019, claiming that the terror of crocodiles continued in Vadodara due to waterlogging.On digging further, we also found a news article in Deccan Chronicle, dated August 2, 2019, claiming that crocodiles were found hunting dogs in flooded Vadodara.Earlier, NewsMobile debunked the same claim when it was being shared in the name of Bihar, Hyderabad and Pakistan.Hence, the video of a stray crocodile found in the floodwater is from Vadodara in Gujarat, and NOT from Assam.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Old Video of Mamata Banerjee Protesting Over Fuel Prices... A video of West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee driving a scooter is being widely shared on social media. Sharing this video, users claim that the entire road was closed to teach the Bengal CM how to drive a scooter and the entire administration was helping her.The video is shared on Facebook with a Hindi caption: “ममता बनर्जी को स्कूटी सिखाने के लिए पूरी सड़क बंद कर दी और पूरा शासन स्कूटी सिखाने में लगा है ऐसे ही नेताओ ने देश को बर्बाद किया है” (English translation: The whole road was closed to teach Mamata Banerjee how to ride a scooter and the whole administration is busy in teaching her. Such leaders have ruined the country.)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above claim, and found it to be MISLEADING.Using the InVid Tool, we extracted keyframes from the viral video and performed a Reverse Image Search. This search directed us to a news report, published by The Economic Times on February 25, 2021, that carried similar visuals of Banerjee driving a scooter. The article headline reads: “Watch: Mamata Banerjee nearly falls while driving an electric scooter to protest fuel price hike”The video was also uploaded by ANI on February 25, 2021, with the caption: “West Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee nearly falls while driving an electric scooter in Howrah, as a mark of protest against the fuel price hike. She quickly regained her balance with support and continued to drive. She is travelling to Kalighat from State Secretariat in Nabanna.” Many other news websites also carried similar visuals in February 2021.#WATCH | West Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee nearly falls while driving an electric scooter in Howrah, as a mark of protest against fuel price hike. She quickly regained her balance with support and continued to drive. She is travelling to Kalighat from State Secretariat in Nabanna pic.twitter.com/CnAsQYNhTP — ANI (@ANI) February 25, 2021Further, we did a keyword search, but could not find any recent media report corroborating the viral claim.Thus, it is evident from the above information that an old video of Mamata Banerjee driving an electric scooter is being shared as recent with misleading claims.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 979l9Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos n our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Old Video Of Yogi Adityanath Falsely Linked With Nupur... Amid the violence over suspended BJP spokesperson Nupur Sharma’s remarks on Prophet Mohammad, a video of Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister, Yogi Adityanath, has surfaced on social media where he can be seen suggesting ways to deal with communal violence.The above post can be seen here.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above post and found it to be misleading.Upon closely observing the above video, we noticed that UP CM Yogi Adityanath was addressing the Lok Sabha which raised our doubt about the date of video since Yogi Adityanath is no longer a Member of Parliament.We extracted keyframes of the video using InVid software and put them through Reverse Image Search with relevant keywords. The search led us to the full version of the video on the official YouTube channel of the Bharatiya Janata Party dated August 13, 2014, from which the video in question was extracted using different clips.On digging further we found several reports about Yogi Adityanath’s Lok Sabha address dating back to August 13, 2014. These reports can be seen here and here.Yogi Adityanath was earlier a member of Lok Sabha from UP’s Gorakhpur constituency for five successive terms from 1998 to 2017. He gave up his Lok Sabha seat in 2017 when he took over as Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh.Hence, with the above findings, it is clear that the video in question is nearly eight year old and has no connection with violence over Nupur Sharma’s remarks.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Old Video Of Bhagwant Mann Dancing Resurfaces As Recent A video of Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann is being widely shared on social media in which he can be seen dancing on a jeep. The video is being shared with a claim that Mann celebrated this way after becoming the Chief Minister.The caption reads, “ਮੁੱਖ ਮੰਤਰੀ ਸਾ੍ਹਬ ਜੀ ਏਨਾ ਗੁੱਸਾ ਕਿਹੜੀ ਗੱਲ ਦਾ. ਜੇ ਲੋਕ ਵਿਰੋਧ ਕਰਦੇ ਨੇ ਗੰਦੇ ਇਸ਼ਾਰੇ ਕਿਓ ਕਰਨੇ. ਤੁਸੀ ਹੁਣ ਝੰਡਾ ਅਮਲੀ ਨਹੀ ਤੁਸੀ ਪੰਜਾਬ ਦੇ ਮੁੱਖ ਮੰਤਰੀ ਜੇ ਸੰਜਮ ਤੋ ਕੰਮ ਲਵੋ.”(English translation: “Chief Minister, why are you so angry? Why make dirty gestures if people protest You are no longer the flag bearer. If you are the Chief Minister of Punjab, exercise restraint”)The link to the post can be seen here.FACT CHECKNewsMobile did a fact-check and found the claim to be Misleading.On doing a Google Reverse Image Search with one of the screenshots, we found that the same video was published by Punjabi singer Jassi Jasraj in 2019 with a caption that read, “ਸੌਭਾ ਨੀ ਦਿੰਦੀਆਂ ਇਹ ਗੱਲਾਂ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਮਾਨ ਨੂੰ। ਘਨੌਰ ਕਲਾਂ ਚ ਕੱਲ ਦੀ ਹਰਕਤ ਦੇਖਲੌ ਸਾਮੀ 7 ਵਜੇ ਲੋਕਾ ਨੂੰ ਗਾਲਾਂ ਕੱਡੀਆ ਤੇ ਜਾਦਾ ਹੋਇਆ ਆਪ ਦੇਖੋ ਕਿ ਇਸ਼ਾਰੇ ਕਰ ਗਿਆ……” (English translation: “These things do not give glory to Bhagwant Mann. See tomorrow’s movement in Ghanour Kalan.”)We also found that a Facebook user also shared a news clip from a Punjabi newspaper on May 19, 2019. According to the report, “Bhagwant Mann played DJ in front of Gurudwara Sahib regardless of the time in Ghanauri Kalan village. He also sang, danced to the songs and made obscene gestures toward the villagers.”The report also said that he was then the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) Punjab President and Lok Sabha candidate from the Sangrur constituency. He did so in order to stop the ongoing protest by villagers.Bhagwant Mann was sworn in as the Punjab Chief Minister on March 16, 2022, after the party registered a landslide victory in the assembly polls, wresting the state from Congress.Hence, we can conclude that the viral post is misleading.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Old Video From Madhya Pradesh Falsely Linked To Bangladesh... India’s northeastern region and several parts of Bangladesh including Sylhet are seeing the worst flooding in nearly 20 years, which has affected millions of people.In this backdrop, a video showing a temple standing in gushing waters is being widely shared on social media linking it to flooding in Sylhet.The video is being shared on Facebook with a caption in Bengali: “হাজার হাজার ঘর-বাড়ি বাংলাদেশের সিলেট-সুনামগঞ্জে নদীর জলে তলিয়ে যাচ্ছে, কিন্তু ঈশ্বরের ঘর(মন্দির) এখনো মাথা উচু করে দাড়িয়ে আছে.. হর হর মহাদেব”(English translation: Thousands of houses are being submerged in the river in Sylhet-Sunamganj of Bangladesh, But the house of God (temple) is still standing with its head held high)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above claim and found it to be MISLEADING.A simple Reverse Image Search directed us to a YouTube video uploaded on September 15, 2021, which carried the same viral video stating that it was the Shri Kapileshwar Temple in Sarangpur, Madhya Pradesh.The same visuals were also carried in another YouTube video dated August 22, 2020, with the description, “Sarangpur#MP: Reporter- Shafiq Ansari on river drain overflowing due to heavy rains.”We searched further and found a Vlog on Shri Kapileshwar Temple that carried visuals of the same temple. The temple seen in that vlog is exactly the same as the temple seen in the viral video.We further searched on Google Maps and found that this temple is located in the middle of the Kali Sindh river in Madhya Pradesh.Thus, it is evident from the above information that an old video from Madhya Pradesh is being falsely linked to recent floods in Bangladesh.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 979l9Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos n our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Video From Mexico Falsely Shared As Cattle Washed Away... This search directed us to the official YouTube channel “Imagen Noticias”, which carried the same video on July 28, 2020. According to the video description, these were scenes related to the incident of Jakulpan river in Nayarit (Mexico), where cattle were washed away.Taking a cue from this, we searched the web and found a news article published on July 28, 2020, on the same incident.We found the same video uploaded on a Twitter post, dated July 28, 2020, with the caption: “WORLD – Cows are washed away by flood after a high volume of rain caused by the hurricane #Hanna in Compostela, Nayarit, Mexico.”On digging further, we also found the same video on Joranda.com.mx, dated July 28, 2020, claiming that the video is from Hanna, in which thousands of people were affected because of the torrential rains, followed by a storm.Earlier, NewsMobile had also exposed the viral video, which claimed that cattle were washed away in Kerala floods.Thus, the viral video in question is from Hanna, Mexico, having no connection with the recent Bangladesh floods.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 979l9Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos n our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: 2020 Image From Turkey Falsely Linked to Afghanistan Earthquake On June 22, a strong earthquake struck a remote, mountainous area of eastern Afghanistan, close to the Pakistani border, killing at least 1,000 people and wounding nearly 1,500.Against this backdrop, an image showing a collapsed building is being widely shared on social media linking it to the recent Afghanistan earthquake.The image is shared on Facebook with a caption in the Arabic language: “زلزال قوي يضرب #أفغانستان , يودي بحياة أكثر من 950 شخصاً ومئات المصابين ودمار هائل في المنازل , حيث ضرب الزلزال مقاطعة باكتيكا شرق البلاد في وقت مبكر من صباح اليوم”(English translation: A powerful earthquake hits #Afghanistan, killing more than 950 people, and injuring thousands with massive destruction of properties, where the earthquake hit Paktika district early this morning)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above claim, and found it to be MISLEADING.Doing a simple Reverse Image Search directed us to Getty Images, which carried the same viral image on January 26, 2020.The image description reads: “Rescue workers at the scene of a collapsed building on January 26, 2020, in Elazig, Turkey. The 6.8-magnitude earthquake injured more than 1,600 people and left some 30 trapped in the wreckage of toppled buildings. Turkey sits on top of two major fault-lines and earthquakes are frequent in the country.”The same image was also featured in a Bloomberg article, dated January 31, 2020, with the description: “Rescue workers at the scene of a collapsed building in Elazig following an earthquake on January 26.”Searching further, we found many news articles published in January 2020 that reported the same earthquake, stating “at least 22 people died and hundreds injured in eastern Turkey after an earthquake rattled the region on Friday evening, according to authorities.”Thus, it is evident from the above information that the viral image is not related to the recent Afghanistan earthquake.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 979l9Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos n our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Old Images of Flood-Rescue Operation By Bangladesh Army Reappears... The recent incessant rainfall in Bangladesh’s Sylhet region has claimed at least 25 lives. The devastating flood has also left more than four million people stranded.Against this backdrop, a collage of images is widely shared on social media claiming that it shows Bangladesh Army carrying out a rescue operation in the flood-hit Sylhet region.The image is shared on Facebook with a caption in Bengali language: “আলহামদুলিল্লাহ্‌ উদ্ধারকাজে নিয়োজিত বাংলাদেশের আস্থা বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনী আল্লাহ্‌ এবার আপনি একটু দয়া করুন। সকল আযাব গজব হতে প্রিয় ভূমি বাংলাদেশ ও সিলেট অঞ্চলে পানিবদ্ধ মানুষগুলোকে হিফাজত করুন”(English translation: Alhamdulillah Confidence of Bangladesh engaged in rescue work Bangladesh Army God, now, please. Protect the waterlogged people in the beloved land of Bangladesh and the Sylhet region from all the torment and wrath)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above claim, and found it to be MISLEADING.Doing a simple Reverse Image Search, directed us to a post on the official Facebook page of the Bangladesh Army, dated June 19, 2018, which published the same images. The caption reads: “Bangladesh Army next to the flood victims in Moulvibazar”.The same image had been carried by a Facebook page — ‘Bangla Fact’, on June 20, 2018, with a caption: “Ignoring the Eid vacation, Bangladesh Army besides the flood victims of Moulvibazar. Thank you”Taking a cue from this, we did a keyword search and found a news report published by a Bangladesh news website on June 16, 2018, reporting that “the flood situation in Moulvibazar has further deteriorated due to the downpour from upper reaches.” In June 2018, when the flood situation deteriorated in Moulvibazar, the Bangladesh Army was involved in the overall relief and rescue work of the flood victims.Thus, it is clear that an old set of images is being falsely shared as recent visuals of the Bangladesh Army carrying out a rescue operation in the flood-hit Sylhet region.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 979l9Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos n our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: No This Video Does NOT Vandalism At Bihar Deputy... Protests over the Agnipath recruitment scheme escalated in Bihar on June 17, when a mob attacked Deputy Chief Minister Renu Devi’s house, damaged railway properties, and disrupted normal life in many districts.Against this backdrop, a video is being widely shared on social media with the people standing under a white two-story house and smashing things, claiming that angry mobs vandalising Bihar Deputy Chief Minister Renu Devi’s house.The video is shared on Facebook with a caption in the Bengali: “এটা কিন্তু বিহারের উপ মুখ্যমন্ত্রীর বাড়ি শ্রীলঙ্কা পার্ট ২” (English translation: This is Bihar’s Deputy Chief Minister’s house. Sri Lanka part 2)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above claim, and found it to be MISLEADING.Doing a keyword search, we found a news report published by Hindustan Times that Bihar Deputy Chief Minister’s house was vandalised by Agnipath protesters. It also embedded a video tweeted by ANI. Although in this video, the house is not clearly visible, one can see a blue structured building being vandalised and not white.#WATCH | Bihar: The residence of Deputy CM Renu Devi, in Bettiah, attacked by agitators during their protest against #AgnipathScheme Her son tells ANI, “Our residence in Bettiah was attacked. We suffered a lot of damage. She (Renu Devi) is in Patna.” pic.twitter.com/Ow5vhQI5NQ — ANI (@ANI) June 17, 2022Searching further, we found a clearer version of vandalism at Renu Devi’s home in Bihar, uploaded by Times Now on June 17, 2022. This video also shows a different house being attacked.We then extracted keyframes from the viral video using the InVid Tool and performed a Reverse Image Search. This search directed us to a tweet upload on June 17, that carried the same viral video. The text reads: “Protesting students reached BJP office in Bagaha. BJP office vandalised, papers blown in the wind.”We also found the same video uploaded by Alok Kumar, Editor of The Times of India’s Hindi edition. It also stated: “The BJP on the receiving end of #Agnipath protesters as its three MLAs and house of the Deputy CM in #Bihar were attacked in the last 24 hours. Protesters are now attacking its offices. This video is of the Bagha BJP office.”The BJP on the receiving end of #Agnipath protestors as its Three MLAs and house of the deputy CM in #Bihar were attacked in the last 24 hours. Protestors are now attacking its offices. This video is of Bagha BJP office#AgnipathRecruitmentScheme #AgnipathScheme pic.twitter.com/0P7XMEMXLV — Alok Kumar (@dmalok) June 17, 2022Many newspapers and media channels have also reported about BJP’s Bihar office being vandalised over Agnipath protests.Thus, it is confirmed that the video on BJP’s Bihar office incident is being falsely shared as Bihar Deputy Cheif Minister’s house. Therefore, the viral claim is misleading.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 979l9Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos n our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Video Of Protest Against ‘Agnipath’ Scheme In Bihar Linked... Amidst the ongoing nationwide protests over the contentious ‘Agnipath’ scheme, video of a burning train is being shared online, claiming that the visuals are from Secunderabad in Telangana.The video is being shared with a caption, “तेलंगाना के सिकंदराबाद में अग्निपथ स्कीम के विरोध में हुई आगजनी की घटना”(English Translation: Arson incident in Telangana’s Secunderabad against Agnipath scheme)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the post and found it to be misleading.We ran a keyword search along with a Reverse Image Search on the keyframes of the video and found that the same video was featured in an NDTV report dated June 17, 2022. As per the report, the video is from Lakhisarai, Bihar.Mojo Story also uploaded the same video on YouTube on June 17, 2022, with the title, “Agnipath | Trains Set On Fire In Bihar On 3rd Day Of Protest | Over 34 Trains Cancelled By Railways.”This proves that the video is from Bihar and not Telangana.However, we did find reports of Secunderabad Railway Station being vandalised and that of a train being set ablaze by agitators in Telangana.#WATCH | Telangana: Secunderabad railway station vandalised and a train set ablaze by agitators who are protesting against #AgnipathRecruitmentScheme. pic.twitter.com/2llzyfT4XG — ANI (@ANI) June 17, 2022Hence, from the above information, it is clear that the post in circulation is misleading.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Did 34 Nations Extend Support To Suspended BJP Leader... Amid ongoing protests in India and abroad over suspended BJP spokesperson Nupur Sharma’s controversial statement on Prophet Mohammad, a claim is doing rounds on social media suggesting that 34 nations including Russia, Netherlands, France and Israel have extended their support to Sharma.The claim in Hindi reads: “रूस नीदरलैंड फ्रांस इजरायल सहित कुल 34 देशों ने नुपुर शर्मा और भारत का समर्थन किया।।। जय श्री राम”(English Translation: “A total of 34 countries including Russia, Netherlands, France, Israel have supported Nupur Sharma and India. Long live Ram”The above post can be seen here.The same tweet was also attributed to Major General (Retd) GB Bakshi.The tweet can be seen here.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the above claim and found it to be false as we could not find any official statement by any country supporting Nupur Sharma.Upon running a relevant Google search we did not find any news report corroborating the viral claim that 34 countries have supported the suspended BJP leader.However, Dutch politician, Geert Wilders (member of the opposition), did Tweet in support of Sharma, but the Netherlands did not release any official statement on the matter.It is ridiculous that Arab and Islamic countries are angered by Indian politician #NupurSharma @NupurSharmaBJP for speaking the truth about #ProphetMuhammad who indeed married Aisha when she was six years old and consumed the marriage when she was nine. Why does India apologize? — Geert Wilders (@geertwilderspvv) June 6, 2022Hence, we can conclude that the claim of 34 nations supporting Nupur Sharma is False.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news

content: Fact Check: Letter Claiming ‘ORs Attested After Jan 2019 Will Come... A letter attributed to the Ministry of Defence is being circulated on social media claiming personnel under ‘Other Ranks (ORs) attested after 01 January 2019 and not promoted to the substantive rank of Naik or equivalent on 01 July 2022 are to be kept under the new Agnipath Scheme’.Facebook users are sharing the letter with text, “मोदी सरकार का एक और #दमनकारी_फैसला। भारतीय सेना में जो जवान 31 December 2018 के बाद भर्ती हुए हैं वो सभी जवान “अग्निवीर” घोषित कर दिये हैं।”(English Translation: Another #oppressive_decision of Modi government. All the soldiers who have joined the Indian Army after 31 December 2018 have been declared “Agniveer”.)Here’s the link to the above post.FACT CHECKNewsMobile fact-checked the post and found it to be false.We ran a keyword search but did not any credible media report to corroborate the claim. Under the Agnipath scheme, around 46,000 soldiers will be recruited between the ages of 17-and-a -half years and 21 years (23 for the year 2022) into the three armed services on a four-year short-term contractual basis.Moreover, in the letter, the date mentioned is June 17, 2022. However, we scanned through the press note on the website of the Ministry of Defence but did not any such letter.On searching further, we also found that Press Information Bureau had also refuted the claim in a tweet dated June 20, 2022.Hence, from the above fact check, it is clear that the viral letter is fake.If you want to fact-check any story, WhatsApp it now on +91 11 7127 9799Your nameYour emailSubjectYour message (optional)ΔClick here for Latest News updates and viral videos on our AI-powered smart news
