content: Fact Check: Is the viral video of the protestor related to the Agnipath Scheme Protests? A video of a protestor is going viral on social media. In that video, the man is speaking to several news reporters and assures students that he is protesting on their behalf. The man says, “I will reach wherever my students are in problem.” When asked by media persons about what the demands of the students are, the protester fails to answer and he leaves the interview midway and runs away.Many social media users are claiming that the man in the video is protesting against the Agnipath scheme, i.e newly launched scheme by the Indian government.A Facebook user writes, “When it comes to “firefighters” walking the “file path”Why do such “Agniveer” come first in the mind?”Fact Check:We at DFRAC reverse searched the video to know its reality. We found a logo on the video that is of Principle of news and found a Youtube channel. On that channel, we found the same video which was on the Facebook page, but with the caption, “The meaning of RRB-NTPC is not known but for the students doing Protest. RRB-NTPC Latest News.”The video was uploaded 5 months earlier.Conclusion:The video is not from the farmer’s protest but is 5 months older video.Claim Review: the video is protesting against the Agnipath scheme.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did Aaditya Thackeray have removed the word minister from his Twitter bio amid the Politics crisis in Maharashtra? A piece of information is going massively viral on the internet with the claim that Aditya Thackeray has removed his ministerial designation from his Twitter bio amid political turmoil in Maharashtra. Further, sharing a clip on its official Facebook account, Zee News English wrote the caption, “Aditya Thackeray changes Twitter bio, removes minister post | Watch this update on Maharashtra political crisis.”Likewise, a Twitter user Sudhir Suryawanshi wrote, “Interesting: Aditya Thackeray changes his Twitter profile status, removes minister, simply writes voice of youth…” Tagging @NewIndianXpress and @TheMornStandard.Similarly, many other users have shared this claim about Maharashtra cabinet Minister Aaditya Thackeray.Fact CheckDuring keyword research, we found a tweet from a account names Ms Aflatoon from August 28, 2020. Sharig a screenshot of the Twitter handle of Aaditya Thackeray wrote, “Why is “Minister” missing from Aditya Thackeray’s twitter profile??”Why is “Minister” missing from Aditya Thackeray’s twitter profile?? pic.twitter.com/WW3xUTvJ1M — Ms Aflatoon (@Ms_Aflatoon) August 28, 2020Hence, from the above Tweet, it is clear that Aaditya Thackeray has not removed the word Minister from his Bio recently.Furthermore, we also found the archived version of twitter of Aaditya Thackeray of 2019 and 2020. There also the word minister has not been used.Conclusion
label: truth

content: ‘Crime Tak’ spread misleading news about Pakistan being removed from FATF grey list Even after four years, Pakistan has not been able to get out of the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) grey list, but on June 17, the news published on the Crime Tak website, “Pakistan’s name removed from FATF green list”.Crime Tak wrote, “Pakistan has been taken out of FATF grey list. The decision to remove Pakistan from the grey list has been taken in the ongoing meeting in Berlin (Germany).”Fact Check:On internet search, we found a video of Pakistan’s Union Minister Hina Rabbani Khar on BBC Urdu’s YouTube channel. In this video, she can be heard saying that the FATF has expressed satisfaction over Pakistan’s performance (to curb terror funding) and now begins the process of Pakistan’s exit from the FATF grey list.Read this also: Fact Check: Did FATF has removed Pakistan from Grey List?During this, we got a report by Dainik Bhaskar, which states that even after four years, Pakistan could not get out of the grey list of FATF. The FATF clearly said that Pakistan still needs to take strict steps to stop terror funding.At the same time, ‘Hindustan Times’ has also published a report with the headline, “Pakistan won’t be removed from FATF grey list immediately, decision after onsite visit.”Conclusion:It is clear from this fact check of DFRAC that the news given by ‘Crime Tak’ is misleading. Because despite great efforts, Pakistan still remains in the grey list of FATF.Claim Review: Pakistan’s name removed from FATF grey listClaimed by: Crime TakFact Check: Misleading(Follow #DFRAC on Twitter, Facebook, and YouTube.)
label: rumor

content: The reality behind the defence ministry viral letter on Agnipath Scheme- Read Fact Check. Amid the recently declared Agnipath scheme launched by the government, many news are around the corner some with real claims others with false claims.Similarly, a letter is getting viral on social media from the defence ministry the letter reads, “I am directed to refer to this Ministry’s letter no. F.No. 9 (11/2027/F dated 17 June 2022, on the subject sited above and to say that the ORs attested after 01 January 2013 and not promoted to the substantive rank of Naik or equivalent on 01 July 2022 are to be kept under the new Agnipath Scheme….”It is being claimed in the letter that, the Ministry of Defence has ordered personnel under Other Ranks (ORs) attested after January 1, 2019, and not promoted to a substantive rank of Naik or equivalent as of July 1, 2022, are to be kept under the Agnipath Scheme.Many social media users are sharing this letter with concern a user on Twitter writes, “I only hope that this letter is fake otherwise the repercussions are going to be very serious. It would invite endless litigation.”I only hope that this letter👇is fake otherwise the repurcussions are going to be very serious. It would invite endless litigation. pic.twitter.com/3GNHLnVtot — Mukul (@Warrior_Mukul) June 19, 2022Many others too shared the viral letter under different captions.Fact Check:To check the authenticity of the viral letter from the defence ministry, we searched the letter on the official defence ministry website and found no letter as such on the website.Conclusion:with no sign of such a letter on the official defence ministry site, it is clear the letter is getting viral with the misleading claim.Claim Review: the Ministry of Defence has ordered personnel under Other Ranks (ORs) attested after January 1, 2019, and not promoted to a substantive rank of Naik or equivalent as of July 1, 2022, are to be kept under the Agnipath Scheme.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check: ‘News Nation ‘ anchor makes a misleading claim that Muslim women insulted the national anthem There is a user named Shubham Tripathi on Twitter. According to his bio, he is an anchor and producer at News Nation. He tweeted a photo and claimed that the Muslim women in the burqa did not stand while the national anthem was sung.Further, he wrote on Twitter- ” When ‘ National Anthem ‘ was playing, she didn’t stand up…then says “Everyone’s blood is included in the soil here. Eat here and sing for somewhere else.”(“जब ‘राष्ट्रगान’ चल रहा था तो उस दौरान ये ख़्वातीने खड़ी नहीं हुईं….फिर कहते हैं “सभी का ख़ून शामिल है यहाँ की मिट्टी” में खाओ यहाँ का और गाओ कहीं का”)Fact Check:To investigate this photo, we did a simple search on Google. During this we got a report of “Jansatta” with the same photo. According to this report, this incident is from the meeting of the Municipal Corporation in Muzaffarnagar. The report has been given the headlines- ” Muslim woman councilor sitting on chair during Vande Mataram in Muzaffarnagar board meeting, created a ruckus ” .This report shows that Muslim women did not stand during the Vande Mataram, not the national anthem.Then, the question arises that whether is it necessary to stand on Vande Mataram ? when we tried to collect information, in this context, we came across a report published by Dainik Jagran in 2016. According to this report, Union Minister Kiren Rijiju told in the Rajya Sabha that no rule has been fixed for singing Vande Mataram.Conclusion:After fact checking, we found that Muslim women did not stand while the Vande Mataram was sung. They has not insulted the national anthem in any way. Hence, the claim being of Shubham Tripathi is misleading.Also Read: Did the Indian Muslim protesters burn the Tricolor?Claim- Muslim women did not stand during the national anthemClaimed by- Shubham TripathiFact Check – Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Misleading video of Nupur Sharma’s arrest goes viral on Societymedia
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: know the reality of a Sanghi removing the head scarf of a lady. A video is getting viral on social media sites. In the video, it can be seen a man wearing a saffron scarf is trying to remove the headscarf of a lady sitting on a two-wheeler. In reaction to this, the lady and the people started thrashing him and push him on the road. People on the internet are claiming that the Sanghi man is trying to remove the headscarf as he thought only Muslim women do that.A Facebook user writes, “This Sanghi asked a woman to remove cloth covering head, because he thought only Muslim ladies do that. Watch the response from others. Sanghi’s are brainwashed by Media and Govt”.A Twitter user shared the same video with same caption.WhatsApp Trending:This Sanghi asked a woman to remove the cloth covering her head, he thought only Muslim ladies do that. Watch the response from others.Thanks to Noida. pic.twitter.com/0iEKQaUsHH — Kroordarshak क्रूरदर्शक (@SufiRoshan82) June 20, 2022Fact Check:We reverse searched the video using specific keyframes and found the same video. We found the same video on the news website of Dainik Bhaskar with the headline, “Slaps and punches rained on the manchle, VIDEO:: In Bina, the girl beat up the young man on the middle of the road for molesting people.”The report also states that the man was thrashed for harassing the girl. None of the news reports mention anything about a headscarf.Conclusion:New reports confirms that the accused was beaten because he had passed lewd comments at the woman, and there was no hijab angle involved.Claim Review: man wearing a saffron scarf is trying to remove the headscarf of a lady sitting on a two-wheeler.Claimed by: social media users.Fact check: misleading

content: Fact Check: Did the Indian Muslim protesters burn the Tricolor? An image is going viral on the internet of people burning the Indian Flag. Further, sharing the image on social media users are targeting the Indian Muslim community. Along with the picture Facebook user, Tarun Soti wrote the caption, “Peaceful Muslims burning Our Tiranga (National Flag) today in India. #HindusUnderAttackInIndia.”Similarly, many other users have shared this picture on their user handle.Also Read: Analysing the Pakistan-Based Disinformation CampaignFact CheckOn reverse image search we found the same image on the website of Associated Press. Moreover, the title of the image is PAKISTAN INDIA ISLAM. In the overview it was given that, “supporters of religious groups burn a representation of Indian flag during a demonstration to condemn derogatory references to Islam and the Prophet Muhammad recently made by Nupur Sharma, a spokesperson of the governing Indian Hindu nationalist party, in Lahore, Pakistan, Thursday, June 9, 2022.”We also found the same image on The Washington Post in an article dated June 9 2022. And, Aljazeera also used the same image in an article titles, South Asia protests over prophet remarks by India’s BJP officials published on 10th June , 2022. Hence, the image is from Pakistan, not from India.ConclusionTherefore, from our fact check analysis, it is clear that the users are sharing the viral image with misleading claim.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Rahul Gandhi’s statement ‘Aag lagegi’, got viral misleadingly. A video of Congress leader Rahul Gandhi is going viral on social media. In this video, Rahul Gandhi said- “Now this fight has started “. Is. You will see it in the future. There will be a fire in India. ,Further, a Facebook user named Shyolal Jat wrote – “There will be fire in India”…Rahul had warned the country from Congress’s Chintan Shivir, repeated the same thing in London.In UP, many Congress leaders have been arrested by the police for sabotaging masquerading as youths recruiting in the army.A fire is being set.”(“हिंदुस्तान में आग लगेगी”…राहुल ने कांग्रेस के चिंतन शिविर से देश को चेतावनी दी थी, लन्दन में इसी बात को दोहराया।यूपी में पुलिस ने सेना में भर्ती होने वाले नौजवान बन कर तोड़ फोड़ करने वाले जिन लोगों को गिरफ़्तार किया है उनमें कई कांग्रेस के नेता है।आग लगायी जा रही है।”)Fact Check:To check the video going viral, we reverse searched some of the frames of the video. On searching, we found this video uploaded on the official YouTube channel of Congress on 15 May 2022. This video is from Congress’s Chintan Shivir organized in Udaipur.Between the 29:20 to 30:14 minutes of this video, Rahul is saying – “ This is a fight for ideology. It’s not an easy fight. This is not even a political fight. This is a fight for the future of the country and a fight to save the country. And you will see, now this fight has started. In the coming time you will see, there will be fire in India. I spoke of Covid, remember. I’m telling the more they destroy the institutions, the more they suppress the conversations between our states, between religions, between castes, the more intense the fire will be. ,This fact check of the viral video of Rahul Gandhi proves that his reference was to the activities happening inside the country. We also found a post of ANI on this matter.Inflation will rise in near future. Unemployment, inflation, and attacks on India’s institutions are on the rise. 'Aag lagegi', we have to ensure they don’t set the country on fire: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi at Nav Sankalp Shivir in Udaipur pic.twitter.com/kKbdzUGfph — ANI (@ANI) May 15, 2022On the other hand, when we visited the profile of Shyolal Jat, we found that he has 34,500 followers. Fake and misleading news is continuously spread from his Facebook. He has posted a misleading video about the protest against Agnipath in Bihar. He wrote- ” When it comes to “Agniveers” walking on “Agnipath”. Why only such “Agniveer” comes in the mind first . ,Fact Check:To check the reality of this video, when we reverse searched some frames of the video, we found that this video has been uploaded by Principle Of News on 28 January 2022 . This video is not about the protest against Agnipath, but about the rigging of recruitment in RRB-NTPC in Bihar.At the same time, another misleading post has been made from this ID. Sharing the picture of Shivling in a hill situated between two mountains, Sheolal Jat wrote – “# wonderful , # unimaginable … he is # calm, # fierce , he is # beginning and # end too.. # Look at this # Shivling situated between two # hills in southern India, how hard our # ancestors have introduced us all to wonderful and great # architecture , and # so many wonderful and # wonder _ astonishing # wonders in the heritage Left for us #Har_Har_Mahadev ” _ _ _ _ _Fact Check:For the fact check of this photo, we did a reverse image search of the photo. During this time we found this photo on the website of pinterest.com . According to this website, this photo is from Norway.Conclusion:Our investigation proves that a Facebook user named Shyolal Jat is constantly spreading fake and misleading information.
label: rumor

content: Azam Khan became a devotee of Ram-Krishna after being in jail for 27 months?, Read Fact Check A video of senior Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan is becoming very viral on social media. Users sharing this video are claiming that after being in jail for 27 months, Azam Khan has started considering Shri Ram and Shri Krishna as ideals.Sharing this video, a user named ‘Main Bhi Agniveer’ wrote – “Azam Khan Ji after being in jail for 27 months”Same video was shared by other social media users with same claim:Fact Check:To fact-check the video going viral, we reverse searched some of the frames of the video. We found this video posted on the official YouTube channel of Samajwadi Party. This video was uploaded on 7th October 2017. Azam Khan’s full statement can be heard at 13:16 minutes to 16 minutes 20 minutes of this video.Azam Khan said- ‘The Mughals were not our ancestors. they were our ancestors neither yesterday, noe today never will there be tomorrow. We have told a thousand times in front of you that we have our deen, our Quran, our hadith, our prophet’s decree that beware… do not insult any religious Peshwa or great men of any religion. And why? Because after 1500 years in your book, which is your soul, one aspect of it has neither decreased nor increased. Allah has sent 1 lakh 20 thousand prophets. All the great men in the world, they may have been prophets in their time. So Yogi ji, Mughals are not our ideals, but Ram and Krishna ji are our ideals. But we want to know whether the Prophet and Jesus Christ are your role models or not?Conclusion:This fact check proves that Azam Khan’s video is not recent but 5 years old and social media users are spreading misleading information by sharing his incomplete video.Claim- Azam Khan considered Ram-Krishna as ideal after being in jail for 27 monthsClaimant- Social media usersFact Check – Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did an Army Officer aspirant commit suicide due to the Agnipath scheme? An image of cutting off a newspaper is getting viral on social media sites. In this cutting a news report of an army officer is provided, who ends his life. It is claimed by the social media users that the army officer commit suicide because of the new Agnipath scheme launched by the government.The viral post shares the screenshot of a newspaper cutting with a Hindi headline ‘Father, I Could Not Become A Soldier in This Life, I Will Definitely Become One in Next Life’.(translates Hindi)In the Agniveer scheme the new recruits, called the Agniveers, will be recruited on a contract of four years and 45,000 to 50,000 personnel will be recruited annually. However, only 25% of these will be retained after four years. Those retained will be allowed to continue their services for the next 15 years and will be able to avail benefits like health insurance. The government had earlier set the upper age limit as 21 and was changed to 23 on Thursday amid massive protests which turned violent in Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh and Haryana.Many social media users are sharing the image of newspaper cutting with agitation.A user on Facebook writes, “Bapu……! I could not become a soldier at this birth, I will definitely become one in the next! Where he used to practice these words, he left them written on the sand!* Every year four and a half lakh youth are preparing for army recruitment! 200000 youth over age due to non-recruitment for 3 years!* The state is at number one in unemployment!* If the recruitment of 41000 posts was canceled in the past, then the dreams of 1200000 applicants were broken!* Center is not getting army recruitment and youth is disappointed and desperate due to paper leak and cancellation of recruitment in the state! Who is the culprit of this death???????”Fact Check:We at DFRAC reverse searched the image to check the authenticity of the viral image, and found the same report published on various news sites like Today Haryana and Indian Express newspaper dated 29th April 2022 and 30th of April respectively.According to the news report, the aspirant ended his life in Bhiwani, Haryana after he was unable to secure a position in the army after multiple attempts.Conclusion:The death of a young army aspirant is being falsely linked to the Centre’s Agnipath scheme.Claim Review: an Army Officer aspirant commit suicide due to the Agnipath scheme.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did Police take Rana Ayyub forcefully from a protest site? An image is getting viral on the internet with the claim that Police is taking away Journalist Rana Ayyub forcefully from a protest site. Further, sharing an image, a Twitter account whose location is shown Lahore, Pakistan wrote the caption, Jinnah was always right ..what a brave girl ..salute to her courage @RanaAyyub may ALLAH be with her.”Similarly, many other users have shared this picture on social media with the similar claim.Fact CheckOn reverse image search, we found a Facebook page of Fraternity Movement Kerala. The Fraternity Movement is the student’s wing of the political outfit Welfare Party of India. According to their reports, the girl in the picture is Aysha Renna not Ranna Ayyub. She is a student leader from Kerala.Detained girl picture Ayesha Renna N’s pictureFurthermore, on keyword search we have not found any recent news of Ranna Ayyub getting detained by Police.Also Read: Analysing the Pakistan-Based Disinformation Campaign.ConclusionTherefore, the claim of social media users are wrong. The girl in the viral image is not Rana Ayyub. And, the news that Police is forcefully taking away Rana Ayyub from a protest site is fake.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: ‘Aaj Tak’ spread fake news about the chemical blast in Hyderabad mosque A tweet from the news channel ‘Aaj Tak’ went viral on social media sites. It can be seen in this tweet that there is news of a chemical blast in a mosque in Gowliguda Gol, Hyderabad. It has also been claimed that 2 people were injured in this blast.Sharing the screenshot of this tweet, a user named Poornima Biswas wrote “Islamic bomb scientists were at work and then chemical bomb has the fart ! Ola uber.”Another user Vikas Choudhary also shared the same screenshot of the tweet in Hinglish with the caption, “Baulana Chemistry Practical kar raha tha Basjid me”.On the other hand, a Twitter user named The Speaker captioned, “What is the use of chemicals in the mosque? So much chemical that it exploded, why was it collected? What kind of chemical was there that would explode?” and shared the same screenshot.Fact Check:To know the reality of the viral screenshot, we first checked the Twitter account of Aaj Tak. During this we found this tweet on Aaj Tak Twitter, in which it has been claimed that there has been a chemical blast in the mosque. A link to a news article published on the website has been posted along with this tweet.The report regarding the incident can be read by opening the link of this news. However, there is no report of chemical blast anywhere inside the mosque in the report.At the same time, this incident has been covered by other media houses including The New Indian Express, The News Minute. According to which the chemical blast did not happen inside the mosque.According to these reports- “Blast occurred at around 10 am on June 12 at Mogram Basti in Maharajganj area of ​​Afzalganj in Hyderabad and chemical trader Bharat Bhattar died on the spot.Police said Bhattar used to throw the expired chemical into the drain in front of his shop, which led to the blast that day.”Conclusion:It is clear from this fact check of DFRAC that the tweet made by Aaj Tak is fake. Giving a communal angle, Aaj Tak linked the chemical blast incident to the mosque. Since the chemical blast did not happen in any mosque in Hyderabad, the claim being made by “Aaj Tak” and social media users is wrong and false.Claim Review: Chemical blast in Hyderabad mosqueClaimed by: Aaj Tak and other social media usersFact Check: FakeAlso Read:
label: truth

content: Fact Check: A video of Nupur Sharma shouting How’s the Josh gone viral amid the Prophet remark controversy. Read the full story A video of ex-BJP member Nupur Sharma is getting circulated all over the internet. In the video, Nupur Sharm with a group of people shouting How’s the Josh? High Sir!.Further, sharing the video a Facebook user named Niki Sidhu wrote in the caption, “Queen After Offending 1 Billion. How is the Josh?”Similarly, many other users have share this video with the similar claim.Also Read:Claim of US and Western countries to collapse by 2050 goes viral.Fact CheckOn reverse image search of the different frames of the image we found the original video on the official Twitter handle of Nupur Sharma. She posted this video on 26 Jan, 2019. Hence, this video is not related to the ongoing Prophet remark controversy. Further, she gave the caption, “Celebrating #गणतंत्रदिवस #URITheSurgicalStrike style with old college friends! How’s the Josh?? High Sir!!” Tagging Prime Minister Narendra Modi and actor Vicky Kaushal.ConclusionTherefore, from our fact check analysis it is clear that users are sharing an old video of Nupur Sharma with misleading claim.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Did FATF has removed Pakistan from Grey List? The FATF GREY list is prepared by the Financial Action Task Force (FATF), an intergovernmental body formed to combat money laundering. It was established in July 1989.A piece of news is getting viral on social media from the Twitter handle of @SouthAsiaIndex which states, “Just IN:— FATF has removed Pakistan from the grey list after its 3 days plenary in Berlin, Germany.”Just IN:— FATF has removed Pakistan from grey list after its 3 days plenary in Berlin, Germany. — South Asia Index (@SouthAsiaIndex) June 17, 2022Fact Check:We at DFRAC searched specific Keywords to know the authenticity of the piece of information.We found a report of the Hindustan Times with the headline, “Pakistan won’t be removed from FATF grey list immediately, decision after onsite visit.”We searched the Google to know about the countries that are in FATF grey list and found Pakistan on number 14 in the list.Conclusion:From the search it is clear that the piece of information shared by south Asia index is misleading.Claim Review: FAFT has removed Pakistan from Grey List.Claimed by: South Asia Index.Fact Check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Claim of US and Western countries to collapse by 2050 goes viral. Read the full story. A screenshot of a piece of news from CNN is going viral on social media. In this screenshot, a claim is being made about China’s Diplomacy. The screenshot reads that – “A leaked Chinese geopolitical strategy document reveals China’s self-confidence. The document predicts, ‘The US and Western Europe will collapse due to cultural and demographic conflict by 2050.’ China’s leaders increasingly see multiculturalism as ‘cultural suicide’ and believe the west is dying because of it.”Further, a user Twitter user Lord Miles Routledge Adventures shared the screenshot with the caption, “Half of people think china is collapsing and the other half think china is doing great, however, idk anyone who thinks the west is doing great.”Similarly, many other users have shared this sreenshot.Fact Check:We checked the Twitter handle of CNN News to check the reality of the viral screen shot. But, we could not find any such tweet. After this, we searched some keywords of the viral post on Google. But, we did not get any information in this context even there.Conclusion:Our fact check proves that the social media claim about China is fake.Claim- American and Western countries will be destroyed by 2050Claimant- Social media usersFact Check – Fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did two brothers commit suicide in Saharanpur over Army recruitment? An image is getting viral on the internet with the claim that the two brothers of Saharanpur gave life together. And, the reason behind the suicide is the Cancellation of Army Recruitment. Further, sharing the picture a user named Rajesh Yadav Vaishali(राजेश यादव वैशाली) wrote the caption, “@PMOIndia Two real brothers were fit in the army in Saharanpur given life together.” (@PMOIndia सहारनपुर में दो सगे भाई आर्मी मे फिट थे एक साथ दी जान)Similarly, many other users have shared this picture with the similar same claim.Also Read:Prophet Row: Analysing the Pakistan-Based Disinformation CampaignPakistani Journalist Asad Kharal spreads misleading news against IndiaFact CheckOn reverse image search we found an article on the website of Perma Culture News published on 26 January, 2010. The title of the report is, “Farmer Suicides and Bt Cotton Nightmare Unfolding in India.” It is noteworthy that the same image was used the articleHence, the viral image photo is old. And, it is not related to any present day scenario. Further, on keyword research we have not found any such incident in Saharanpur.ConclusionTherefore, users are sharing an old image with misleading claim.
label: rumor

content: CJ Werleman again shared a misleading video about Indian Muslim oppression. Read fact check A video of Indian Muslim oppression is shared widely on social media sites.CJ werleman, who claims to be an activist of islamophobia also shared the video with the claim of how Hindu radical cops are assaulting an elderly Muslim man.He tweeted, “Watch Hindutva radicalized cops brutally assault an elderly Muslim man.” The archive version is provided here.https://twitter.com/cjwerleman/status/1536839680968507394?s=20&t=IrQ__jxJMsCjZYxwIZhSiw@Muslim__news too shared the video under caption, “This is how Muslims are treated in India. Look at the old man’s age and the brutal use of force by the Indian police. Horrible !! This is the true face of Hindutva and the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party in India.“(Translates Urdu)هكذا يتم التعامل مع المسلمين في الهند.أنظروا إلى سن الرجل العجوز والاستخدام الوحشي للقوة من قبل الشرطة الهندية. فظيع !! هذا هو الوجه الحقيقي للهندوتفا وحزب بهاراتيا جاناتا الحاكم بالهند.#اطردوا_الهندوس_من_الخليجhttps://t.co/mIaa6yVTds — أخبار المسلمين (@Muslim__News) June 14, 2022Fact Check:Just below the tweet of CJ Werleman we found replies from Bareilly Police that state, “Concerned video is from 2020 when the complete lockdown was implemented. unlawful gathering tried to misbehave with police and police used mild force to disperse the crowd so that COVID infection would not spread.”And“Fake news is being spread by this Twitter handle.this video is from 2020 when corona lockdown was being implemented. unlawful gathering tried to misbehave with police. police used mild force to disperse it so that covid would not spread.”Read Another Misleading tweets by CJ Werleman:Conclusion:With Bareilly Police coming forward it is clear the video is from the year 2020 and CJ Werleman is sharing it with a misleading claim.Claim Review: A video of Indian Muslim oppression is shared widely on social media sites.Claimed by:@Muslim__news and @cjwerlemanFact Check: miseading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Fake statement of National Security Advisor Ajit Doval went viral A screengrab in the name of National Security Advisor Ajit Doval is going viral on the internet.Further in the screengrab, it is written that “Today, India is suffering from the exact same problem that Israel was suffering from, 5 years ago. There also a crowd of thousands used to gather upon the death of even one terrorist and then they start throwing stones at the Army. The same is happening in India today. To deal with this, Israel had a ‘small meeting’. Mossad Force said that they will solve this problem in just three days. The very next day, Mossad shot only one terrorist at the crossroads in 5-6 different cities. One terrorist was shot at a crossroads. At every intersection of the city, thousands of terrorists started the procession. Mossad only threw three bombs at every procession and there were the dead bodies of thousands of Terrorists. As a result, people in Israel are afraid of forming a crowd today also.This tactic of Mossad was liked by Russia so much that they have used them many times. Friends, is the time has come that this formula should be applied in India as well?”Further, a Facebook user Pankaj Singh have shared this screengrab with the caption, “Jai Shree Ram.”Similarly, many other users have shared this screengrab on the social media handles.Also ReadFact CheckOn our factcheck analysis we found a post on the Official Facebook Page of Ministry of External Affairs of India, Government of India. In the post it was written that, “Important Alert! Shri Ajit Kumar Doval K.C., National Security Advisor has no official account on Facebook. This is to advise caution against impostor or fake accounts under his name.”Further, digging more into the matter we found that this is not the first time that what is written in the screengrab went viral. In 2016, also many users have shared the same story of Israel.Further, comparing this screengrab with other posts on Facebook we found that the format it not same. In the edited post hour is written as hrs, but originally on the Facebook it is written as hConclusionThe viral screenshot is fake as there is no official account of Ajit Doval on Facebook.
label: truth

content: Amit Shah wrote a letter to CM Dhami to give Z security to Nupur Sharma’s relative? Read Fact Check A letter from Home Minister Amit Shah is going viral on social media. It is being claimed that this letter has been written by Home Minister Amit Shah to Uttarakhand CM Pushkar Singh Dhami on 13 June 2022.It has been mentioned in this letter that a relative of Nupur Sharma living in Dehradun and another person associated with the ideology of RSS should be provided Z category security. It has also been written in this letter that Nupur Sharma and Ajay Gupta are icons spreading the ideology of Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS).Fact Check:To know the truth of this letter going viral, we went to the website of the Ministry of Home Affairs. There we did not find any proof of issuing any letter from the Home Ministry. After that, we searched for the letter.At the same time, we searched Google to gather more information in this context. We found a report published on the website of ‘Hindustan’ newspaper. According to this report, Home Minister Amit Shah’s fake letter is going viral on social media. It has also been written in this report that STF has started the investigation after registering a case on this matter.Conclusion:Our fact check is proving that the letter going viral on social media is fake. No letter has been issued by the Home Ministry or Amit Shah to Uttarakhand CM Pushkar Singh Dhami regarding providing Z security to Nupur Sharma’s relative.Claim Review- Amit Shah instructed CM Dhami to provide Z security to Nupur Sharma’s relativeClaimed by- Social MediaFact Check – Misleading
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Misleading claim of South Asian Journal on UAE’s ban on India’s wheat export goes viral The United Arab Emirates (UAE) bans the export of wheat imported from India for 4 months. After this, people are giving their reactions on social media. Many believe that the UAE has banned importing wheat from India, while many people have attributed the UAE’s decision to the controversial statement of former BJP spokesperson Nupur Sharma on Prophet Mohammed.Many other users have cited that apart from the controversial remarks on Prophet Mohammed, the reason behind this decision of the UAE was beating Indian Muslims and running bulldozers on their homes. South Asian Journal had claimed on its Twitter account that after the controversial remark of Nupur Sharma on Prophet Mohammed, the UAE has banned the export of wheat from India. They captioned an article in Khaleej Times – “UAE bans export of Indian wheat. Comes after Prophet Mohammad insulted and Muslims beaten and homes demolished in India.”https://twitter.com/sajournal1/status/1536978681540640768/Soon the tweet went viral with more than a hundred retweets.Also ReadFact CheckWe did a simple search on Google for the viral claim. We found a report published on the website of ‘ Aaj Tak ‘. It is clearly mentioned in this report that the UAE has banned the export of wheat or flour purchased from India to other countries for 4 months. It has also been written that the UAE has taken this decision only at the request of the Government of India. Because India wants the wheat exported by it to UAE to be used for its domestic consumption.Further, when we looked at the Khaleej Times report, it was mentioned that The Ministry of Economy explained that this decision comes in view of the international developments that have affected trade flows and in appreciation of the solid and strategic relations that bind the UAE and India, especially after the signing of the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (Cepa) between the two countries and the Indian government’s approval to export wheat to the UAE for domestic consumption.Conclusionso it is clear that the claim made by the South Asian Journal is misleading. In this fact check many misleading things are coming out, which are as follows.UAE has not imposed restrictions on importing wheat from India.The UAE has banned the export of wheat or flour imported from India to any other country.At present, this ban has been imposed for only 4 months.The UAE has taken this decision on the request of the Government of India.The UAE’s ban on Indian wheat exports has nothing to do with the controversial statement of a BJP spokesperson on the Prophet Mohammed in India.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did lakhs of Hindus chanted Hanuman Chalisa in response to Namaz in Jaipur? A video is going viral on social media. In this video, there is a huge crowd of people on the road under a metro station. Slogans are being raised by the crowd. Users sharing this video are claiming that this video is from Jaipur, the capital of Rajasthan. They claim that Ram Bhakts have recited Hanuman Chalisa on the road while answering Namaz in Jaipur.Sharing the video, a user named Arvind Kumar Singh wrote – ” While answering Namaz in Jaipur, Ram devotees read Hanuman Chalisa on the middle road .. My heart became happy seeing their numbers. My Hindu has woken up. Jai Shri Ram ”At the same time, many other users have also shared this video with the same claim.Fact Check:To know the truth of the video going viral, we reverse searched some of the frames of the video. On searching, we found a video uploaded on the YouTube channel of Labbaik News on January 4, 2021. It is written in the description of this video that this video is from Chehallum of Allama Khadim Hussain Rizvi. Let us tell you that Labbaik News is a Pakistani channel.Conclusion:This fact check proves that the video going viral is not from Jaipur but from Pakistan. Hanuman Chalisa is also not being recited in the video. Hence the claim being made by social media users is false and misleading.Claim- Lakhs of Hindus answered the Namaz in Jaipur by reciting Hanuman ChalisaClaimant- Social media usersFact Check – Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: The image of a crowded river from Finland went viral as it is of the US. An image is going viral on social media sites with the claim that it is of the United States. Further sharing the a Facebook user Fox Sports Radio 1400 Texarkana, shared the image with the caption, “Guadalupe River in New Braunsfel, Tx this weekend.” The Guadalupe River is in Texas, America.Moreover, many other user have shared this picture with the same claim.Fact checkOn reverse image search we found a tweet of Discovering Finland of July, 2017. And, the caption of the Tweet is, “What kind of activities do you think people can enjoy in Finland? Lots!! http://discoveringfinland.com/activities/ Activities gallery: https://fi.pinterest.com/DiscoverFinland/things-to-do-in-finland/.” It is noteworthy that this tweet also have the viral picture.https://twitter.com/DiscoverFinland/status/890537733466316800Further, we also found the same picture on the website of kaljakellunta.org. kaljakellunta is a Finnish word that means floating beer festival.Also Read: Analysing the Pakistan-Based Disinformation Campaign.Also Read: Pakistani Journalist Asad Kharal spreads misleading news against India.ConclusionTherefore, The viral mage is of Finland not from United States. Hence, users are sharing this picture with misleading claims.Claim: The crowded river is Guadalupe River. Claimed by: social media users Fact Check: Misleading(For more such update, follow DFRAC on Twitter, Facebook and YouTube)
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: A video went viral with the claim that Gulf countries are sending back the Indians. Know the complete truth. A video is getting viral on the internet with the claim that the Gulf countries are sending back Indians who have migrated there for work. Further, sharing the video a user named Lallulal Yadav wrote the caption, “कुवैत से घर वापसी(gharwapsi in Kuwait).”Similarly, another user Surendra Sharma shared the video with caption, “Arab Qatar was the first which fired people from Kuwait, ready to come to India, there is no livelihood here, not even foreigners have eaten* Some 60,000 people are being returned to India from Arab countries. Action has started in Qatar Kuwait Arab countries. If Modi is there, its possible.”(“अरब कतर कुवैत से पहला नौकरी से निकाल दिया गया लोग भारत आने के लिए तैयार यहां तो रोजी रोटी है नही विदेशो का भी खा गया *कोई लगभग 60,000 लोग अरब देश से भारत वापस किये जा रहे हैं. कतर कुवैत अरब देशों में कार्रवाई चालू हो गई है. मोदी है तो मुमकिन है”)Likewise, many other users have shared the video with the similar claim.Fact CheckOn our fact check analysis, we found the same video on YouTube.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CcrzNkvSdgcThe video is of a strike by wokers in Redco international Company. Further, we found another such video on Youtube.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yOZRxAb_YlIln the description of the video it is written that,” Redco international company video worker salary problems and strike 3 month Al Rayyan Industrial Area 47.”ConclusionTherefore, the video is not related to any deportation of Indians from Gulf Countries. Hence the claims of users are misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Is BJP responsible for the recent Kanpur Violence? A video is vividly getting viral on social media in the context of recent Kanpur violence. It is claimed that in the video the police officers are clearly blaming BJP (Bharatiya Janta Party) for the violence, still, no action is taken against them.A user shared the video on Facebook with the caption, “In Kanpur, the police themselves are saying that BJP MLA has brought bombs. He is telling one of his senior officers. But still, no one has been arrested, only innocent Muslims are being arrested. (Translates Hindi)Many more social media users shared the video with similar claims.Fact Check:We searched some keywords, and many similar videos were found. ‘Mojo Story’ has uploaded the same video in July 2021 and writes – “During the counting of Uttar Pradesh’s Block Pramukh elections, SP City of Etawah district was allegedly slapped. SP City was caught on camera talking on a phone call and saying he has been slapped and the mob came with stones and bombs. He reportedly said that BJP MLA and District President were leading the mob.”News channels like NDTV and AajTak too covered this report, from the year 2021.Conclusion:Old video of UP Police blaming the BJP for thnce is being falsely linked to the recent Kanpur violence.Claim Review: the police officers blaming BJP for the Kanpur violence.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: misleading
label: truth

content: Muslims killed a policeman in Bengal?, Read Fact Check A video is becoming increasingly viral on social media. It can be seen in this video that the dead body of a policeman lying in blood on the road. There is a crowd around the corpse, in which some members of the Muslim community can be seen. In this video, a man can be seen talking angrily at another person.Users sharing this video are claiming that this policeman has been killed by the Muslim community. Sharing this video, Pt. Varun Parashar (@VarunPa15556594) tweeted- “Muslim rioters kill policeman in Kolkata, then threaten his partner too. @Mamata Banerjee”https://twitter.com/VarunPa15556594/status/1536019253760913410?s=20&t=Pj0FWWz-K3l0ddi0FC0nEQAt the same time, a user named SS Nauhwar (@Sonvir_Singh12) tweeted- “Just in Kolkata, rioters killed a policeman, after that his partner is also threatening. Tag any Bengali ku@ya brother.https://twitter.com/Sonvir_Singh12/status/1536051915980648448?s=20&t=Pj0FWWz-K3l0ddi0FC0nEQFact Check:To make the video go viral, the team of DFRAC reverse searched some of the frames of the video. During this, we found a video uploaded on 10th June 2022 on the official YouTube channel of “NDTV”. The caption of this video “Cop Opens Fire Outside Bangladesh High Commission In Kolkata, Kills Self”According to this NDTV report, a police constable posted at the Bangladesh High Commission in Kolkata fired several rounds before shooting himself today. A woman reportedly died during this firing.Conclusion:This fact check proves that the claims being made by social media users are misleading and false. The death of the policeman does not appear to be from the protesters, but it appears to be a suicide committed by him.Claim Review- Muslims killed a policeman in BengalClaimed by Social media usersFact Check – Misleading
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: CJ Werleman again shared a video with misleading claim. CJ Welreman Posted a video of a man threatening Muslims on 12th June 2022. Further, he gave it a caption, “Modi’s Hindus are now posting their promise to kill Muslims on social media with total impunity.”Soon, thousands of other social media users retweeted his tweet. And, many other users shared this video with the similar claim.Fact CheckOn our analysis of the video we found a same post but of 2020.The man in the video is identified as Yogesh and he made the video in Lucknow. Further, we a report of Etvbharat of March 1, 2020. In the report it was mentioned that the Police has arrested the person who was was making abusive remarks on Muslims.Many other media houses had also covered the incident of the arrest of this man.Also Read: Who is CJ Werleman?Also Read: Another Deceptive Tweet by CJ Werleman To Defame Hindus. Know The Full Story.ConclusionHence, it is clear that CJ Werleman have posted an old video with misleading claim.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Reality Of The Video In Which A Dalit Man Was Tied To A Tree And Beaten Up. A video of a man being tied to a tree and beaten up is going viral on the internet. Users are claiming that a YSR party member had tied a Dalit man to a tree and beat him up with shoes.Further, sharing the video a Facebook user Kripal Verma wrote the caption which can be nearly translated into English, “The video is from Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh. A person belonging to the Dalit caste is being tied up and beaten up with shoes. The beater is the leader of the ruling YSR party. The condition of Dalits is similar all over India. I am saying again, can anyone other than Dalits be tied with shoes and killed?”Similarly, many other users have shared this video on their user handle.Also Read: Prophet Row- Analysing the Pakistan-Based Disinformation CampaignFactcheckOn our fact check analysis, we found a report of The Hindu. According to the report the name of the victim is Tarakeswara Rao. And, the man who is beating Tarakeswara is Suri Babu. It is noteworthy that both of them belong to Dalit Community. The incident took place over a dispute on a Mobile phone. As of now the accused is under custody. Furthermore, the accused not a leader of YSR party.ConclusionHence, there is no Dalit and YSR party angle involved in the incident. Therefore, the claim related to the viral video is misleading.Claim: YSR party leader beat up a Dalit man with shoes after tying him to a tree. Claimed by: Kripal Verma and other social media users. Fact Check: Fake and Misleading(For more such update, follow DFRAC on Twitter, Facebook and YouTube)
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Old video of firing went viral as Kanpur riots A video is going viral on social media sites in the name of Kanpur’s violence over the protest against the Nupur Sharma controversy. In this video, some gunmen can be seen who is buffed with anger and are firing.A user named Sampat Kumar Saraswat captioned it, “These are the Jihadis of Kanpur, who were openly firing recklessly with state-of-the-art weapons and the police were leaving only tear gas shells, their cure is direct bullets, once if ten-twenty are killed then these guys will not behave like this”, and posted a video in which some people can be seen who are firing guns in anger, the fight is in full swing.Similarly, many other users are also fiercely sharing the viral video with the same claim.Fact Check:On reverse image search of different frames of this video on the internet, we found that this video is of a fight between two parties of a community in Bareilly in May 2021. This incident has been covered by Dainik Bhaskar and Etv Bharat.According to Etv Bharat, there was a dispute over meat between Salim Qureshi and Jalis Banjara, residents of Madhotanda in the Bhojipura police station area. According to the police, there was a fight between the two over the price of meat. Within no time the quarrel escalated so much that fighting started between both the sides and openly waving weapons and firing was also done.Bareilly Police had released its statement on Twitter upon it.Conclusion:DFRAC’s fact check proved that the claim being made by the users is fake, as the video through which the claim is being made is old and not from Kanpur, but from Bareilly.Claim review: Some were openly firing recklessly in Kanpur riots.Claimed by: Social Media UsersFact Check: FakeAlso read:
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Pakistani Journalist Asad Kharal spreads misleading news against India Award-winning Investigative Journalist-Chief Analyst/Anchor of Pakistan, Asad Kharal shared a video of a mob Lynching targeting Hindu extremists. Further, he gave the caption to his post, “Another inhumane act of extremist Hindu terrorists in India Extreme criminal silence and hypocrisy of these atrocities by international human rights organizations and so-called human rights activists.”Soon his tweet was retweeted more than Three Thousand times. Likewise, another social media account who have shown it’s location, Kuwait shared the video with the similar claim.Similarly, many other social media users have shared this video targeting Hindu Extremists ant trying to give communal color to the incident.Also Read: Prophet Row- Analysing the Pakistan-Based Disinformation CampaignFact CheckUsing InVID tool on different frames of the video, we found that actually this is an old video. The incident is of Madhya Pradesh. The Times of India have covered this report on 5 February, 2020. In the report they have shared the same video with the title, “One killed, six injured over child-lifting rumour in Madhya Pradesh’s Dhar. “Similarly, many other media houses including AajTak have covered this incident. The victims were visiting Borlai village to ask some laborer’s. The person who was killed in this was identified as Ganesh. And, the incident was nowhere related to any communal issue. It matter was of money dispute. Moreover, Police had investigated against the people accused.ConclusionHence, our fact check proves that no communal angle was involved in the incident. Therefore, the claims of the social media users are fake as well as reprehensible.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Rajesh Pilot did not contest the election of Congress Sangathan  against Sonia Gandhi A claim about Sachin Pilot’s father Rajesh Pilot is going viral on social media. Rajesh Pilot was a big leader of Congress and former Union Minister. Social media users are claiming on Twitter that he had contested the election of Congress Sangathan against Sonia Gandhi.On Twitter, there is a verified user named Ashok Kataria ( @ Ashokkatariya9 ), sharing a picture of Rajesh Pilot, he wrote – “ India’s famous politician, who has given a strong challenge to the slave cult of Congress by fighting the Sangathan election against Sonia Gandhi, former Regards, on the death anniversary of Rajesh Pilot ji, Union Minister, strong spokesperson of farmers.According to the bio of Ashok Kataria, he is a member of the Legislative Council of Uttar Pradesh.Fact Check:To check the viral claim, we searched some keywords on Google. During which we found a report published on 13 July 2020 on the website of ‘Aaj Tak ‘ . According to this report, Rajesh Pilot contested the election of Congress President in 1997 against Sitaram Kesari. However, in this election, Sitarat Kesari defeated both Rajesh Pilot and Sharad Pawar. After which Sonia Gandhi joined Congress in 1997 and in 1998 she became the President of Congress for the first time.At the same time, according to the report of ‘News-18 Hindi ‘ also, Rajesh Pilot had contested the election of Congress President against Sitaram Kesari.According to both these reports, he did not contest against Sonia Gandhi but against Sitaram Kesari.Conclusion:DFRAC proves that Pilot did not contest for the post of Congress President against Sonia Gandhi. Hence the claim being made by Ashok Kataria and other social media users is misleading.Claim- Rajesh Pilot fought the election of the Sagathan against Sonia GandhiClaimed by: Ashok Kataria ( @Ashokkatariya9 )Fact Check – Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Old video went viral with the claim that ‘a Hindu man thrashed in Kuwait’ After the controversial remarks made by former BJP leaders Nupur Sharma and Naveen Kumar Jindal on Prophet Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ, social media has been flooded with photos and videos, which are being fiercely shared with different claims.A user named Al Barboushi Mahmoud captioned in Arabic, “A Hindu supporter of “Modi” made a video trampling the “Holy Quran” in Kuwait, one of his colleagues at the restaurant informed muslims reportedly, angry Kuwaiti youth thrashed him.” (English Translate)Apart from this, other users are also sharing this video.Fact Check:After reverse search images of some frames of this video on the internet, we found the same video on September 2020 by ابو فطيمه الصعيدي (Abu Futima Assaidi) with Arabic caption, “Asian worker who insulted the Holy Quran in Kuwait thrashed by Kuwaiti youth.#AboFtiama”At the same time, we also found a statement in Arabic language issued by the Ministry of Interior of Kuwait on Instagram. It has been told in this statement that action was taken in the case of making a video of a person insulting the Holy Quran. He has been arrested and handed over to the concerned authorities. A strong message has been given at the end of this statement that (Kuwait’s) Ministry of Home Affairs will not tolerate anyone who insults the religion of Islam.Conclusion:This fact check by DFRAC proves that this video is old, which is being shared by users with a misleading claim.Claim Review: Hindu man beaten up in KuwaitClaimed by: Social Media UsersFact Check: Misleading(Follow #DFRAC on Twitter, Facebook, and YouTube.)
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Picture of a female anchor from Afghanistan, being viral as that Qatar In the context of Nupur Sharma controversy, photos and videos are becoming viral on social media sites with different claims.A user named NATHU RAM GODSE The Most Discussed Man shared a picture with the caption, “Qatari Anchor Fatima Shaikh on national TV expressing concern about religious freedom in India”. In this picture, a burqa-clad woman with her head bowed, her hand on her forehead, is seen almost in pity.Similarly, a user named AdvisorZaidu captioned,”Qatari Anchor Fatima Shaikh on national TV expressing concern about religious freedom in India.”Fact Check: This picture was found on AP IMAGES after doing reverse search image on the internet. In this TV anchor Khatereh Ahmadi bows her head while wearing a face covering as she reads the news on TOLO NEWS, in Kabul, Afghanistan, Sunday, May 22, 2022.Afghanistan’s Taliban rulers have begun enforcing an order requiring all female TV news anchors in the country to cover their faces while on-air.At the same time, we also found tweet from the official Twitter handle of Tolo News, according to which the Islamic Emirate in a new order has demanded all female presenters working in TV channels to cover their faces while presenting the program.The Islamic Emirate in a new order demanded all female presenters working in all TV channels to cover their faces while presenting programs… 1/2#TOLOnews — TOLOnews (@TOLOnews) May 19, 2022Conclusion:It is clear from this fact check of DFRAC that the claim being made by the users is fake, because the image on which this claim is being made is not from Qatar but from Afghanistan.Claim Review: Qatar’s anchor Fatima Shaikh on National TV expressing concern about religious freedom in IndiaClaimed by: Social Media UsersFact Check: FakeAlso Read:Fact Check: Did Moen Ali boycott IPL over the Nupur Sharma controversy?
label: truth

content: Fact Check: The truth behind Pardhan Mantri Loan Yojna. A Post on the name of a scheme called Pardhan Mantri Loan Yojna is getting viral on social media sites. It is being claimed that the loan provides a subsidized loan of up to 20 lakh rupees.Many users shared the below screenshot with different captions of Pradhan Mantri Yojana Loan.In many captions, the link for the application is also provided that can be downloaded from the play store.Fact Check:We initiate by clicking on the link and found no such application on the play store.After this we reverse searched the image using the keyframes and found nothing related to this scheme on the internet. Also, there is no such media report on this scheme.The website provided on the ‘प्रधानमंत्री लोन योजना INDIA’ Facebook page is also not working. also, ‘Pradhan’ is spelled wrong as “prdhan” in the website address.‘Press Information Bureau (PIB)’ also tweeted that there is no such central government scheme.Conclusion:DFRAC found that this image and Facebook page is spreading the picture with fake claim.Claim Review: Pardhan Mantri Loan Yojna is getting viral on social media sites. It is being claimed that the loan provides a subsidized loan of up to 20 lakh rupees.Claimed by: social media users.Fact check: fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check: ‘Zee Hindustan’ gave false information, SSP said – stop spreading fake news! Fake news and misinformation keep spreading on social media. Not only social media users are involved in spreading this fake news but also the mainstream media. A misleading video was shown in the news by ABP News regarding the Kanpur riots, whose fact check has been done by DFRAC with the headline – “Fact Check: ABP News and BJP leader shared an old video of 2020 as Kanpur riots”.At the same time, a piece of information was circulated from the verified and official Twitter handle of the news channel “Zee Hindustan”. “Zee Hindustan” tweeted – ““जुमे की नमाज के बाद देवबंद में हंगामा!”जुमे की नमाज के बाद देवबंद में हंगामा! — Zee Bharat (@ZeeBharatOFCL_) June 10, 2022Fact Check:This claim made by Zee Hindustan was investigated by our team. During this, we got a tweet from Saharanpur SSP Akash Tomar (@akashtomarips). SSP Akash Tomar replied by retweeting the tweet of ‘Zee Hindustan’ – “Stop spreading fake news. The situation is totally normal! No incident at all in deoband.”https://twitter.com/akashtomarips/status/1535174601478590464?s=20&t=PErPP9uQMIUUDEiedmHNRgConclusion:SSP Akash Tomar’s explanation proves that the conditions are absolutely normal in Deoband. No incident of any kind has happened here. Hence the claim made by “Zee Hindustan” is misleading and fake.Claim Review- Uproar after Friday prayers in DeobandClaimed by- Zee HindustanFact Check – Fake
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: A video went viral with the claim that Rohingya Muslims killed a Hindu man. Know the truth. A video of a man beaten to death in broad daylight is going viral on the internet. Users are sharing this heinous video with the claim that in the video Rohingya Muslims killed a Hindu man.Further, a user name @KNMishra_, have shared the video with the captioned, “In the scorching summer afternoon, the Rohingya Muslims beat up a Hindu youth with stones, kept beating him till he could not stop breathing. Finally ripped him with a knife so that there was no possibility of his survival at all. Government should expel all Rohigyas from the country.”Similarly, many other users have shared this video.Fact CheckUsing InVid tool on the different frames of the video we found the same video on YouTube. The Times of India uploaded this video on June 4, 2022 with the title, “Viral Video: Man brutally killed by two brothers in Delhi’s Azadpur.”Furthermore, according to a report of Indian Express, the incident is of Adarsh Nagar, New Delhi where A 28-year-old man was allegedly murdered by two brothers. The accused brothers have been identified as Rahul and Rohit Kali. The victim, Narender alias Bunti, and Rahul were previously involved in cases of robbery and snatching,” said DCP (Northwest) Usha Rangnani.Also Read: DID MOEN ALI BOYCOTT IPL OVER THE NUPUR SHARMA CONTROVERSY?ConclusionHence, the viral claim that Rohingya Muslims Killed a Hindu is wrong.Claim: Rohingya Muslims Killed a Hindu is wrong. Claimed by: Social media users Fact Check: Fake(For more such update, follow DFRAC on Twitter, Facebook and YouTube)
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did Moen Ali boycott IPL over the Nupur Sharma controversy? A screenshot of a tweet is becoming fiercely viral on social media sites. Through this, it is claimed that famous English cricketer Moen Ali has boycotted the IPL. A user named Mohammad Quamar captioned it on Facebook, “Respect Moen Ali ??? ????ℎ?? ??? ??????. ??? ????ℎ?? ??? ????????. ??? ????ℎ?? ??? ???????. ??? ????ℎ?? ??? ??????. ??? ????ℎ?? ??? ?????. ??? ????ℎ?? ??? ????. ??? ????ℎ?? ??? ????. ?? ???? ????? ???????? ?????? ?? ??? ??????? ????ℎ?? ??ℎ????? #ProphetmuhammaThe tweet has been deleted by the Twitter handle @Moeen_Ali18 seen in the screenshot . But its archive link is being given here.A user named Zohaib Khan, supporter of Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) shared the same screenshot with the caption #MoeenAli Love you bhai ” .Similarly, another user Shezz malik shared the post with the caption, “England Star Moen Ali reacted on blasphemous remarks made by #nupursharma Well done #MoeenAli.”Fact Check:On searching the internet with this quote, we found that neither the viral tweet is of Moen Ali nor the Twitter account. But, he is not active on Twitter nor has he commented on the controversy.Furthermore , we searched the official Twitter account of Moen Ali , but could not find anything. On Ali’s profile on the official website of the England Cricket Board , all linked social media accounts were either inactive or unavailable. The Twitter account being referred to is @MoeenAli Is. It has 111 followers while tweet is zero. This is an unverified account.After this, we did not even find some media reports on search of Moeen Ali’s statement. Recently Ali toured India to play for Chennai in the 15th edition of IPL.Also Read: ARE THE PEOPLE DRIVING OVER THE INDIA FLAG ON THE STREETS OF TAMIL NADU?Conclusion:Hence, English cricketer Moen Ali has not posted any such tweet. Therefore, the social media users are sharing it with the wrong claim.Claim: Moen Ali boycotted said to IPL over Nupur Sharma controversyClaim by: Social Media UsersFact Check: Fake
label: truth

content: Hindu women in Pakistan thrashed by the mob? Read Fact Check A video is being shared on social media. It is being claimed that women of the Hindu community are being mistreated in Pakistan. These women have been thrashed by a mob and stripped of their clothes and made naked.Sharing this video on Twitter, a user named Pandit Kalkiram wrote – “The scene of the brutality being done to Hindus in Pakistan is disturbing. What justice can be expected from all the Islamic countries of the world including @UN, who advocates humanity and @OIC_OCI, who leads the Islamic world. @HumaneSociety @UNHumanRights @POTUS”https://twitter.com/Pt_kalkiram/status/1534759981970427906?s=20&t=5DY18vas-Un67Fy3ekbeWgFact Check:Our team investigated the claim of the video going viral. We searched most of the keywords on Google. This have been published on the website of ‘News-18 Hindi’ on December 10, 2021 with the title- “Shameful video surfaced from Pakistan, clothes of girls exposed on the streets of Chorni Bata”.According to this report, these women, who were rag pickers in Faisalabad, Pakistan, were inhumanely treated by a shopkeeper by accusing them of theft. Many screenshots published in this report have been photographed of the same women who are in the viral video. There is no mention anywhere in this report that these women belong to the Hindu community. At the same time, many other websites and media houses have covered this incident. But nowhere it is written that they are women of the Hindu community.At the same time, Pakistani journalist Reem Khurshid also tweeted on this incident on 7 December 2021 and criticized the incident.https://twitter.com/ReemKhurshid/status/1468194858930249738?s=20&t=0s-fZxFYihHb8OF4mcqcmw“Hi Allah” is being said by the women who are being abused in the video. This signifies the women probably belong to the Muslim community.Conclusion:The investigation of DFRAC proves that the women who are being treated inhumanly do not belong to the Hindu community. Hence the claim being made by social media users is misleading.Claim Review- Hindu women were beaten up naked in PakistanClaimed by- Social media usersFact Check – Misleading
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Truth Behind the pictures of destroyed houses shared by Salman Khurshid? Some pictures of destroyed houses went viral from the account of Salman Khurshid, Senior Advocate of Supreme Court of India and former Minister for corporate affairs, water resources, minority affairs, law & justice, and external affairs.He tweeted from his account, “Not Ukraine, these are photos of Unnao and Farrukhabad of Buldozerland.”Not Ukraine, these are photos of Unnao and Farrukhabad of Buldozerland pic.twitter.com/K3K66G36Jr — Salman Khurshid (@salman7khurshid) June 7, 2022A user on Twitter writes, “Shocking Pictures shared by @salman7khurshid from Unnao n Farrukhabad. Such was the corruption that people had built 2-3 stories illegal houses/apartments Well done Mahant Ji @myogiadityanath.”Shocking Pictures shared by @salman7khurshid from Unnao n Farrukhabad.Such was the corruption that people had built 2-3 storeys illegal houses/apartmentsWell done Mahant ji @myogiadityanath pic.twitter.com/ROMEdlYd5D — AgentVinod (@AgentVinod03) June 7, 2022Fact Check:To know the authenticity of the viral pictures we reverse searched different images.We found the same pictures in the report of Amaj Ujala with the headline, “encroachment drive launched.” From the same report, we found that the pictures are from Unnao, but from the year 2016.Conclusion:After the Fact Check by DFRAC we found that the pictures shared by Salman Khurshid is Misleading as the viral pictures are from the year 2016.Claim Review: Some pictures of destroyed houses went viral from the account of Salman Khurshid.Claimed by: Salman KhurshidFact Check: misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: The news of the death of  former Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad is getting viral. Know the truth behind it. A post is becoming very viral on social media with the claim that former Prime Minister of Malaysia Mahathir Mohamad passed away.Further, a facebook user posted in Urdu and wrote that “Inna Lillahe and Inna Ilaihe Rajioon.” An era has ended. Hero of Muslim Ummah, Fearless Leader, And the founder of modern Malaysia died. May Allah give Mahathir Muhammad sahib a high position in paradise.Similarly, many other Pakistani users shared this post, written in Urdu.Fact Check:To verify the above claim, we first visited the official Twitter account of Mahathir Mohamad. But, there was no news related to his death on his Twitter.In October 1995, I visited Republic of Peru. Peru was then led by President Alberto Fujimori. As a trading nation, Malaysia was always exploring new markets for our products. pic.twitter.com/dF2Xl6J5Bp — Dr Mahathir Mohamad (@chedetofficial) June 3, 2022However, we found a tweet by him on June 3. In which he shared a post about his meeting with Ricardo Estanislao Morote Canales, Ambassador of the Republic of Peru to Malaysia. And, in the pictures, the two dignitaries are shaking hands and chatting.Apart from this , a report of AP News was found. In which a photo of him was published while attending the International Conference on “The Future of Asia” in Tokyo , Japan on 27 May 2022.Also Read: ARE THE PEOPLE DRIVING OVER THE INDIA FLAG ON THE STREETS OF TAMIL NADU?Conclusion:Therefore, it is clear that the news of the death of former Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad is fake .Claim: Former Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad passes awayClaimant: Facebook userFact Check: Fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Know the truth behind the viral video of Mooseswala’s murder. Famous Punjabi Singer Shubhdeep Singh Sidhu, popular by his stage name Sidhu Moose Wala, was shot dead in Jawaharke village of Mansa district in Punjab on May 29, 2022.Soon after Punjab government reportedly reduced his security to half.A video of some man openly firing another person is getting viral on social media claiming how Moosewala was murdered.Along with the viral video, a voiceover can be heard in the background, “See it on the TV screen, those who killed Moose Wala are in front of you. Watch on your TV screens who killed Moose Wala’. The voiceover goes on to narrate the make of the weapons used in Moose Wala’s murder.”(Translates Punjabi)A Facebook User writes,” Waheguru Ji, see how the killer of Musa attacked.”Many social media users shared the same video which can be seen here , here.Fact Check:We reverse Searched the image using certain keyframes. We found a video on a YouTube Channel under the caption, “Badnam Gabru song| in neeraj bawana attack on Road PoliceWe searched more and found that this is a scene from a series called “Shukla the Tiger.”Also, NDTV has uploaded a real video of how Moosewala was murdered on thei8r official Youtube channel.Also Read:Conclusion:The video is getting viral with misleading claim, as the video is from a series not from the murder of Moosewala.Claim Review: some man openly firing another person is getting viral on social media claiming how Moosewala was murdered.Claimed by : many social media users.Fact Check: misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Are the people driving over the India Flag on the streets of Tamil Nadu? A video is getting viral on the internet where some people are driving over the holy Flag of India. People are claiming that the video is from Tamil Nadu. Further, sharing the video, a user named Jayesh Patel wrote, “watch this video and forward it as much as you can…if u keep quiet today we will be at a loss…because after 6 months there will be no use to pursue it…move the fingers and forward it now. -Tanjore, Tamil Nadu.”Similarly, many people have shared this video on their social media handles.Fact CheckUsing InVid tool on the different frames of the video and keyword research, we found a twitter post of 2020. The post is similar to a screenshot of the video. Therefore, this video is an old video.Furthermore, watching the viral video carefully, we found a shop labelled as Sanam Boutique. Using google maps we found that the location of the shop is in Karachi, Pakistan. Comparing a screenshot of the viral video from a video of YouTube of the streets of Karachi, we found both are similar.Also Read: PAKISTANI MEDIA IS MANIPULATING THE STATEMENT OF OMAN’S GRAND MUFTI.ConclusionThe viral video is of the streets of Karachi Pakistan. Hence, the claims of the users that the video is of Tamil Nadu is wrong.
label: truth

content: When Indians were fighting the British, then RSS workers were giving a salute to the Queen of Britain? Read Fact Check A picture of RashtriyaSwayamsevakSangh (RSS) workers is going viral on social media. In which some youth are standing in RSS costume and a woman can be seen passing. It was claimed that this woman is the Queen of Britain.Sharing this picture, a Facebook user wrote, “Britain Mata Ki Jai. This photo is hard to capture and should reach every phone. Let everyone know who is the traitor to the country. When the whole country was fighting with the British, some traitors were saluting the Queen of England. I have heard that their descendants call themselves patriots.(Translates Hindi)Fact CheckTo check the viral claim, we did a reverse search image of the image. We found this picture on the website of Deccan Chronicle and Jagran. Which was published on 26 February 2015.Apart from this, when we did a Google reverse image search on the part of the Queen of Britain. So we got a report from CNN. In which the image credits for the picture are given to Getty Images.After doing some keyword searches, we found this picture on the website of Getty Images. Where the photograph is reported, Queen Elizabeth II inspects men of the newly-named Queen’s Own Nigeria Regiment, Royal West African Frontier Force, at Kaduna Airport, Nigeria, during her Commonwealth tour on 2 February 1956.So it is clear that the viral picture is edited. Also, the claim made with the picture is fake.Claim Review: When Indians were fighting the British, then RSS workers were giving a salute to the Queen of Britain.Claimed by: Social media usersFact Check: Fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Former Pakistani Ambassador Abdul Basit’s misleading claim about Naveen Jindal Former Pakistan ambassador Abdul Basit has claimed that BJP leader Naveen Kumar Jindal is the brother of famous industrialist Sajjan Jindal.YouTube channel Kaleidoscope captiond , “Imran Khan Deserves Credit and Uploaded 7.14 min video with “Moditva” Draws Flak From Muslim World.In the intro of the video, Abdul Basit claimed, “Everybody knows Naveen Jindal, who is very famous in our Pakistan, younger brother of (industrialist) Sajjan Jindal.” Next he talks about the reaction of the Muslim world. As evident from the caption, he credits all this to the former Prime Minister of Pakistan, Imran Khan.Fact Check:We searched on the internet about BJP leader Naveen Kumar Jindal and found that BJP leader Naveen Jindal has nothing to do with industrialist Sajjan Jindal.Industrialist Jindal does not have Kumar in his name, while the BJP leader has “Kumar” in his name.Sajjan Jindal’s brother, “Naveen Jindal“, mentioned by former Pakistani Ambassador Abdul Basit, is a billionaire industrialist from India. He defeated his nearest rival Abhay Singh Chautala from Kurukshetra, Haryana by a margin of 130,000 votes in 2004 on a Congress party ticket. In 2009, he was re-elected to the Lok Sabha.Conclusion:It is clear from this fact check of DFRAC that the claim made by former Pakistani Ambassador Abdul Basit is misleading.Claim Review: BJP leader Naveen Jindal is the brother of famous industrialist Sajjan Kumar Jindal Claimed by: Former Pakistani Ambassador Abdul Basit Fact Check: Misleading(Follow #DFRAC on Twitter, Facebook, and YouTube.)
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did Sourav Ganguly resign as the President of the BCCI? On social media, many users are claiming that former Cricketer Sourav Ganguly has resigned from the position of President of BCCI.People are sharing such images, a user on Facebook writes, “Saurabh Ganguly resigned from the post of BCCI President.” with the image that states the above mentioned in Hindi.Another user on Facebook shared a screenshot from ABP Live which states that Sourav Ganguly is resigning as the president of BCCI as he is planning to start something that will help a lot of people.Fact Check:After a tweet by Sourav that states, “ I am planning to strat something that I feel will propaby help a lot of people .” people thought that he is resigning from the position of President of BCCI.But, in that tweet there was no mention of his resigning from his position.Looking at all the viral news about this matter ANI posted from its official account Denying the resign of Sourav Ganguly.ANI writes, “Sourav Ganguly has not resigned as the president of BCCI: Jay Shah, BCCI Secretary to ANI.”Sourav Ganguly has not resigned as the president of BCCI: Jay Shah, BCCI Secretary to ANI pic.twitter.com/C2O3r550aL — ANI (@ANI) June 1, 2022Conclusion:Hence, the viral news of Sourav Ganguly resining from the position of BCCI president is fake.Claim Review: Sourav Ganguli resign as the President of the BCCI.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: Fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Pakistani media is manipulating the statement of Oman’s grand mufti. The derogatory remark of the ex-BJP member Nupur Sharma against Prophet Mohammed is getting condemned all over the World. A trend #BoycottIndianProducts is trending on social media. Meanwhile, a piece of news is getting viral that Oman’s Grand Mufti Ahmed Al-Khalili has called for the #BoycottIndianProducts.Many media reports including ARY News have published the articles with the same claim.Moreover, many Indian media houses like News24, Hindustan Times, Reddit, and Times of India have claimed that Ahmed Al Khalili has started the trend of boycotting Indian Products.Fact CheckIn our analysis, we checked the official Twitter account of @AhmedHalKhalili. We found a tweet in which he strongly criticized the ongoing matter and asked all Muslim to rise as one nation.He tweeted in Arabic which can be nearly translated into English, “The insolent and obscene rudeness of the official spokesman for the ruling extremist party in India against the Messenger of Islam, peace be upon him, and his pure wife, Mother of the Believers Aisha, may God be pleased with her, is a war against every Muslim in the east and west of the earth, and it is a matter that calls for all Muslims to rise as one nation.”The noteworthy thing is that there is no mention of the boycott of Indian Products in any of his Tweets.ConclusionTherefore, the claims of media houses that Oman’s grand Mufti have started the trend #BoycottIndianProducts is deceptive.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Reality of the image which got viral as Uttarkashi bus accident. On 5th June, a very tragic accident took place in Uttarkashi where at least 25 pilgrims from Penna, Madhya Pradesh died. After the tragedy, social media was flooded with many pictures of the accident. Meanwhile, an image of a bus accident is getting viral on the internet. Sharing the image social media users are claiming that, 25 pilgrims from Madhya Pradesh died in a bus accident.Further, sharing the picture, a social media user Sanjay Satyaedra Pathak wrote,” the death of 25 pilgrims from our neighboring district of Panna in Madhya Pradesh on pilgrimage to Chardham in Uttarakhand after the bus going to Yamunotri Dham fell into the gorge. May God give peace to the departed souls. Om Shanti Santi!”Similarly, another user Abhilash Pandey wrote, “The death of the pilgrims on the pilgrimage to Chardham in Uttarakhand after the bus going to Yamunotri Dham fell into the gorge. May God give peace to the departed souls.”Many users have shared this picture on their social media handle with the similar claimFact CheckOn reverse image search of the viral picture, we found the same image in an article by Amar Ujala dated 14th February 2022. The article was about Himachal: HRTC bus rolled into a ditch nd stopped after hitting eight trees.Furthermore, we found the viral picture on the website of newshindi.ConclusionHence, the viral picture is not of the accident where 25 pilgrims from Madhya Pradesh died .
