Therefore, from our fact check analysis it is clear that users are sharing this picture with a misleading claim.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Did PM Modi stop the Russia-Ukraine war for 3 hours to evacuate Indian students? Making a big claim about the Russia-Ukraine war, Former Union Minister Ravi Prasad said that Prime Minister Narendra Modi has halted the war for 3 hours so that Indian students can be taken out safely.'PM Modi ने 3 घंटे तक रुकवाया था रूस-यूक्रेन युद्ध', Putin ने मानी Modi की बात, तब सुरक्षित निकले भारतीय छात्र' : पूर्व केंद्रीय मंत्री रवि शंकर प्रसाद pic.twitter.com/TdOvlGyTcG — News24 (@news24tvchannel) June 3, 2022In a video posted by News24, Ravi Shankar Prasad said, “PM Modi had stopped the Russo-Ukraine war for 3 hours. Putin obeyed Modi, then Indian students came out safe.”Fact Check:During the investigation of the viral claim, our team found a report by The Quint. The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) on Thursday, March 3, denied claims that Russia had halted the war for three hours on Wednesday to facilitate the evacuation of Indians from Kharkiv.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wDZQiMmoICg&t=1201s( at 20:21 sec of timestamp )Apart from this, we also found a video report of DD News dated 03 March 2022. In the video MEA spokesperson refuted the news that Russia had stopped the war for three hours to allow Indians to evacuate Kharkiv.During a press conference , Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Arindam Bagchi said, “We got specific inputs that this is a route that is available. We told our citizens, and I am glad that many people could make it. Not in the best of circumstances maybe because I think such an incident happened violence, but it is a war zone. Saying that someone is bombing or it is something that we are coordinating , Which I think is absolutely wrong. I don’t think if I could have been more assertive , it would be extrapolated by itself. This would be what triggered the bombing of our request again.”Conclusion:Hence, Ravi Shankar’s claim of PM Modi stopping the Russia-Ukraine war for 3 hours to evacuate Indian students is false .Claim: Russo-Ukraine war was halted by PM Modi for 3 hours to evacuate Indian studentsClaimed by: Former Union Minister Ravi Shankar OfferingFact Check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Was Hardik Patel Welcomed With A Slap On Joining BJP? Hardik Patel, the leader of the Patidar community in Gujarat, recently resigned from the Congress and joined the BJP. As soon as he joined BJP, his old anti-BJP tweets were fiercely shared by the social media users to troll him. Meanwhile, a video of Patel is going viral. In the video, he is giving a speech on a stage when a person comes and slaps Hardik Patel.Sharing this video, a user named Aman Qureshi wrote- “Hardik Patel was welcomed like this as soon as he joined BJP. ,Further, this video is being shared on all social media platforms. Users are making the video massively viral, making fun of him.Fact Check:To check the veracity of the video going viral, we did an open search on Google. During this, we found a link to the video posted on the YouTube channel of the English newspaper ‘Hindustan Times.’ The caption of the video was – Congress leader Hardik Patel slapped at a rally in Gujarat on 19th April 2019The description of this video shows that he was addressing a rally in Surendranagar, Gujarat, during which a man came and slapped him. However, after a while, Patel’s supporters caught hold of the man and beat him up.Also Read: IS THE MOVIE SAMRAT PRITHVIRAJ BEING PROMOTED FROM THE BJP’S OFFICE?Conclusion:Hence, the investigation of the viral video proves that the viral claims with the video is misleading. Because users are sharing the video of 2019.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Is the movie Samrat Prithviraj being promoted from the BJP’s office? Actor Akshay Kumar has been in the headlines ever since the release of his movie Samrat Prithviraj. This time a picture of actor Manushi Chillar, Akshay Kumar and Union Home Minister Amit Shah standing in front of the movie poster is surfacing on the internet. Further, social media users are sharing the picture with the claim that Akshay is promoting his movie right from the BJP’s office.Meanwhile, a social media user Sanjay Singh Parihar shared a picture on his Facebook handle. On the image, it was written that.” Akshay Ji ask for Indian citizenship also.” Further, the caption also claims that instead of the Kapil Sharma show, promotion of the movie is going on BJP’s office.”Similarly, many social media users have shared this picture on their user handles.Fact CheckOn reverse image search of the viral picture, we got an Instagram post on the verified account of Miss World 2017 Manushi Chillar. The caption of the post is, “Honoured and humbled to meet the Honourable Home Minister of India Shri Amit Shah Ji. And all the other esteemed guests today at the special screening of #SamratPrithviraj in New Delhi. 2 days to go for the release!”Furthermore, we also found the same picture in an article in the Times of India. It is mention in the article that the picture is of the time of the screening of the movie in New Delhi.ConclusionTherefore, this picture is getting viral with the misleading claim. The viral picture is of the special screening of the movie at the Chanakyapuri PVR, New Delhi.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Did Putin Declare Islam as Russia’s Second State Religion? A post on social media is becoming very viral where It is claimed that Russian President Vladimir Putin declared Islam the second state religion of Russia.A Facebook user shared a picture in his post and wrote that Putin ended all the restrictions on Islam by calling Islam the second religion of Russia … Allah Hu Akbar.Fact Check:To investigate the above claim, we first searched for information about this by searching the keywords Russia, Islam, and Vladimir Putin on Google. But we did not get any such news. If this was the case then some news agency would have reported about it.Then our team reverse searched the picture shared in the post and found that this picture is from 2012. The photo was taken during a ceremony to honor Mufti IldusFaizov, the region’s top religious leader, who was injured in a car bombing on July 19, according to Reuters.Whereas according to Article 14 of the Constitution of Russia,The Russian Federation will be a secular state. Where no religion can be established as the state religion or compulsory The religious union shall be separate from the state and shall be equal before the law.Conclusion:Therefore, Putin’s claim of having declared Islam as the second state religion of Russia is false.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: ABP News and BJP leader shared old video of 2020 as Kanpur riots Violent clashes broke out between two communities in Kanpur on June 3, 2022, after Friday prayers. Incidents of stone-pelting also came to light during this period. Many photos and videos are becoming viral on social media regarding these incidents. There are many videos and photos, which are from old incidents, but these videos are being shared as Kanpur.Not only social media users are involved in spreading such misleading information, but big channels of mainstream media are also running news by pretending old videos to be from Kanpur. A video has been played live by ABP News on the official Facebook page. It can be seen that the old video from the Facebook page of ABP News has been circulated in the name of Kanpur. At the same time, BJP leaders, who are verified users, are also among those sharing such misleading videos.Claim-Has been run live on 4th June 2022 from the official Facebook of ABP News. This live has been titled- “Whose conspiracy behind Kanpur violence?…Watch big news LIVE”. In this, a video is being played about the Kanpur riots. It can be seen in this video that some policemen are beating up some people.This video is also being shared by many social media users about the Kanpur riots. There is a verified handle of Laxmikant Bhardwaj on Twitter. Sharing this video, he wrote – “Peacedoots were rioting in Kanpur, Yogi Ji continued his treatment all night. “(Translates Hindi) (archive link )According to Laxmikant Bhardwaj’s bio, he has been a former spokesperson of the Rajasthan BJP. Apart from this, he has also held many important posts in BJP.While sharing this video, a user named ‘Aap Banarasi Hain’ wrote on Facebook – “After the Friday prayers in Kanpur, the sound of ah-ah kept coming till late last night.Fact Check:To check the veracity of the videos shared by social media users including ABP News and BJP leader Laxmikant Bhardwaj, we took screenshots of some frames of the video and reverse searched them. On searching, we found a link to a video posted on Twitter.This video was posted on Twitter by a user named Shivanshu Bharadwaj on 3 April 2020. He wrote the caption- “The same mohalla of Indore where doctors were stoned. Action is a reaction. For weak-hearted, close your voice and watch the video. (Translates Hindi)Conclusion:After fact-checking this video shared by ABP News and BJP leader Laxmikant Bhardwaj, it is proved that the viral video is of an incident in Indore in 2020. This video has nothing to do with the Kanpur riots. Hence the claim being made by ABP News, BJP leader Laxmikant Bhardwaj and other social media users are misleading. It has nothing to do with reality.Claim Review- Rioters beaten up by police in Kanpur riotsClaimed by- ABP News and other users including BJP leaderFact Check – Misleading
label: truth

content: 148 from Muslim Universities and only 2 from Hindu Universities clear UPSC Exam!, Read Fact-Check A picture is going viral on social media sites with Red chillies in the picture. It is also written that only two candidates from Banaras Hindu University (BHU) have succeeded in the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) while a large number of students from Muslim universities have succeeded.Ran Vijay Kumar Singh shared a picture on Facebook. The photo reads, “The total 685 selected in upsc include Muslim University, Jamia-93, AMU-33, Osmania-22, Deshdrohi University JNU-53, Hindu University BHU-2… Where are the children getting ruined?”Fact Check:On the Internet, we searched for some special words from this quote. During this time, we received a tweet from jamia millia islamia’s verified twitter account dated May 30, 2022. In this tweet, it has been mentioned that a total of 23 candidates of Jamia have managed the UPSC exam. In the pictures, it can be seen that VC Najma Akhtar, a student of Jamia RCA, is congratulating UPSC 2021 topper Shruti Sharma.@jmiu_official VC Prof. Najma Akhtar & other officials of the university congratulated RCA, JMI student Shruti Sharma for securing 1st rank in #upsc2021. A total of 23 students from RCA cleared the exam.@rashtrapatibhvn @PMOIndia @dpradhanbjp @EduMinOfIndia @ugc_india pic.twitter.com/gK5Tjjmlzr — Jamia Millia Islamia (NAAC A++ Grade Central Univ) (@jmiu_official) May 30, 2022The Indian Express has also covered it with the headline, “UPSC CSE Rrsult 2021: 23 candidates from Jamia RCA managed in civil services exam.It is to be noted that students of all religions are among those who have succeeded from Jamia RCA.Three students from Osmania University, Hyderabad have succeeded in UPSC 2021.The New Indian Express has published a story with headlines, “UPSC CSE 2021 Result: Six candidates from Telangana and Andhra Pradesh in the top 100 -(Hindi translated)”, according to which apart from Kiranmayi Koppisetty, two other doctors – Dr Syed Mustafa Hashmi – graduated from Osmania Medical College, Hyderabad in 2018 and Dr Prasannakumar V also succeeded in the exam this year.Regarding Banaras Hindu University (BHU), we found a story on the website of the Patrika, titled “Two students from Banaras in UPSC, Devesh, who became ias in the first attempt, succeeded Anand for the second time in a row”(Translates Hindi).According to the information received from unofficial sources, 17 students of IIT BHU have cleared the UPSC 2021 exam.Thus, a total of 19 students from BHU have raised the flag of success in upsc exam this time.Quoting Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU), we could not get information from any reliable source as to how many students have cleared upsc from here. It is estimated that like every time, this time too a good number of people from JNU will have cleared the UPSC.Conclusion:From this fact check of DFRAC, it is clear that the user’s claim that 148 students from Jamia, AMU and Osmania have succeeded in UPSC is false and misleading. According to reports, this time, the success rate of Muslim candidates is the worst in the last 10 years.Year Total Candidates Muslim Candidates 2020 761 31 2019 829 42 2018 485 27 2017 990 50 2016 1099 52 2015 1,078 34 2014 1,236 38Claim: 33 candidates from AMU and 2 from BHU have managed in UPSC Claimed by: Social Media Users Fact Check: Misleading(Follow #DFRAC on Twitter, Facebook, and YouTube.)
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: the viral image of the damaged dome of a masjid is falsely claimed to be of Delhi. Due to the heavy Strom and rains in Delhi on the 30th of May. Many Delhiites suffered losses some lost their shelter, others got their car broken. Jama Masjid’s too had its dome broken and suffered other damage.Meanwhile, a picture of a broken dome of a masjid is getting viral on social media sites. It is claimed that it showed the damaged Jama Masjid dome.A user writes in Hindi, “दिल्ली वाले बुखारी चच्चा तो बिखर गए।वो भी एक झोंके से कसमें खाते थे जामा मस्जिद की तैयारी का,ईंटा-ईंटा हो चुका गुम्बद चच्चा बुखारी का which roughly means that the dome of the Jama masjid is destroyed by the Hailstorm.Fact Check:DFRAC searched the internet and found the same viral picture and the report on the news website Patrika. The report was from the year 2017.It was clear from the report that the viral image was from Bulandshahr, UP.News 18 too covered this report under the headline, “Bulandshahr: People living in the colony panicked after Jama Masjid minaret collapsed. (Translates Hindi)Conclusion:It is clear from the above Fact Check that the picture of the damaged dome of the masjid is from UttarPradesh and not Delhi.Claim Review: damaged dome of the masjid is from Delhi’s Jama Masjid.Claimed by: Social Media Users.Fact Check: misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did Vasundhara Raje quit BJP to join Congress? A big claim was made on social media about former Rajasthan Chief Minister Vasundhara Raje Scindia. In which it was said that VasundharaRaje left BJP to join Congress.A user on Facebook shared the video and said that “Vasundhara left BJP will join Congress”.Fact checkTo check the above claim, we first checked VasundharaRaje’s social media handles – Twitter, Facebook, Instagram. But we did not get any information about this. Then we saw the media section of the official website of VasundharaRaje. But there too no information was found about this.However, we did get a tweet from Navbharat Times. In which he accused the Gehlot government of Congress of misuse of power in the RajyaSabha elections.Conclusion:Therefore, the claim of VasundharaRaje leaving the BJP and joining Congress is fake.Claim Review: VasundharaRaje left BJP and joined CongressClaimant: Facebook UserFact Check: Fake
label: truth

content: “Mahatma Gandhi was once a Sergeant Major in the British Army!” Read Fact-Check A picture is becoming fiercely viral on social media sites. It is being claimed through this picture that the Father of the Nation, Mahatma Gandhi was once in the British army and he was also awarded two medals for his outstanding work.Yogi Vishalananda-Brahma Energy Pranayoga specialist captioned, “Did you know? Mahatma Gandhi was once a Sergeant Major in the British Army and had also received two medals for his outstanding work in the British Army”. Tweeted a photo with this is a group pose. In this picture, the young Gandhi ji is seen behind, which has also been shown by highlighting.A user Digvijay Mishra, captioned, “Is this the truth….you know Mahatma Gandhi was once a Sergeant Major in the British Army and he also got two medals for his brilliant work in the British Army, but yes Congressman’s eyes Savarkar is a traitor in me.” With the same picture posted on Facebook.Fact Check:On doing a reverse image search on the internet, this picture was found on the Alamy website. This photo is said to be about, “Mahatma Gandhi standing the sixth row from the left with the Secretary of the Passive Resisters Soccer Club, Johannesburg, South Africa, 1913, Miss Sonia Schlemiel.”At the same time, we also found this picture of Gandhiji in an article published on the website of the Hindustan Times owned business newspaper Live Mint in June 2010, which was written as “When Bapu kicked the ball”. In this article, Gandhiji’s interest was in sports in his student life.Conclusion:This fact check of DFRAC proves that the claim being made through Bapu’s picture is contextless and misleading.Claim Review: Mahatma Gandhi was once a Sergeant Major in the British Army Claimed by: Social Media Users Fact Check: Misleading(Follow #DFRAC on Twitter, Facebook, and YouTube.)
label: rumor

content: Fact Check:  Know the reality of the viral video of the large crowd at the funeral of Sidhu Moosewala? The untimely death of Shubhdeep Singh Sidhu famously known as Sidhu Moosewala has led the whole world in a state of moaning. People are taking up the internet to show their grief and disappointment on this issue.The Internet is all flooded with the videos of his funeral and the gathering of a large crowd.Amid all this, a new video of a large crowd can be seen on the internet. People are claiming it to be the crowd that has gathered in order to give condolences to the famous singer Sidhu Moosewala.A Facebook user writes, “Rip Sidhu musewala saskar @sidhu_moosewala @sidhu_musewala_fanpage #sidhumoosewala #sidhumoosewalafans #punjabiindustry #punjab #punjabi #punjabisuit #punjqbi #singersongwriter #singer #sidhumoosewalasongs #jatti #jattlife #jattwaad .” Along with the video of a large crowd.Another user writes, “80% of Jats don’t know what they have lost and what a big star he was.”(Translates Hindi) along with the same video.Fact Check:We searched different keyframes of the video to know the reality. We do not found any such video on the funeral of Moosewala.While futher searching we found the same video on a YouTube channel Aapnusanjali .The same video was uploaded under the caption, “Antim Yatra Vir Jawan Harish Sinh Parmar | Jaihind | Army | Kheda |.”This report was also covered by the newspaper under the caption, “last farewell: Tearful farewell to Gujarat’s Veer Harish Singh Parmar, who was martyred in Kashmir.”Conclusion:DFRAC through its research found this claim to be misleading. As the crowd was gathered for the funeral of Harish Singh Parmar, who was martyred while fighting terrorists in Kashmir and not of Sidhu Moosewala.Claim Review: the viral video of the large crowd at the funeral of Sidhu Moosewala.Claimed by: Social Media Users.Fact Check: Misleading.
label: truth

content: Was the mosque built by the Mughals by breaking the temple in Chittorgarh? read- Fact Check of Viral Photo A photo is going viral on social media. Users are sharing this photo claiming that this photo is of a temple in Chittorgarh, which was demolished and converted into a mosque by the Mughal emperors. It can be seen in this photo that below are the walls of the temple and above is the dome shape of the mosque.Social media users are commenting on India’s Ganga-Jamuni Tehzeeb by sharing this photo. Sharing this photo, a user writes- “Stunningly beautiful walls…with an ugly looking dome! This is an old Hindu temple in Chittor converted into a mosque by Mughals … Will any Historian highlight this???? #GyanvapiMosque #TajMahal”https://twitter.com/SujinEswar1/status/1523519450393169920?s=20&t=rRPwDo6dPGBrj2ARVzDbiAAt the same time, another user wrote on Facebook – “Chandrashmi Singh – This is an old Hindu temple of Chittor which was converted into a mosque by the Mughals. Will any historian uncover this??”Many other users have also posted the photo with the same caption.Fact Check:To fact-check the picture going viral on social media, a reverse image search was done on Google. This picture was found on the website of alamy.com, which was posted on 16 December 2009. According to this website, this is an old Hindu temple.At the same time, on searching more about it, we found a published report on the website of thinkingparticle.com. The viral picture is attached to this report. According to this report, this is the Sringar Chauri temple located inside Chittorgarh, Rajasthan, which was built in 1448 AD.https://www.thinkingparticle.com/blog/chittorgarh-largest-fort-indiaConclusion:Our fact check proves that the claims being made by social media users are false and misleading. The claim that the Mughals demolished the temple and built a mosque is false because the temple located in the Chittorgarh Fort is still present, which is called Sringar Chauri Temple.Claim- Mughals had built a mosque by breaking the temple in ChittorClaimant- Social media usersFact Check – Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Pakistani video of IAS couple’s transfer case for taking a dog walk in Delhi stadium goes viral IAS couple Sanjeev Khirwar and wife Rinku Dugga had recently faced transfers for taking a dog walk at the Tyagaraja Stadium in the national capital. Meanwhile, a video is going viral on social media, In which a woman can be seen getting angry.Sharing the video, the Facebook user wrote that after receiving the IAS Madam Transfer Order. In the 10-second clip, the woman can be heard saying in Urdu, “What kind of rule is this?” Whose order was it? Heembarrassed us. We’re all ashamed. I cried at night. I’m crying..Fact Check:To check the above claim, we did a reverse search of the keyframe of the video. During this time, we got a similar video from Pakistan on YouTube. In the video, the woman is showing her displeasure towards the Imran government. The woman is a fan of Maryam Nawaz Sharif.Conclusion:Hence, the claim of the viral video being of an IAS couple from Delhi is fake.Claim review: IAS wife hurt by transfer over dog walk in Delhi stadium expresses angerClaimant: Facebook UserFact Check: Fake
label: rumor

content: Why did CM Gehlot say, “Ra” in Ram means Ram, and “M” means Mohammad? Read Fact-Check A video clip of Rajasthan CM Ashok Gehlot is becoming increasingly viral on social media sites. In this video, he is explaining “Ra” and “M” of Ram. Expressing anger and resentment, users are asking how long will Lord Ram continue to be insulted like this?A user named Babbar Singh Prakash took to Twitter with the caption, “The “Ra” in Ram means Ram and the “M” in Ram means Mohammad: Ashok Gehlot Chief Minister of Rajasthan, will any religious leader answer this parrot? For how long will these people insult Lord Ram like this?” also, shared a video clip in which CM Gehlot is seen saying, “The “Ra” in Ram means Ram, the right thing is said, and the “M” in Ram means Mohammad.”(Translates Hindi)Similarly, a Facebook user named Shuklaa Satish and Instagram page Hindu_he_hum._ have also shared the same video with the exact same caption.Fact Check:Searching about CM Gehlot’s speech on the internet, we found 47.25 minutes video on verified YouTube channel Ashok Gehlot uploaded with the caption “Deval inauguration of Brahmalin Acharya Shri Harinarayanji Maharaj, the inauguration of development works of tourism department” has been done.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=96k9oDyHjVw&t=10sTalking about goodwill, harmony and mutual brotherhood, at 41.24 minutes in the video, CM Gehlot says that Dariyav ji Maharaj had written that “Ra” in Ram means that of Ram, said the right thing, and what is in Ram. “M” means Mohammed. The symbol of such Hindu-Muslim unity was Dariav ji Maharaj.On the other hand, a couplet of Dariyav ji Maharaj was found on the website named Sant Kavi of Ramsnehi Sampradas, which CM Gehlot mentioned during his speech.Conclusion:This fact check of DFRAC proves that the claim being made by users through a short video clip of CM Gehlot’s statement is contextless and misleading, as CM Gehlot spoke on Hindu-Muslim unity. The message of Ji Maharaj was mentioned.Claim Review: CM Gehlot told “Ra” in Ram as Ram and “M” means Mohammad Claimed by: Social media users Fact Check: Misleading(Follow #DFRAC on Twitter, Facebook, and YouTube.)
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did the song “Jannat ki hai Tasveer” by Mohammed Rafi banned initially? A video of the song “Jannat Ki Hai Tasveer” is widely shared by social media users. Sharing that video, it is claimed that Mohammed Rafi sang the song in the year 1971 during the India-Pakistan war and it got banned by the government of India as it was not liked by the people of Pakistan.The song was having the lyrics like “Kashmir hai Bharat ka, Kashmir na denge.Sharing this video a user writes on Facebook, “Muslims did not apologize, 50,000 ulemas were hanged by the British on trees together.It is said that Pakistan objected to this song sung by Mohammad Rafi and it asked the Indian government to ban this song our government had banned this song at that time, it is a rare song, maybe you have never heard the whole song.”The archive link of this post is provided here .Fact Check:We searched for certain keywords on Google to know the reality of the viral claim. DFRAC found that the name of the viral song is “Jannat ki Tasveer” and is from the movie “Johr In Kashmir” which was released in the year 1966.In further research, we found that “ Haji Peer ” was the only word that was objectionable in the whole song which was said to be removed. After that, the song was released.The song is also available on YouTube Channel.Conclusion:Therefore, it is clear from the fact check that the video is going viral with the misleading claim.Claim Review: the song “Jannat ki hai Tasveer” by Mohammed Rafi banned initially.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Reality behind the “#GoBackModi” sign held by Vanathi Srinivasan. A picture of Vanathi Srinivasan, a member of the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly and a lawyer is going viral on social media sites in which she is seen holding the poster that says #GoBackModi.In front of the Adiyogi statue, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu.People all over the internet are posting her picture with the caption, “We stand with Vanathi #GoBack_Modi #GoBackModiFact Check:We reverse searched the image to find its reality. We found the same image, along with some other images on the official Twitter account of Vanathi Srinivasan.In reality, the poster that she was holding says, “Today, the Prime Minister, who made a record of paying Rs 100 crore in vaccinations in front of the Coimbatore Adiyogi statue.@narendramodi The state president Mr. at the youth team event to thank them. @annamalai_k @VinojBJP @apmbjp attended with them #100CroreVaccination.”Conclusion:The picture is getting viral with the misleading claim as no #GoBackModi was written on the poster held by vanathi.Claim Review: “#GoBackModi” sign held by Vanathi SrinivasanClaimed by: social media users.Fact Check: misleading.
label: rumor

content: Fact-Check – Old video viral as Moosewala’s last interview After the murder of a famous Punjab singer and Congress leader Sidhu Moosewala, social media has been flooded with pictures and videos of him in reactionary sorrow and anger. Similarly, a video that is going viral from this content is being claimed by users that this is the last interview of Sidhu Moosewala.A user named Salman Khan shared a video with the caption, “Sidhu moose wala last interview.”In which he answers questions from program host Sonam Bajwa about his life and career. In the end, he also enacts with Sonam in a scene.Fact Check:We did a reverse image search on the internet to find some frames of this video of Sidhu Moosewala going viral on social media. We found that this video was uploaded on YouTube on June 28, 2021, as the 13th episode of the channel Zee Punjabi’s show “Dil Diyan Gallan”.At the same time, the video of this entire interview has been uploaded on the OTT platform “ZEE5” on 06 March 2021.An article related to Sidhu Moose Wala has been published on a website called Newsable, in which the video of this interview has also been mentioned.Conclusion:This fact check by DFRAC proves that the video clip of the interview which is going viral on social media is old, hence users are sharing it with a misleading claim.Claim Review: Moosewala’s last interview Claimed by: Social Media Users Fact Check: Misleading(Follow #DFRAC on Twitter, Facebook, and YouTube.)
label: truth

content: Riyan Parag to become the most irritating player in IPL history?, read – Fact Check Gujarat Titans defeated Rajasthan Royals in the final of IPL-2022 to lift the trophy. Gujarat Titans had entered the IPL for the first time and in their very first IPL tournament, they have won the title. At the same time, after the defeat of Rajasthan Royals, its supporters on social media expressed a lot of anger and also criticized the players who performed poorly.Riyan Parag was the highest target of the trollers. Memes were also shared against him. At the same time, a picture of Riyan Parag is being shared on social media and he is being mocked. In the photo, parag can be seen standing with a trophy and a checkbook. The trophy and the checkbook reads ” Most Irritating Player of IPL History”. Users who shared this picture are writing that Riyan Parag is the right person for this trophy and honour.On Facebook, a user named Mahmood Sayyed wrote- “It deserves this award”On Twitter, Himesh R. Keswani wrote- “Most irritating player award. goes to #RajasthanRoyals #RiyanParag #IPL2022 #GujaratTitans”Fact Check:DFRAC examined the viral picture. On doing a reverse image search of the picture on Google, we found the story of Rediff.com (rediff.com). In this story, the same picture of Riyan Parag is seen, which is being made viral by social media users. However, on the checkbook in the original picture- “PUNCH SUPER STRIKER OF THE MATCH” is written on the checkbook, while “Super Striker” is written on the trophy.Conclusion:DFRAC’s fact check proves that the viral picture of Riyan Parag is false and misleading. It has nothing to do with reality. This picture is being viral by social media users to troll Parag with a misleading claim.Claim review- Riyan Parag Becomes Most Irritating Player of IPL 2022 in IPL HistoryClaimed by- Social media usersFact Check- Misleading(Follow #DFRAC on Twitter, Facebook, and YouTube.)
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Old picture of India in the name of Nepal plane crash goes viral In Nepal, 21 bodies have been recovered from the debris of a Tara Air plane that crashed in the mountainous district of Mustang. On Monday, Tara Air’s Turboprop Twin Otter 9N-AET aircraft went missing in the mountainous region of Nepal shortly after taking off from Pokhara on Sunday morning. A total of 22 people, including 4 Indians, 2 Germans, and 13 Nepalese, were on board, none of whom survived.A picture of this is going viral on social media sites. Users are expressing their condolences by sharing this picture.A user named Krishna Raj Sigdel has posted a screenshot with the caption “Sad News”. In this screenshot, the accident has been reported in the Nepali language with a picture.Fact Check:On doing a reverse image search on the internet, we found that the picture being used by users is from December 2021, which was published by India Today with the headline, “CDS Bipin Rawat died in a helicopter crash: a look at the crash history of IAF’s Mi-17”.Let us tell you that the helicopter of India’s first defence chief or Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) Bipin Rawat had crashed, in which General Rawat died at the age of 63.According to the Hindustan Times, no one has survived since the Tara Air plane crashed with 22 people on Sunday in the mountainous district of Mustang in Nepal. The aircraft took off from the tourist spot in Pokhara at 9:55 am and had lost contact with air control at 10:07 am about 12 minutes later.At the same time, a user named Milan Karki also wrote on Facebook in Nepali, “Sad news.” Tara, who was flying from Pokhara to Jomsom, met with a plane crash. There were 4 others on boarthe plane with 4 members who crashed on the hill above The Layte. A heartfelt tribute to the deceased.Conclusion:This fact check by the DFRAC proves that the picture being used by the users for the Nepal plane crash is misleading, as it is of General Rawat’s helicopter crash in December 2021.Claim Review: Old picture of India in the name of the Tara Air accident goes viral Claimed by: Social Media Users Fact Check: Confusing(Follow #DFRAC on Twitter, Facebook, and YouTube.)
label: truth

content: The person standing in the picture near Bhagwant Mann is not the murderer of Sidhu Moose Wala. Read Fact Check. After the death of the singer Sidhu Moose Wala, all the social media is filled with grief and agitation towards his death.Meanwhile, a picture is getting viral on social media sites of Punjab’s CM Bhagwant Mann and a person standing near him. It is claimed that the person standing near him is the person who murdered famous singer Sidhu Moose Wala, Goldie Brar.A Facebook user writes, “In this photo, who is Standing with Bhagwant Mann, Goldy Brar, has taken responsibility for the murder of Sidhu Musewala, now the question is that at whose behest the security of Musewala was removed. (Translates Hindi)A user on twitter writes, “In this photo, the one who is standing with Bhagwant Mann is Goldy Brar, who has taken the responsibility of killing Sidhu Musewala, now the question is, on whose behest the security of Musewala was removed.https://twitter.com/esjadon4/status/1530951899284877312?s=20&t=fZMzEaz-xwestcci9vubwgFact Check:To find the reality of the viral image, we reverse searched the image and found that the the person in the viral picture is not Goldy Brar who murdered Mose Wala.We found the image of the murdered Goldy Brar on a news report by India Today. Which do not at all looks like the person in the viral image.So, to get more information about the person seen in the viral picture, we started searching with some related keywords on Google. After which we found an article published on Aajtak’s website related to the case. According to the article, the name of the person seen in the viral picture is also Goldie Brar, but it is not Goldy, who is accused of the murder of singer Musewala, but Goldy Brar of Fazilka.Conclusion:The viral picture of Bhagwant Mann with Goldie Brar of Fazilka is not the Goldie Brar who have murdered Sidhu Moose Wala.Claim Review: The person standing in the picture near Bhagwant Mann is not the murderer of Sidhu Moose Wala.Claimed by: Social Media Users.Fact Check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Hindu sadhu’s Jatas and beard was shoved off by Muslim man in Madhya Pradesh? Fake news, videos, and photos often go viral on social media to spread disturbance. Social media users keep sharing such disturbing videos and photos without any investigation. A similar video is going viral on all social media platforms.In this video, it can be seen that a man is behaving badly with an elderly monk. The young man first abused and assaulted the elderly monk, then cut off his jatas and beards. Social media users claim that the person who carried out the incident is a Muslim.Sharing this video, a user named Jansevak Aman Tripathi wrote- “In Khandwa, a Muslim youth burnt an Aghori Sadhu Maharaj and shaved all the mangoes, this pig’s child should be caught as soon as possible, all forward this post as much as possible, it will be punished in the strictest Hindu Act. @khandwapolice @mpcyberpolice”At the same time, Rishi Raj Shankar wrote – “These peacemakers are not going to improve. Someone looks for an excuse to provoke a quarrel. In Khandwa, a Muslim youth shaved the jewel of an Aghori Sadhu Maharaj and shaved his beard all the mangoes. This young man has been arrested.”https://twitter.com/Principalrashtr/status/1530466487261011969?s=20&t=ijEN-yW3g56Vs8VkqULBAwAt the same time, by sharing this video, many other users have also claimed the sameमध्यप्रदेश के खंडवा मैं एक युवक ने भीख मांगने वाले साधु को अपशब्द कहते हुए जटा काट दी. प्रदेश में लगातार इस तरह की घटनाएं सामने आ रही है, क्योंकि आरोपियों के साथ सरकार खड़ी रहती है। इससे पूर्व प्रदेश मैं भाजपा नेता ने मुस्लिम समझकर एक जैन धर्म के बुजुर्ग की हत्या कर दी थी 🧵1/2 pic.twitter.com/Lhf7ZASUhE — Avinash Kadbe اویناش کڈبے (@INCAvinashkadbe) May 24, 2022Fact Check:To check the authenticity of the video that is going viral, we first searched on Google in the context of the incident. We got a report published on NDTV. The report quoted Khandwa Superintendent of Police Vivek Singh as saying, “Khandwa Superintendent of Police Vivek Singh said that the case of assault and jata bite of the sadhu is of Sunday.The sadhu earns his living by asking for alms in the market. At the same time, the accused Praveen Gaur is the hotel operator. There was an argument between the hotel operator and the sadhu over something, after which the hotel operator beat him up in the Surrey market and took him to the salon shop and cut off his jata. ”Conclusion:Other media reports have also mentioned the name of the accused who misbehaved with the sadhu as Praveen Gaur. DFRAC’s fact check revealed the fact that the youth who assaulted the elderly sadhu is not a Muslim. Therefore, the claim being made by social media users is false and misleading.Claim Review: Hindu sadhu shaved off his beard and shaved by a Muslim man.Claimed by – Social Media UsersFact Check – False and Misleading
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Video of Fuji hill of Japan viral as Kailash mountain A video is going viral on social media. It can be seen in this video that there is a very high snow covered hill, clouds are surrounded all around this hill. Which can also be seen from an airplane. Users sharing this video are claiming that this video is of Mount Kailash.Posting this video from Facebook account named ‘Amritsar Shri Balaji Dham‘, caption- “Amazing view of Kailash. You’ve never seen it before”.At the same time, Nageshwar Chauhan also captioned – “Amazing view of Kailash. You’ve never seen it before”.Fact CheckWe reverse searched the frames of the video to check the viral claim. On searching, we found a link to a video published on YouTube. This video has been published on JOSH RAWLIN YouTube channel “JOSH RAWLIN” on 7th April 2018. According to this channel, this video is from the famous Fuji hill of Japan. It looks exactly like the viral video that can be seen from 4.08 minutes to 4.14 minutes of the video uploaded on YouTube.After we gathered more information about the Fuji Hill video, we found a ‘GIPHY GIF’ video on reddit.com. This video is what is going viral. It is written in the caption of this video- “Mt. Fuji cloud sweep”.ConclusionFact check of DFRAC proves that the video going viral is not of Mount Kailash. Hence the claim being made by social media users is misleading.Claim- Amazing view of Mount KailashClaimant- Social media usersFact Check- Misleading
label: truth

content: To give relief from inflation, the central government will give Rs 30,628 to all citizens, read the Fact Check Amidst rising inflation, a post on social media is becoming increasingly viral. In which it was claimed that the central government has decided to give an amount of Rs 30,628 to every citizen of India to overcome this crisis of inflation. Also a link is given. By clicking on which people can make their application.One user wrote on Facebook, “After the price jump, the government decided to give an amount of (Rs 30,628) to the Indian people for every citizen who fulfills the conditions as an aid to the poor class to overcome the crisis. Enter and register now and make sure to register correctly.”Fact CheckTo check this claim that is going viral, we looked at the list of schemes of the government. There we did not get information about any such scheme. At the same time, the plan of the Ministry of Finance has been told in the viral news. We went to the website of the Ministry of Finance but there too we didn’t get anything regarding the scheme.At the same time, on knowing more about this scheme, we got a tweet from Press Information Bureau (PIB). In the tweet, he clarified that the viral message is fake.A message with a link 'https://t.co/sn2GmrJgW9' is doing the rounds on social media and is claiming to offer a financial aid of ₹30,628 in the name of the Ministry of Finance to every citizen.#PIBFactCheck ▶️ This message is FAKE ▶️ No such aid is announced by @FinMinIndia pic.twitter.com/DkbssCM7Ic — PIB Fact Check (@PIBFactCheck) May 23, 2022The tweet read, “A message is doing the rounds on social media with the link ‘https://bit.ly/3P7CiPY’ and claiming to give financial assistance of Rs 30,628 to every citizen in the name of Ministry of Finance. #PIBFactCheck… This message is FAKE… No such assistance has been announced by @FinMinIndia”ConclusionTherefore, it is clear that the claim of giving financial assistance of Rs 30,628 to every citizen from the central government is fake.Claim: To deal with rising inflation, the central government is going to provide financial assistance of Rs 30,628 to every citizen.Claimant: Facebook user.Fact Check: Fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check: A picture of a tribal woman with Nehru goes viral with misleading claim A picture of a tribal woman with India’s first Prime Minister Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru is becoming increasingly viral on social media. The picture was shared with the claim that a tribal woman had inaugurated the Bhabha Atomic Research Center along with Pandit Nehru.A Twitter user captioned the picture – “Bhabha nuclear plant being inaugurated by a tribal woman”. Apart from this, many other users have also shared this picture with similar claim.Fact CheckTo verify the viral image, we first did a reverse search image of the image.Meanwhile, we found a viral picture posted on the official Twitter account of Congress on May 1, 2017. The image is captioned- “In 1959 Pandit Nehru asked Budhni Mejhan, a tribal activist, to press the button to inaugurate the Panchet Dam (now in Jharkhand)”.Apart from this, we also found a report published in The Hindu on June 2012. In which the viral picture was published. Caption of the image- “Switched on, switched off: Budhni inaugurated the power station at Panchet Dam in December 1959. Photo: Nehru Memorial Museum and Library, New Delhi.” has given.The Bhabha Atomic Research Center (BARC) at Mumbai was established in January 1954 as Homi Jehangir Bhabha Atomic Energy Establishment, Trombay (AEET) for India’s nuclear program. After the death of Shri Bhabha in 1966, AEET was renamed as Bhabha Atomic Research Center (BARC).ConclusionIt is clear from the fact check of DFRAC that the viral image has been shared with a misleading claim.Claim: Bhabha Atomic Research Center inaugurated by tribal girl.Claimant: Twitter UserFact Check: Misleading
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Know the truth of the devastating hailstorm in Haryana In a video going viral on social media, terrible scenes of severe hailstorm can be seen. Users are claiming about this video that this shadid hailstorm took place in Karnal, Haryana.A user named India Awaaz captioned on Facebook, “Due to the changing #मौसम(Climate), the rain and the big hailstorm, something like this was seen on the road in Nilokhedi in Karnal, Haryana. ” In this video, there is such a severe hail that passers-by stop their cars on the road and stop.https://www.facebook.com/110113928080754/posts/4885883034874777/Fact Check:We did a reverse search of some frames of this video on the Internet and we found that these videos were uploaded on a German channel’s verified YouTube in July 2017 with the caption, “Hailstorm in Istanbul – which broke the car’s windows”-(Hindi translation).At the same time, we also received a tweet from a verified Twitter account called Kai Diekmann in July 2017. The same video has been posted in this tweet.So einen Hagel habe ich noch nie erlebt! #Istanbul pic.twitter.com/evuEteH30x — Kai Diekmann (@KaiDiekmann) July 27, 2017Conclusion:This fact check by DFRAC proves that the video is being shared with a misleading claim, as the video is from Istanbul, the capital of Turkey.Claim Review: Severe hailstorm in HaryanaClaimed by: Social Media UsersFact Check: Confusing
label: truth

content: Fact Check: 95% of Monkeypox cases in Canada are actually herpes? Monkeypox has been common in African countries for the past several decades, but now the disease is also spreading to other countries of the world. Especially in the US, Canada, and many European countries, cases are being reported. So far, 80 cases of Monkeypox have been detected in 11 countries.A news screenshot that is going viral on social media sites, users are claiming that it has been confirmed in Canada that 95% of monkeypox cases are actually herpes cases.Users named Project Tabs tweeted a screenshot of a CTV News and wrote in the caption: “It’s been confirmed that 95% of Monkeypox cases in Canada are actually cases of herpes. Look! What happens next now? Before they bring out their agenda, we thwart their plans.“Health officials investigating two dozen suspected cases of monkeypox across Canada found that 95% of the cases are shingles.”Similarly, a user named Brenda Fuller also captioned the same news screenshot as, “Ever since I heard the headline about Monkeypox, I’ve been wondering what’s the balla? In North America? Wrong treatment of extreme herpes. . I can buy it. ”Fact Check:We searched Google to investigate this news that is going viral. But we didn’t see any such news anywhere.After this, we checked the website of Canada’s CTV Television Network and Twitter, in fact, the source of the viral news is being given to CTV. We did not find any such information on CTV also.Conclusion:This fact check by DFRAC proves that the claim being made by social media users is misleading, because the news screenshot on which the claim stands is edited.Claim: 95% of monkeypox cases in Canada are cases of herpes Claimed by: Social Media Users Fact Check: FAKE(Follow #DFRAC on Twitter, Facebook, and YouTube.)
label: truth

content: Fact check: Did Telangana CM KCR give a reward of Rs 50 lakh to Nikhat Zareen? Nikhat Zareen, a 25-year-old Indian woman boxer, created history by winning a gold medal at the World Boxing Championships. She was 52 kg category, she defeated Thailand’s JitpongMustamus by 5-0.Meanwhile, a picture of him with Telangana Chief Minister K Chandrasekhar Rao is going viral on social media. Sharing the picture, it was claimed that KCR gave a reward of Rs 50 lakh to Nikhat Zareen.A user wrote on Facebook that Telangana Chief Minister K Chandrasekhar Rao gave a reward of 50 lakh to Nikhat Zareen, who won a gold medal in boxing.Fact Check:To investigate the above claim, we first looked at the news related to the award given to Nikhat Zareen. During this time we received a report of the Deccan Chronicle. The above viral picture can be seen in this report published on August 16, 2014.The caption was given along with the viral picture that Chief Minister K. Chandrasekhar Rao was giving a cheque of Rs 50 lakh to woman boxer Nikhat Zareen in Hyderabad on Friday.Also we received a tweet from Telangana Pradesh Congress Committee (TPCC) president A Revanth Reddy. In which he announced a reward of five lakh rupees to Nikhat Zareen.On behalf of @INCTelanganaI announce Rs 5 lakh to @nikhat_zareen as a token of appreciation for her commendable achievement. Her journey from Nizamabad to Istanbul will inspire many. I demand @TelanganaCMO to reward her as he did earlier forPV Sindhu,Saina & Sania Mirza. pic.twitter.com/65YLdGJbMD — Revanth Reddy (@revanth_anumula) May 22, 2022In a tweet, he wrote, “On behalf of @INCTelangana, I announce Rs 5 lakh as a token of appreciation to @nikhat_zareen for his commendable achievement. His journey from Nizamabad to Istanbul will inspire many. I demand @TelanganaCMO to reward him as he did earlier for PV Sindhu, Saina, and Sania Mirza.Conclusion:So, it is clear that Telangana chief minister K Chandrasekhar Rao’s claim of giving a reward of Rs 50 lakh to Nikhat Zareen for winning a gold medal at the World Boxing Championships is misleading.Claim: Telangana CM KCR gives Rs 50 lakh reward to Nikhat ZareenClaimant: Facebook UserFact Check: Misleading
label: rumor

content: Priyanka Chopra’s objectionable statement on Lord Shiva? Read – Fact Check A collage of images of Priyanka Chopra Jones is going viral. Some captions have been written on this viral photo. In this caption, an objectionable statement has been made about lord Shiva, the aradhya of the Hindu society.On Twitter, a user named Rajiv Kumar Maurya wrote- “The exact answer of Priyanka Chopra, who could not even recognize her son with three eyes on her forehead, how will her devotees be able to identify what the real thing is? ”(translates Hindi)The same graphical photo has been posted on Facebook by a user named Birendra Bai Pass.Fact Check:We searched on Google for a fact check of this news. On searching, we found a report published on March 1, 2022 on the website of ‘Indian Express’. The report said that Priyanka Chopra and her husband Nick Jonas offered prayers to Lord Shiva on the day of Mahashivratri at their home in the US. Many photos of Pooja were also shared by Priyanka Chopra on the status of her Instagram account.From this report, it is clear that Priyanka Chopra worships Lord Shiva, then the question arises whether Priyanka Chopra has really made any such statement about Lord Shiva. To investigate this, we did a reverse search to find out the truth of his photos with graphical posters. After which we got a video published on the YouTube channel of ‘Movie Talkies’ on June 9, 2016.The thumbnail of this video shows the same photo of Priyanka Gandhi, which is going viral with graphical content. According to this news, Priyanka Chopra got angry with the journalists at the Mumbai airport.Conclusion:Our fact check is proving that Priyanka Chopra has not made an objectionable statement about Lord Shiva. His photoshopped statement is being made viral by social media users. Therefore, the claim of social media users is misleading.Claim Review-Priyanka Chopra made an objectionable statement about Lord ShivaClaimed by – Social Media UsersFact Check – False and Misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: What did the MLA of Nepal say in criticism of Narendra Modi? A video is getting viral all over the social media sites in which the MLA of Nepal is claimed of criticizing Narendra Modi and his government.In this video of 4 minutes, he can be seen ranting about the amount spent on Prime Minister Narendra Modi for himself and how much amount he provided to a different country. Also criticizing him and his government in every aspect.Many users on social media shared this video using different captions.A Facebook user writes, “Every Indian must listen to what the Nepal MP said about Modi in the Nepalese Parliament.There are discussions all over the world about the wasteful expenditure of the thrower and the starvation of the country, our media is engaged in praise.(translates Hindi)Many Facebook users shared the same video with the same caption.Fact Check:In the investigation of DFRAC we found the claim to be false. In the video that is going viral, it is not a Nepali MP but Congress MLA from Kinnaur in Himachal Pradesh, Jagat Singh Negi. The House seen in the video is the Assembly of Himachal Pradesh, which is being made viral with misleading claims by referring to the Parliament of Nepal.The whole video can be seen in a video of live time TV Himachal under the caption, “Jagat Singh Negi lambasted the BJP in the House.”Conclusion:The video is getting viral with a misleading claim as the video is not of any MLA of Nepal, but is of Himachal Pradesh.Claim Review: the MLA of Nepal says in criticism of Narendra ModiClaimed by: social media users.Fact Check: misleading
label: truth

content: Was the Ajmer Sharif Dargah built by demolishing the temple? Read – Fact Check These days misleading claims are being made about all the mosques and Mazars in the country including the Taj Mahal, and Qutub Minar. Sometimes a Qutub Minar is described as the Vishnu Pillar, sometimes the Taj Mahal is described as the temple of Tejo Mahadev. Though the court has already advised the petitioners to study MA-PhD on these claims, they are still flooded every day.The latest controversy is being created over the dargah of the great Sufi saint Hazrat Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti in Ajmer. Social media users are making many misleading and factless claims about Ajmer Sharif Dargah. An organization named Maharana Pratap Sena has shared some pictures claiming that Ajmer Sharif Dargah has a fake with a swastika’s mark, which takes place in a Hindu temple.At the Ajmer Sharif Dargah, Dhani Wadhwa wrote: “At the #अजमेर, some foolish Hindus go to the grave of Moinuddin Chishti, who kill lakhs of Hindus in the dargah and palm the shame of thousands of Hindu women. Now the truth is finally coming out.”https://twitter.com/DhaniWadhwa2/status/1529835983935401985?s=20&t=xzHd7qx4_MpqeHZSGY8m0wA user named Amit Dwivedi wrote- “Under the Ajmer Sharif Dargah was the samadhi of a sadhu of the Nath sect on top of which the dargah was erected. It means samadhi of a Nath yogi there. The truth must come out.”https://twitter.com/DwivAmi/status/1530043256716726272?s=20&t=xzHd7qx4_MpqeHZSGY8m0wAt the same time, a user named Ajay Pratap Singh wrote – “Now claims that Khwaja Garib Nawaz Dargah of Ajmer is a Hindu temple, demand for archaeological survey. Dig Dig Dig will find shiva in every corner of India. Har Har Mahadev.”https://twitter.com/REALAJAY4065/status/1529754415367741440?s=20&t=xzHd7qx4_MpqeHZSGY8m0wPt Ravi Shankar Joshi wrote- “The Eklinga temple was demolished and ajmer sharif dargah was built. Meaning to dig up here too. Har Har Mahadev.”https://twitter.com/ravisjoshi44/status/1529847536545959936?s=20&t=xzHd7qx4_MpqeHZSGY8m0wFact Check:This claim is being made by social media users on the basis of a photo going viral. Our team searched Google for its fact check. We found a report published on ‘Dainik Bhaskar’ website on May 27, 2022. The report has been titled – “Truth of the claim of the temple at Ajmer Dargah: Swastika marks not found in the premises, the photographs which were not even forged as shown”.https://www.bhaskar.com/local/rajasthan/ajmer/news/the-photographs-shown-by-the-organization-are-not-even-fake-in-the-campus-129858055.htmlThe report states that – “Dainik Bhaskar visited Dargah Sharif and conducted an inquiry. Here the team did not find any part of the dargah of Sufi saint Hazrat Khwaja Moinuddin Hasan Chishti with a swastik mark on it. Nor were the stones found, as in the picture released by the Maharana Pratap Sena organization.”An investigation by Dainik Bhaskar revealed several more facts, which confirm the absence of a temple at the Ajmer Sharif Dargah.
label: rumor

content: Did APJ Abdul Kalam say that Muslims are made terrorists in madarsas? Read, Fact-Check A newspaper cutting is going viral on social media sites, in which a picture of former President Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam is visible and his statement is also written that Muslims are not born terrorists, they are made in Madrasas.On April 15, 2022, a user named Yogi Supporter posted a newspaper cutting with the caption, “How to become Kalam who has Kasab inside” on which it is written in capital letters, “A precious paper cutting, In this newspaper cutting, his statement is recorded along with dr kalam’s picture as follows, “Muslims are not born terrorists. They are taught the Quran in Madrasas, according to which they selectively kill Hindus, Buddhists, Sikhs, Christians, Jews and other non-Muslims. It is very important to ban thousands of Madarsas operating in India to control terrorism.”Anand Prakash Yadav’s March 22 post on the page of 288-Vidhan Sabha Kaiserganj condemns the running of a bulldozer at a Madarsa in Azizpur. In the comment box of the same post, a user named Pappu Singh Bahraich has also posted the same picture.Fact Check:On doing a reverse search image on the internet, we have not found any such statement from former President Kalam anywhere. If it had been for Dr. Kalam’s statement, it would have been available to be published or mentioned by some trusted institution. However, we found a blogpost dated December 14, 2014, which mentions the text of the viral clip, which is also written on APJ Abdul Kalam’s viral newspaper Cutting. It is titled ‘Computers and the Qur’an’. This blog has been written in the name of L.R. Gandhi.This newspaper cutting has gone viral in Sep 2021 also.Conclusion:This fact check by the DFRAC proves that former President Dr Kalam has not made any such statement and that the newspaper cutting is photoshopped. Therefore, users are sharing it with a fake claim.Claim: Muslims are made terrorists in Madrasas: APJ Abdul Kalam Claimed by: Social Media Users Fact Check: Fake(Follow #DFRAC on Twitter, Facebook, and YouTube.)
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did Pfizer’s Monkeypox vaccine get FDA approval? A post on social media is going viral. It was claimed that Pfizer has developed a new Monkeypox vaccine.One user tweeted that only to clarify… A case of “Monkeypox” was found in Massachusetts this week… In less than 48 hours, the U.S. government bought 13 million Monkeypox vaccines for $119 million. A day later, Pfizer received FDA approval for the New Monkey Pox vaccine.Many other users have also made similar claims.Fact Check:During the course of investigation of the above claim, we found an article by the satirical website Babylon. The title is – ‘Pfizer announced that they did this yesterday to end the Monkeypox vaccineIt is worth mentioning that the website gave information in the About section, writing that Babylon B is the best satirical site in the world, which is completely flawed in all are true claims. We write satire about Christian content, political goods, and everyday life.Julia Cohen, a representative for Pfizer, told Reuters via email: “Pfizer does not currently have a vaccine approved by the FDA for Monkeypox or for an active program. “Apart from this, there has been no update on the Monkeypox vaccine from Pfizer on its website.ConclusionSo, Pfizer’s claim to release the Mancapox vaccine and get it approved by the FDA is wrong.Claim Review: Pfizer’s Monkeypox vaccine approved by FDAClaimed by: Social Media UsersFact Check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check:  Did Chennai residents make a “Go Back Modi” graffiti? Amid Prime minister’s Narendra Modi Chennai trip on 26th of May, a graffiti is getting viral on social media with the words written as “Go Back Modi” on it. The picture is claimed to be of Chennai and it is said that the graffiti is a protest of Chennai residents against Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s visit in the city.People all over the internet are sharing an image of graffiti with different captions.A user on Twitter writes, “TN hates you and your party ideology..#GoBackModi #GoBackFacistModi.”https://twitter.com/yazhiniappa/status/1529598802520248320?s=20&t=A8o9tkWlsRaRDiDt5PNS6gA user on Facebook Mohamed Bayash writes, “TN hates you and your party ideology..#GoBackModi #GoBackFacistModi.”Fact Check:As such images, of graffiti were already getting viral initially from different states of the country like Bihar. We reverse searched the image to know its authenticity. We at DFRAC found the graffiti is not from Chennai or Bihar. It is the image from the Anti-CAA protest in Kolkata in January 2020.The news and the image of the graffiti are on many local news sites of Kolkata like eisamay.com. the headline was, “ Assamese students march in city, researchers in London.”(translates bengali)The news was also covered by India today. The headline was, “Prime Minister Narendra Modi leaves Kolkata, protesters shift venue.”Conclusion:Therefore the image of graffiti is getting viral with the misleading claim. As the image is not from recent times but is from year 2020.Claim Review: Chennai residents make a “Go Back Modi” graffiti.Claimed by: Social media users.Fact Check: misleading
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Was the Sri Lankan Information Minister beaten up by the protesters, know the truth about the viral video Violence in Sri Lanka, which is facing an economic crisis, is not taking its name to stop. The protesters are also targeting the ruling leaders.Meanwhile, a video of a man beating up on social media is going viral. It was claimed that the Sri Lankan information minister was beaten to death by the protesters.In the viral video, a man can be seen walking on the road in torn clothes. Sharing the video, a user wrote – “Sri Lanka’s information minister was beaten to death by people today.”Fact Check:To check the viral video, first converted the video into keyframes. We found a similar video on YouTube when we reverse imaged the keyframe. This video was uploaded on May 11, 2022, on a YouTube channel named Atakatu.Giving information about the video, it was told that the person seen in the video is MahindaKahandagama, President of Sri Lanka People’s Front (SLPP), a union of Colombo Municipal Councilors and Employees. He had participated in a protest rally in front of Temple Trees Gate in support of President MahindaRajapaksa. During this there was violence with them.Giving information about this, MahindaKahandagama told News Wire that “I attended the Temple Trees program and came to the city council, when I came out of the council. Only then was I assaulted.”MahindaKahandagama alleged that he was also treated at the hospital, where someone even pasted the number 69 on his hand.ConclusionHence the claim of Sri Lanka’s Information Minister being beaten up by the protesters along with the viral video is fake.Claim Review: Sri Lanka’s Information Minister thrashed by protestersClaimed by: Social media userFact Check: Fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did Australia’s PM announce a $2.4 billion fund to the World Economic Forum? A screenshot is going viral on social media. It has been claimed in this tweet that the newly elected PM of Australia, Anthony Albanese will give $ 2.4 billion in funding to the World Economic Forum over the next three years.A user posted on Facebook the caption “why??” along with the screenshot of the tweet.Similarly, a Facebook user named Robert Obrain also posted the same tweet’s screenshot,” He’s only just got in and it’s already downhill all the way.” Reads the caption.Fact Check:On searching the internet, we found Anthony Albanese Australian Labor Parody (an unverified @AIboMP Twitter handle) tweeted on 23 May 2022, “Australia will fund $2.4 billion over the next 3 years to support the World Economic Forum, which is currently hosting the 2022 meeting in Davos, Switzerland. This will also be an opportunity to foster a sense of camaraderie, collective purpose, and common destiny.”It should be also noted that there is no Twitter account of the newly elected PM of Australia Anthony Albanese from the @AIboMP Twitter handle. His Twitter account is verified by the Twitter handle @AlboMP and under the name Anthony Albanese. No such tweet has been made from his verified account on 23 May.It is to be noted that in the handle @AlboMP of the verified account, “A” is followed by “L” whereas “A” is followed by “I” (I) in the unverified account.Conclusion:A fake Twitter account has been tweeted in the name of Australia’s newly elected PM Anthony Albanese. Hence the claim made through the screenshot is false.Claim: Australia’s PM announced $2.4 billion in funding to the World Economic Forum over the next three years Claimant: Social Media Users Fact Check: Fake(Follow #DFRAC on Twitter, Facebook, and YouTube.)
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did Russian President Putin Start Wearing Bulletproof Jackets After the Ukraine War? A picture of Russian President Vladimir Putin is becoming very viral on social media. In which he can be seen wearing a tight suit jacket. The picture claimed that Putin started wearing a bulletproof jacket after the Ukraine war.Sharing the viral picture, a Twitter user wrote that Putin seems to have started wearing a bulletproof jacket.This tweet has got more than 23000 likes. Also, hundreds of users have commented on this tweet. The user believes that this picture of Putin is from after the Russo-Ukraine war.Fact Check:To check the viral picture, we first did a reverse image search of this picture. From which it came to know about the picture that this picture was first published by the Russian outlet Kommersant on August 4, 2017.Giving information about the picture, the Russian outlet wrote that this picture was taken by photojournalist Gleb Shchelkunov on August 4, 2017. When Putin reached Lake Baikal during his election campaign.However, looking at the picture in general, it is not possible to determine whether the wrinkles on Putin’s suit came from wearing the bulletproof jacket underneath.Conclusion:Hence the claim made with the viral picture is misleading. Because this photo was taken not after the Russian invasion of Ukraine in May 2022, but during Putin’s election campaign on August 4, 2017.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Did Nirbhaya Lawyer Seema Kushwaha get featured in the list of talented women? A picture of Seema Samridhi Kushwaha is spreading on social media claiming that now she is enlisted in the title of “World’s top 6 talented women”Seema was one of the legal lawyers in the Nirbhaya gang-rape case and was successful in providing justice to the victim by making the culprit hang to death. A picture of her is spreading on social media claiming that now she is enlisted in the title of “World’s top 6 talented women”A Facebook user shared her picture along with a caption that states, “Senior Supreme Court lawyer Seema Samridhi Kushwaha, who brought the convicts of Delhi rape case Nirbhaya case, has been included in the list of the sixth most talented woman in the world. Salute to the women’s power of the country.”Other facebook user writes, “Many Congratulations.”Fact Check:We at DFRAC reverse searched the image to know the authenticity of the picture of Seema getting lot of attention from social media users. We found that any available i nformation about her on the internet does not mention anything in line with the claim.Also, no such lists are announced by any recognized channels. Channels like BBC , TIME , Forbes , etc release a list every year that consists of “100 Women of the year.” Which shows all the talented and efficient women in different fields.In these lists too Seema was not recognized.Conclusion:The news is fake as there is no such list and also the name of Seema is not available in any recognized list.Claim Review: Nirbhaya Lawyer Seema Samridhi Kushwaha gets featured in the list of talented women.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: fake.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did AAP government in punjab wants to remove NRI’s property rights? A video of NRI Affairs minister of Punjab’s AAP (Aam Admi Party) Kuldeep Singh Dhaliwal is getting viral on social media platforms. In the video’s short clip, Kuldeep was seen saying, “ if an NRI’s land is continuously on lease with someone, then NRI will automatically lose ownership of the land. We do not want any NRIs to lose their property through this judgment.”The video was shared on Facebook, “these NRIs want inqlaab in Punjab. They are the ones who flew in support of Kejriwal and poured lots of money on him. This law will apply to those NRIs who support Khalistan.” Reads the caption. (translates Punjabi)Fact Check:By reverse searching, the video on the internet DFRAC found that the video was clipped part of the entire video.In the video, Kuldeep was saying about the supreme court ruling related to property rights and how that will affect the NRIs adversely.We found the same interview on the official Facebook page of the Punjab government and found the full video of the clipped video that is running all around the internet.The video is from the 12th of march and the part getting attraction starts from 3 minutes and 10 seconds.The same video was uploaded on the verified Youtube channel.Conclusion:The video was the clipped part of the speech given by Kuldeep Singh Dhaliwal, hence misleading in nature.Claim Review: AAP government in Punjab wants to remove NRI’s property rights.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: misleading
label: truth
